name.en: Drawn exactly where it does not return

mechanism.en: For every determined law next : S → S, with no finiteness or decidability, a configuration is drawn into some absorbing region exactly where it does not return, and once drawn never comes back. The main law is near-definitional (the region used is the configuration's own course ahead) and not a classical attractor: no attracting neighbourhood, minimality, topology or measure. What can be had n steps on is absorbing, and every possibility lost by step n is drawn into it. Of two configurations merged, not both return, so a law that merges draws something, up to double negation; within finitely many listed configurations with equality decided, the law merges nothing exactly where nothing is drawn, while an open world separates the two (counting on draws 0 and merges nothing, a witness). For processes (any process), absorbing under a law is invariant under its process, and a run in an invariant region stays locked in.

edge.en: Along a run of a process, where it is inside a region at step n and outside at step n + 1, the move at step n does not keep the region. A region every move taken keeps need not be invariant.
In Exit, {true} is absorbing under the move false and not under the move true; the run that leaves takes, at its first step, a move that does not keep {true} (a witness on two configurations).

open.en: Which regions actual unfoldings enter, and how deep or wide a basin is, lie outside the theorems.
Escape from beyond the representation is not stated, a determined law having no move or exchange from beyond.
The links to Capture, Admission and Becoming.Experiment are readings.

name.en: Basins of a determined law, one cycle each

mechanism.en: Under any determined law, courses meeting (at one configuration at some steps) is an equivalence whose classes are basins; a course reaches every returning configuration of its basin. Within m listed configurations every course enters what returns before step m and each basin holds one cycle; the finiteness is a hypothesis of those two laws and not of the others.

condition.en: Within m listed configurations every course enters what returns before step m.

open.en: How many basins an actual law has.

name.en: Necessarily drawn exactly what does not return

mechanism.en: Where courses branch, a configuration is necessarily drawn into a region where every run from it enters, possibly drawn where some reachable configuration lies in it. Every process necessarily draws exactly what does not return, a returning configuration having a run round to it for ever, built constructively; possibly drawn is losing oneself on some course, allowing return on another (OneWay, a witness). Runs are infinite, so a dead end, having no run, is necessarily drawn vacuously: the law quantifies over runs and does not say a course entering the region exists. Under every process what can be had n steps on is a region the process never leaves. Failing to return is failing to keep: every configuration reachable from s is reachable from t exactly where t leads back to s; return belongs to the law, not to the change, and a reading that omits the configuration reached can hide the loss (a witness). With configurations of a state and a self-keeping rule on which alone the next depends, a perturbed state is drawn back at once. "Necessarily" and "possibly" quantify over runs and weigh none.

edge.en: A configuration possibly drawn may return on another course: in OneWay, false is possibly but not necessarily drawn into {true}, which the process never leaves, and returns (a witness).

open.en: For processes, what returns need not be a region the process never leaves (Transit.returning_not_invariant), as it is for determined laws.
A merge need draw neither of the two: OneWay merges false and true, both return, and every possibility is kept.
Being drawn in within a bound is not stated.
No measure on branching courses is given; weighted histories are in Becoming.Weighted.
Returning to an equal configuration does not erase the history between: equality of configurations is not identity of histories.
Physical irreversibility does not follow: the laws are of a represented process, and their correspondence to physics is a separate obligation.

name.en: Every loss passes a juncture

mechanism.en: A juncture for s is a configuration with one step after which s can still be had and one after which it cannot. Where s returns, every course from s to where s cannot be had again passes, up to double negation, a juncture at which it takes its losing step. Keeping only the steps after which s can still be had keeps s, holds every sub-process keeping s on its course, and removes exactly the losing steps; a process keeping s has no juncture for s on its course, however many options it has (witness Many). At a configuration with a step keeping s that is no juncture, no step can be refuted to keep it: a choice matters only at a juncture. Where a list holds the configurations and steps are decided, the juncture is found by search and, s returning, what can have s has it within the count of configurations; finding the juncture of every loss of every process gives LPO. World, with a process, under the premises its transition states: to turn a reader at a juncture, a source must, not not, have reached it before. Reading [AI reading, D25, D32, D43, D52]: keeping and losing at a juncture are one operation with no valuation.

edge.en: Keeping, the steps after which s can still be had, can have s from where the process can and keeps s; a process keeping s has no juncture for s on its course.

Where the step chosen in one course keeps s, and the step chosen in the other leads somewhere and loses s wherever it leads, x is a juncture for s and the source has, not not, reached the reader by D: to turn a reader at a juncture, a source must reach it before. Finding the reaching outright needs reaching decided.

condition.en: Where s returns, every course from s, or from a configuration that can have s, to one that cannot passes, up to double negation, a juncture at which it takes its losing step.

World, with a process; before D both courses balanced with the same formations present, a common start, and every formation the source has not reached responding through its couplings; the reader at one configuration x in both courses supplied: a reader the source has not reached by D, whose step at x is chosen from what it reads through its couplings up to D, takes the same step in both courses; so to turn a reader at a juncture a source must have, not not, reached it by D.

open.en: Junctures for a set of configurations, or for a profile of several possibilities at once; which junctures actual unfoldings have.
That keeping is better than losing, or which configuration ought to be kept.
That the reader is at x in both courses, or that a step is chosen from the answer.
A bound on how long s stays obtainable along a course: on a cycle it can stay so for ever.

name.en: Not going out of a region

mechanism.en: Nothing in a region goes out of it along a relation where no member bears the relation to something outside. A closed region is not gone out of, an occurrence's closure among them; not going out is exactly the closedness of what is not outside the region, with no decision; where membership is stable, whatever is not outside lying inside, it is being closed, and that the two coincide for every relation and region is excluded middle. Nothing comes into a region exactly where nothing goes out of what lies outside it, and along a symmetric relation nothing goes out exactly where nothing comes in; some relation that is not symmetric has a closed region come into. A line under any class from a member to something outside means the region is not one nothing goes out of. Any carrier, relation and region: these laws choose no boundary.

declarations: Becoming.«不出当且仅当不外者闭»
Becoming.«不外者内则不出当且仅当闭»
Becoming.«逆之不出当且仅当外者不出»
Becoming.«对称则不出当且仅当逆不出»
Becoming.«定则内至外之线有出步»

edge.en: Where every step of continuation keeps to the region, its end a member wherever its start is, or goes from a member to something outside, a line from a member to something outside has a step going out, reached from the start and reaching the end.

open.en: That a region nothing goes out of is closed: where membership is not stable, what a member bears the relation to is only not outside.
Where on a line a step going out lies, or that one exists, when the steps are not split into keeping and going out: then only that the region is not one nothing goes out of.
A graded boundary, or which relation a self's boundary is drawn along: the laws hold for any region and relation and choose neither.

name.en: Degeneration from a horizon

mechanism.en: At any class included in activity, the kind class among them, a line from an active occurrence of which nothing reached at a step N, at or after its start, is active ends on every branch: the pattern degenerates (退化). The proof is by induction on the steps left, along every branch, with no excluded middle and no premise that an occurrence has one continuation. So each of three regimes (a dependence held below its need where activity needs support, a family drawn beyond its gated renewal, a passing stopped with brief carriers) degenerates under exactly the premises of its law that the line is not 不穷; in witnesses each line takes a step first and activity is given. Root for reaching an end: without a decision, ending on every branch reaches an end (有终) only up to double negation; with going on decided along the line, an end; that every line meeting the premise reaches an end is exactly excluded middle. A line known to end on every branch within a known horizon does not thereby show where it ends.

declarations: Becoming.«尽则有终当且仅当排中»

open.en: That a line known to end on every branch within a known horizon shows a point at which it ends: showing one is deciding, at the points of the line, whether a step continues it.
That a regime is what ends a line: in the witnesses activity is given, and they show only that the premises hold together.
Degeneration where no one step bounds every branch: the law asks for a uniform horizon.
The some-branch regions (生成, 后守) on the World: what this record reads on the World is degeneration, the every-branch region.
The some-branch regions read on the World.

name.en: Loss of renewal for good

mechanism.en: Loss for good is a law of every balanced flow: where whatever gives to a condition depends on it at a need of at least m and is supported where it gives, a level below m stays below; where activity needs support every formation depending at such a need is inactive at each such step, so from then on. With balance, where the joint exchange gives no more than it takes below m, a level below m never returns to it, gated renewal being the case. In the support-gated family (one shared condition, natural-number levels), drawing beyond renewal ends the renewal for good, and two drawers each within renewal can together consume it (joint drawing represented as one law with the summed draw, exact where they share a support level); a dependent drawer then ends itself with bounded formation, an independent one can persist (a witness). Forming new organization at every step, or the drawer's own course, leaves the class undecided. Renewing and consuming exclude each other and do not exhaust the cases.

forbids.en: A condition below a need measured in advance returning with nothing given from beyond; a dependent active while its condition stood below its need (Thesis T1, whose model is the regime's point and the gated World law).

edge.en: Without the gate a formation inactive at the step the excess reaches can be active again: a part inactive at step 1, where a renewer not requiring the condition gives, is active from step 2 on (a witness).

Where activity needs support, a formation still active after a loss without return has weakened or dissolved its dependence on the condition; with its dependence fixed it is not active after the loss.

open.en: Does not show that real processes satisfy the law family.

Consumed does not require the dependence ever to have been met: a requirement never met makes the condition consumed and the drawer consuming without any break or loss (see becoming-dependence-dynamics).
Does not say how losses within a renewed cycle are weighed.

A run of T1's field test with a need measured in advance and of its test on lakes stocked back above that need: both are frozen and refused at the header of the agency's table, and a design that can read those records is claimed as T1B, not frozen and not being worked on.

name.en: Three outcomes of a loss: restored, transformed, or ended where dependence is fixed

mechanism.en: Read as observables of the configuration, dependence makes every run a web; each step keeps, breaks, forms or dissolves each dependence. Of a dependence holding at one step and not at a later one, it cannot be that no step between dissolves it (constructive, naming no step; found where the dependence is decided at each step). Where activity needs support (Dependent, which leaves out buffers, reserves and lags), three outcomes of a loss are constrained, not exhaustive or exclusive: continuing unweakened means restored, still active after a loss without return means transformed, and fixed dependence means ended. Each holds at a single step of any web with its local condition inside the law. In Crossing all three follow one break, the move that makes the break selecting the outcome (a witness). That it is the same break depends on reading the fall against the dependence at the step's start: at the step's end only the restoring run has a break. A formation's identity across steps is given by the index F, not derived here.

edge.en: Under Dependent, a formation active with a dependence at least as strong as an earlier one finds the condition meeting the earlier need.

Under Dependent, after a loss without return, a formation still active has weakened or dissolved its dependence on the condition. A lowered need counts as transformation; an application telling weakening from substitution refines it by Dissolves and Forms.

From one configuration of one process, three runs break the same dependence at the first step, read at the step's start: one ends with no return of the loss, one dissolves it as a dependence on the second condition forms and stays active with no return of the loss, one waits while the condition is renewed and keeps the dependence again (a witness).

open.en: Dependent excludes buffers, reserves and lags; it is the zero reserve, and with a reserve these outcomes are deferred, not removed (reserve-defers-ending).

Derive the identity of formations from relations, and represent splits and merges; identity-across-steps proves that the distinction between ending and transformation, arising and undermining depend on identity across steps, which continuity of activity and dependence constrains up to succession.

name.en: The point of no return of a regime

mechanism.en: The regime (one condition, whole numbers, any giving law): a condition gives by a law of what a standing draw H leaves, the draw taken first. Where giving falls short of the draw below y, gives nothing from nothing, meets it at every z from y with z + H at most a top hi the step keeps, and 0 < H + y, a level up to hi ends exactly where it starts below H + y; a positive level below falls at every step and stays nothing. Where giving stops below a need, the draw is positive and giving meets it at y, the point lies at least the draw above the need, and, y the least level meeting the draw, more than that exactly where giving at the need falls short of the draw. Draws add, and their rises at the point are superadditive up to one, with joint giving subadditive above the need and no greater than under either draw; two draws each held alone can end the condition together (Peaked, a witness). How giving depends on the draw, and that giving is read off the level within a regime, are premises. These laws locate an end, ordering nothing.

forbids.en: A condition below a need measured in advance returning with nothing given from beyond; a dependent active while its condition stood below its need (Thesis T1, whose model is the regime's point and the gated World law).

edge.en: From a level up to the top, under the law's premises, the condition ends exactly where it starts below H + y; from H + y up to the top the level never falls below its start.

Where giving adjusts, what was given can carry a condition across the point: with giving moving one unit a step toward the regime's, from four with recent giving six the level is at least seven from the second step on, and from five with recent giving nothing it is nothing, where the regime's step ends four and holds five (a witness).

condition.en: Where giving falls short of the draw below y, gives nothing from nothing, meets it at every z from y with z + H at most a top hi the step keeps, and 0 < H + y, a level up to hi ends exactly where it starts below H + y.

With joint giving subadditive above the need and, at each amount left, no greater than under either draw, where the least levels meeting the two draws and the joint draw lie a, b and c above the need, a + b ≤ c + 1.
Where nothing gives from nothing, a draw beyond all giving ends the condition from every level; a larger draw, giving no more, raises the point by at least the difference.
The time to break lies in a band: the level stays at or above b at every step n with b + H n ≤ x; where giving is at most Y and Y ≤ H ≤ b, it falls below b within any n with x < b + (H − Y) n.

open.en: How giving depends on the draw, or that giving is read off the level within a regime: both are premises, measured in yeast, not theorems.
That the regime's point predicts a field system: in assessed fish stocks giving persists beyond what the level gives, and the frozen rest forecasts better than the regime margin.

That a margin times a break: in the field the frozen-rest margin ranks the risk, but a third of those it put within five years fell; yeast driven past its fold broke three and at least six days before the curve from constant regimes said.
The fold over the reals, or the other order of a step (giving before the draw): neither is stated.
That drawing beyond the margin is worse: these laws locate where a condition ends, and order nothing.
Super-additivity for every concave giving law: the hypothesis is subadditivity above the need, and the whole numbers lose one unit.
Real amounts, damping strengths, continuous time, infinitely many conditions; the regime's threshold over the reals as a computed level.

A run of T1's field test with a need measured in advance and of its test on lakes stocked back above that need: both are frozen and refused at the header of the agency's table, and a design that can read those records is claimed as T1B, not frozen and not being worked on.

name.en: One law of exact thresholds, and the threshold in the plane of level and recent giving

mechanism.en: Any fate over whole-number levels: where a fate is down-closed in the level and read off an exact check, the least level up to a bound from which the check fails is exact; where one fate implies another, the implying fate's threshold is no higher. The regime for its cases: for giving that adjusts, reading what is left and the recent giving, rising in both and keeping a band up to hi, the runs from a level and a recent giving up to hi that rest below the draw are, for each such recent giving, those from levels below a least level, decided at step 3 hi + 3, which does not rise as the recent giving rises; under the regime's own step it is H + y. For an adjustment also resting at the draw exactly where the regime gives it, every run within the band rests within 3 hi + 3 steps, either at or above the draw, with recent giving equal to the draw and a level the regime's step leaves as it is (any such fixed point, not only the point of no return), or below the draw with level and recent giving equal; whether it changes again is decided at each step. Rising with what is left cannot be dropped: in a witness whose giving does not rise with it, no level separates the fates (Notch).

edge.en: The run from a level and a recent giving up to hi, under an adjustment rising in both and a band, rests below the draw exactly where the level is below the threshold for its recent giving.

condition.en: Where a fate is down-closed in the level and read off an exact check, the least level up to a bound from which the check fails is exact. Rising with what is left cannot be dropped: in a witness whose giving does not rise with it, no level separates the fates (Notch).

open.en: The threshold over the reals as a computed level: there a run converges, and record regime-in-any-amounts states the fates as down-closed and falling with the recent giving, not the level.

Read through the balance as an adjustment, the field's giving meets the rising premise only partly (post hoc, MQ5 stocks): it rises in the recent giving in 65 of 69 stocks; it does not rise in what is left over the whole band, each stock's fitted level law humped, rising over the whole band in only 4 of 69. So the order laws reach the field's state on the low side of its level law, below the peak, where the point of no return lies.

That measured adjustments rise in both arguments over their band, or how often below-point episodes with recent giving short of the catch fall in the field: the curve's direction is proved under the premises; its field frequency was tested once (MQ7), the frozen bound was not met, so the frequency is not established.
The threshold beyond the band, where the search stops at hi + 1; a state with a further lag.
Rest in finitely many steps over the reals: in whole numbers each change moves an amount by at least one; over the reals a run converges and need not rest (record regime-in-any-amounts).

name.en: The exit from a margin

mechanism.en: Two values, natural weights p and q, independent steps: a level standing m above a need, raised q by each one and lowered p by each zero, so that its rises and falls balance under the weights, reaches the need or falls below it at some step on courses taking at most n·p·q/m² of the weight: Kolmogorov's maximal inequality restated in counting form. Standing at the need is not a break, since a need within the level is supported; a break, the level below the need, is reaching it from m + 1. A course can fall and recover, so the count at some step can exceed the count at the horizon (a witness). Given a record of the earliest steps that leaves the level m′ above the need without having reached it, the share of the courses reaching the need within the n steps left is the share from m′. Reading [AI reading, D45]: it is the unregulated case a reading of persisting is measured against, void from n = m·m/(p·q); it is not the regime's point of no return, where giving reads the level.

condition.en: The courses of n steps reaching the need weigh, times m·m, at most n·p·q·(p + q)ⁿ: at most n·p·q/m² of the weight.

open.en: That a level leaves every margin in time: a balanced walk recurs, which is not proved here.
A level whose rises and falls do not balance, more than two values, or steps that are not independent.
Exponential exit bounds: one on ending fallen follows from concentrated; one within the horizon needs its maximal form.

That the exit bound is the free-energy principle's quantity: it is the unregulated case a reading of persisting is measured against, void from n = m·m/(p·q), and gives that principle's containment no third part.

name.en: Consumption ends with its feeders

mechanism.en: Under balance, only active formations giving and activity needing support, a formation taking from a condition at every step from T at which it is active, while nothing supported gives to it, is active for at most as many consecutive steps from T as the condition's level at T; the same holds where it requires the condition while active and everything feeding its continuation is unsupported: keeping its own support, it can still end through its feeder, as in Overshoot (a witness). The bounds hold with balance at the condition and whatever gives to it supported, only across the steps counted. The law is near-definitional: the level falls at each active step, so it bounds the run as a ranking function does; a consumer overshooting what feeds it is known (Catton 1980). Withholding both of two redundant feeders with the remaining taking fixed leaves no balancing path, and the ending with neither is shown on a separate reference flow.

edge.en: With balance at the condition and givers supported over the stretch, requiring and taking for more steps than the initial level exhibits a supported feeder at one of them.
Either of two redundant feeders suffices: with either, the consumer is active and supported at every step (a witness).
With the same dependences, each taking only from its own condition, the flow balances and both are active and supported at every step (a witness; a separate flow, not a course out of Overshoot).

In the support-gated law with a substitutable condition, where the focal formation draws beyond renewal from the start (both needs positive, the focal need within the sustaining one and met at the start), it stays active at every step by switching, still consuming, and the sustaining formation ends. The ability to switch is a modelling choice, and the alternative's level is constant.

condition.en: Active for at most as many consecutive steps from T as the condition's level at T, while nothing supported gives to it.

open.en: No ought follows.

The exact conditions do not make support sufficient for activity; meeting needs does not imply continued actual activity; witness activity is specified and shown consistent with balance and dependence.
Overshoot still compares two flows; withholding within one flow is added, but withholding both with the original taking fixed proves no balancing path, not a dynamically adjusted activity.
Across-step feeding characterizes possible carrying only, leaving actual origin open.

beyond.en: A loss beyond the closure need not return: in Clearing the clearer's closure is supported at every step while the dweller ends (a witness; Clearing.closure_supported, record feeding-closure).

name.en: A consumer that switches stays consuming, on the whole-run reading

mechanism.en: On every web, a consumer stays consuming under every change of its own dependence from a step on exactly where its loss is witnessed by a dependence the change leaves, another's or its own before that step; where only its own dependence witnesses the loss, dissolving that dependence removes the consumption (Lone, a witness). The support-gated law with a substitutable condition is an instance: where the focal formation draws beyond renewal from the start (both needs positive, the focal need within the sustaining one and met at the start), it stays active at every step by switching, it is still consuming, and the sustaining formation ends. Substitution keeps the focal formation active without undoing its consumption; whole-run reading only: on the stepwise reading, in the law extracting, the focal formation is included at every step but step 2, and in the law slow it is withheld at steps 2 and 3. Choosing dependence by support writes the ability to substitute into the model, a modelling choice, and the alternative's level is constant, so drawing on it lowers no level in the model.

edge.en: Consumption is kept under every change of the consumer's own dependence from T₀ on exactly when it consumes through a dependence that change leaves.
A lone formation consumes through no dependence a change from step 0 leaves, and with its dependence dissolved it no longer consumes (a witness).

open.en: Preservation holds on the whole-run reading only.
That what is withheld are, in general, the steps after the sustaining formation loses support and before the focal formation switches is an argument, not formalized.
The individuation of formations is not treated (how identity across steps bears on these readings is in identity-across-steps).

name.en: An end cascading along total dependence

mechanism.en: The regime on webs: any number of conditions, each draw taken first, each giving a law of what is left of all (two: the web indexed by Bool). Where i gives nothing wherever nothing is left of j, i drains once j stays within its draw; in whole numbers it falls by its draw at every step and, the draw positive, is nothing within as many steps as its level, so j's end ends i. Along every chain of total dependence with positive draws on dependents the end of one ends everything downstream, a ring ending together or not at all, and a draw of nothing stops the cascade. Under mutual support (every giving rising with what is left of each) the order of states is kept, so raising a level never ends one that held; inhibition breaks that order (a witness). For finitely many listed conditions within a band under mutual support a run rests within the count times hi plus one steps, ending decided there. In a finite web read condition by condition, a run within a bound B repeats within (B + 1)^n steps, so ending is a finite check with no band; such a run need not rest (Relay.cycles, a witness). Under mutual support each point of no return, in either case, is exact and does not rise as any other level rises. With giving also reading what each gave last, under mutual support bounded runs have ending decided and thresholds exact, not rising as any level or recent giving rises; what was given can lower a threshold (Momentum, a witness). Total dependence, positive draws, mutual support and a band are premises, untested in field webs.

edge.en: With no draw on the middle of a chain the first still ends, yet the third, downstream of it, holds at two for ever: positive draws on dependents cannot be dropped (a witness).
Support can save: from two the first ends with its partner at nothing and holds with its partner at two; its threshold is three at a partner of nothing and two at a partner of two (a witness).
Beyond a band support can sustain a cycle: a pair each of which ends alone moves between two and three and three and two for ever from two and three (a witness).

What was given can lower a threshold: one condition under a draw of two gives one where something is left and nothing was given last, two where something was; levels up to four, its threshold is four having given nothing and three having given one, so from three it ends having given nothing and holds having given one (a witness).

condition.en: Within a band under mutual support, in whole numbers, whether the first condition ends is decided at step 2 hi + 1; for each partner's level up to hi it ends exactly below a least level found by a finite search, which does not rise as the partner's level rises.

For finitely many listed conditions within a band under mutual support, each condition's point of no return, the others' levels given, is a least level up to hi + 1 below which exactly it ends, and does not rise as any other level rises; in a finite web read condition by condition, where the run stays within a bound B, a condition ends exactly where it is nothing at every step from L = (B + 1)^n to 2 L.

For finitely many listed conditions whose giving also reads what each gave last, under mutual support, where the run from a condition's top level stays within a bound B: ending is a finite check, and the threshold is exact and does not rise as any level or recent giving rises.

open.en: Partial dependence, where giving falls without stopping; the time of a cascade along a chain beyond each link's; the reals and continuous time.
That measured webs have total dependence or positive draws on their chains: the cascade is proved under these premises; how far it reaches in a field web is untested.
That measured conditions are coupled by mutual support, or how strongly: a partner's level would be a fourth variable in T2's state; how strong coupling is in the field is untested.
Runs that grow without bound: there whether a condition ends is not decided here.
Rest within a band for webs with a recent giving; partial dependence; a cascade's time.
Giving reading more than the last step; runs without bound; amounts beyond whole numbers.
That measured conditions give by what they gave last, or by how much.

name.en: Co-ending along dependence

mechanism.en: Where activity needs support (the premise Dependent, which leaves out buffers, reserves and lags), a formation depending on an embodied relatum at a positive need is active only while that relatum is, and activity passes along every chain of such dependence: a relatum not active at a step leaves inactive there every formation whose chain of such dependence reaches it. Consuming an embodied relatum at a need of one ends it. Embodied is a representational premise about particular relata; which relata are embodied is an application duty. The law is of one step at a time: no lag is stated here, and being embodied is not being a life.

open.en: Dependent leaves out buffers, reserves, dormancy and lags, under which coextinction need not hold at the same step; lagged coextinction along chains of dependence is stated in reserve-defers-ending.

name.en: A whole of every part ends with one part; the grade between it and a whole of some part

mechanism.en: A whole of every part (active exactly while every part is) ends once one part ends, with no listing. Between it and the whole of some part lies the grade, the count of listed parts active, existing where their activity is decided, changing only as a part arises or ceases; a whole of at least j parts arises and ceases only through a part, and is diminished where some parts are active and not all: of three rafters with one taken, two stand and the house does not (a witness). A whole of some part ceases only as some part ceases. Which whole a formation is, and that a whole is constitution rather than coincidence of activity, are not shown. A whole whose parts arise only through a family drawn beyond its renewal ends: family B's whole-drawing-beyond-renewal-ends.

edge.en: A whole of every part is active at every step from T on exactly where every part is: it persists with no arising, but only while no part ceases.

The same parts, the two wholes: in Generations a formation that is the whole of every member is active at no step, while the lineage, the whole of some member, is active at every step (a witness). Where a whole of some part has its parts arising only through a family drawn beyond its renewal, whole-drawing-beyond-renewal-ends' law ends it.

open.en: Weighted parts, wholes of wholes, or the grade of infinitely many parts.
Which whole a given formation is, or which formations are its parts: these are readings.
That any of the three wholes is constitution rather than coincidence of activity.

name.en: A confined rise within a whole

mechanism.en: Where a family of conditions ran into excess under the coupled gate, every member of a later cohort of descent is the offspring of a member that depended on no condition of the family at the gate's need. A rise is a lineage marked by an amount that selection within goes for before the end, taking from the family during its excess, the family's renewal gated and in excess; it is confined where every later member depends on the family. A confined rise has no member after the end, whatever selection within had raised it to. Hypotheses: balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent, the coupled gate and n steps of excess from a stock below n + m; confinement is a hypothesis; these restate known results on cancer and the germ line (Buss 1987; Michod 1999). Any type for the founding laws: over wholes each founded by one part, where every next founder carries its founder's value (Sequestered, a hypothesis stating an outcome, not a mechanism), the mean founding value rises exactly where selection among wholes goes for it; without it, in the witness Germline, a variant selected for within lowers the mean founding value from a half to none although selection among wholes goes for holding back.

edge.en: In the witness Body, of two lineages meeting every clause of a rise, the confined one ends and the one whose descendant depends on a condition outside the body still has a member a cohort after every part depending on the body has ended; it has a member for one generation past the end.

open.en: How parts first come to live as one (the major transitions themselves): the laws hold of a whole once formed and of its foundings.
That a given tumour meets the clauses of ConfinedRise, or that a given germ line is sequestered: empirical. Confinement, the excess and how founders are drawn are hypotheses wherever they enter.

Wholes founded by several parts (colonial and aggregative routes), removal of parts by the whole's rule (policing in the literature), and a lineage founding a new whole elsewhere are not stated; the spreading witness has a member for one generation past the end.
That a lineage ending with its whole is worse, or that sequestration is better: the counts read who leaves descendants; ranking goes through the comparison C or a premise in its place.

Sequestered states an outcome (each next founder carries its founder's value), not a mechanism; germ lines do vary, and the rise's drawing clause says the lineage takes from the family during the excess, not that it causes it.

name.en: Ending laws as regimes on a lineage

mechanism.en: Three ending laws, each read as deciding a lineage's region under a premise on what the line reaches, are regimes, and the stock enters each only as its horizon. Renewal run past what it gives: under balance and with activity needing support, n steps of a family's uptake above its replenishment from a stock below n + m make the line from an active occurrence at a step not after T + n degenerate at the kind grain wherever everything it reaches at T + n requires a member at a need of at least m, whatever renews the family; a restatement of the ledger and of activity needing support, not a further result. Dissipation within a balanced family: a lineage reproduces at most the starting stock many steps and then ends; the census holding every continuation, every member of every cohort degenerates. A draw on a condition given nothing, at least 2^j at its j-th step, needs a starting level with 2^n ≤ level + 1; so cohorts of takers that at least double, each member drawing a unit, last at most log₂(level + 1) cohorts. The stock alone decides neither fate. The verdict is on the line from before the step the excess reaches, at the kind grain, where its reach so depends; it does not say that nothing of the kind stands later.

edge.en: From the same stock s ≥ 1, a relay with no excess generates and a run-down degenerates (a witness).
A renewer giving from no listed condition and requiring none, with nothing in excess, meets none of the three premises, every formation active and supported at every step (a witness).

Drawn past by n steps of excess from a stock below n + m, a line so renewed degenerates the same, while the renewer's own line can go on (a witness with offspring numbers supplied, where the coupled gate fails at every need).
Without dissipation a lossless relay keeps a lineage going within a family of stock one: dissipation is needed (a witness).

condition.en: n steps of a family's uptake above its replenishment from a stock below n + m; at need one the horizon is the stock.

Cohorts of takers that at least double, each member drawing a unit, on a condition given nothing, last at most log₂(level + 1) cohorts; and, where each active member takes from the condition and no cohort lists a member twice, where level + 1 < 2^n not every member of the first n stays active.

Over cohorts of descent within a family balanced and dissipated on at each step, a lineage reproduces at most the starting stock many steps and then ends; read by offspring number, a lineage that reproduced at its first step within such a family has a step, before the stock runs out, at which transmission lowered offspring number by more than selection and what transmission raised.

open.en: That every decider of a lineage's region is one of the three regimes: the classification is of these three laws.
That a regime is needed for an end: in the run-down nothing is active at its last step, which ends the line by itself.
Which member of the takers' cohorts stops, and at which step: naming one asks to decide activity.
That any actual flow meets the premises.
That formations drawn past renewal from outside stay ended: without the gate one inactive at the step the excess reaches can be active again; the verdict is on the line from before that step.
That multiplying takers degenerate on the map in general: the witness reads it, through the horizon law.
Where something flows into the family from outside, the bounds read only its stock and what flows in; whether actual lineages lie within such families is an application question.

name.en: The ends of drift absorb; fixation, with and without selection in the draw

mechanism.en: Counts of two kinds, counting weighing histories and supposing no chance of the unfolding. Constant N ≥ 2, each cohort N draws from the last (neutral Wright-Fisher): summed over the histories the final count is its start times the whole weight, so drift has no direction; the ends absorb; with r + 2 = N^N the histories still mixed after k cohorts weigh at most r^k of (N^N)^k, and those fixing the first kind weigh, times N, at most h·(N^N)^k and with N·r^k at least that: finite weighted bounds, whose reading is that the fixing share tends to h/N. Replacement one at a time among M + 1, only the steps that change the count read (the jump chain of the Moran process), up with weight a and down with b, a population of one kind staying: with r + a^(M+1) = (a + b)^(M+1) the fixing histories over m rounds are bounded within r^m of the potential at the start over the potential at the top, times the whole weight; for positive a the share so tends to that ratio, the starting share where a = b, strictly above it from every mixed start where b < a, the favoured kind lost with weight at least b^i times every later history. One draw from listed offspring (not a course of samplings): the samplings undoing a step's rise weigh at most a share falling as 1/n and at least q^n.

condition.en: Where a listed step raised the share by the gap g = Np − (p + q)h, the samplings falling back to h/N or below weigh, times n²g², at most N²npq(p + q)ⁿ, and at least qⁿ: undoing selection is rare in large samples and, with q positive, never ruled out.
The favoured kind is lost from i with weight at least b^i times every later history.

open.en: Which history happens: counting weighs histories and supposes no chance of the unfolding.
The time to fixation: the rate r/N^N is crude (it uses only the samplings of one kind alone), so the time is bounded, not stated.
Selection or mutation in the draw, more than two kinds, and a changing population size are not stated; with selection the fixing share is not the starting share.
Selection in sampled generations (Wright-Fisher with selection), where the fixation share has no closed count.
Weights that depend on more than the count, such as on time or the history, and mutation with drift.
Fixation and loss over many sampled generations (a course of samplings each drawn from the last), drift and selection in one draw, more than two kinds, and mutation are not stated.
Wright–Fisher with selection; mutation both ways and with drift; convergence to the mutation–selection balance.

name.en: The ends of a rule rebuilt from its members: no holder, and the end, do not return

mechanism.en: In one rule's family of nets (whole units, a level the members draw on, holders and others by cohort), where the level is 0, or the take exceeds the level and the renewal g, the level goes to 0 and all members leave; nothing renews from empty. Every take condition turns on that clause: let only the excess leave, and they fail. Taught by members or not at all, no holder stays no holder under the whole net (every sequence of entrants and revisions), a revision does not take, and two such states differing only in quota have the same later levels and members. At every source the end, level zero with no member, is closed under the net. Taught by members, holders of at most s cohorts: at s ≤ l, or at a quota of 0 with no revision to a nonzero one, no holder is left after s steps, from every level; a revision to 0 where a holder stands has the same end. A family with a constant take of the renewal plus d, d at least one, closed under the steps that do not end, falls by d a step and ends. It is one minimal model of one kind, a rule of entry; holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation into one count. The member taught by members read as an institution is a reading [AI reading, new].

edge.en: With no holder and no other, a quota of at least one, a level of at least one and a tenure of at least one, entrants on offer: where the rule is taught from outside it has holders after one step; taught by members or not at all it does not. Only that member of the family has holders after one step: it is another rule of the family, not a course out of a net taught by members. Nothing leaves the end, level zero with no member, at any source.

condition.en: Taught by members, holders of at most s cohorts: at s ≤ l, or at a quota of 0 with no revision to a nonzero one, no holder is left after s steps, entrants on offer or not, from every level.

A family with a constant take of A, closed under the steps that do not end: where A is at most the renewal the level does not fall from a level of at least one; where A is the renewal plus d, the level falls by d a step and the family ends in level zero with no member.

open.en: A classification of the ends; laws for states with gaps at l < s − 1; the interval of quotas the band solves to; a bridge to the joint excess of Flow, whose form step 1 has and which no law here uses.
That any actual institution meets these hypotheses, or that this is what an institution is: it is one minimal model of one kind, a rule of entry.
That the rule saves or ends a level as a cause: the two states compared are started separately, and open entry is not reached from the steady state by this course.

name.en: A reader rebuilt from the level it reads: its end does not come back

mechanism.en: In one rule's family of readers (a level in whole units, a reader as a list of units by age, the supply chosen at every step, so every sequence of on and off is a course), where the rebuild draws on the level: where the reader ends, the level is empty, and that state is closed under the net, the supply on or off. While supplied, at least one unit wanted and a set level of at least one, a present reader is present after a supplied step from every level. Under a cut it is present after k + 1 steps from every level of at least 2 (k + 1). A reader rebuilt from the supply, and one never rebuilt, are gone after their span from every level, so their stock buys nothing. Over the four members, with at least one unit wanted and a span of at least one, the stock buys time under a cut, with an end from an empty stock, exactly where the rebuild draws on the level. That the reader rebuilt from the level ends under a cut from every stock is not shown; that the model describes a cell is not shown.

declarations: Becoming.ReaderRebuilding.«以储买时当且仅当取于储»

edge.en: Only where the rule's source differs: a reader rebuilt from the supply is present again after one supplied step, from every level. Nothing returns the reader rebuilt from the level, on any branch.

condition.en: Under a cut, the reader rebuilt from the level is present after k + 1 steps from every level of at least 2 (k + 1); a reader rebuilt from the supply, and one never rebuilt, are gone after their span from every level.

open.en: That the reader rebuilt from the level ends under a cut from every stock, or that its horizon never decreases in the stock.
That each further s + 1 units of stock buy s steps for one unit at every span: decided at spans two and three for small levels only.
That the model describes a cell, or meets closure of constraints, autopoiesis or closure to efficient causation, each of which asks more.

name.en: What ungated steps keep; an empty pool stays empty

mechanism.en: For every process, gate on moves and quantity, the quantity is kept along every ungated course exactly when every ungated step keeps it. Where the ungated steps preserve a property, a course from where it holds to where it fails contains a gated move; where they reflect it, a course ending where it holds started where it held, or splits at a gated step after which it holds; nothing about the property is decided, the gate is. A gate locates where change can enter a line and shows neither that a gated move changes anything nor, without the property decided, the first gated step at which it comes to hold. One declared finite protocol, an instance: only adoption is gated, so every non-adopting history inherits the rule; the seed rule, its recognition, proposals, participation and the amendment procedure are supplied, and a copied rule with no one continuing to take part cannot operate. Periphery, propext and Quot.sound, an instance: in a model of recipes and reactions, where every admitted recipe is closed, an empty pool stays empty; closure is a checked property of the admitted recipes, not a law of chemistry, and no correspondence to chemistry is shown.

edge.en: Where the ungated steps preserve p, a course from where p holds to where it fails contains a gated move.
Where every ungated step keeps the quantity and its values have decidable equality, a course that changes it splits into a prefix keeping it, a gated step that itself changes it, and the rest.

open.en: That a gated move changes anything: the gate only locates where change or origin can enter.
That LivingOrganization's recipes, admitted reactions and selected pool correspond to any actual chemistry: closure is a checked property of the admitted recipes, not a law of all chemistry.
The connection is conditional, within one declared finite protocol.

The forming of proposals, the origin of the highest authority, actual compliance with procedure, an advantage in propagation across a population and an ethical warrant do not follow from the protocol.

name.en: Groups with less leave nothing; groups on one family end together

mechanism.en: Where every group with less of an amount leaves no offspring, nothing is discordant among groups, so the whole selects for it exactly where k times the within-group discordance is below k times the within-group concordance with the concordance among groups (groups of equal size). World: a member depending at a need of at least m on a condition whose gated renewal ran into joint excess leaves no descendant from then on (only active formations giving, activity needing support, balance, the gate, n steps of excess from below n + m); a cohort none of whose members is active leaves no next cohort, so one condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them. Groups depending on one family that ran into excess end together, nothing selected among them: ending selects only between families. A patch renewed by a neighbour shows no excess read alone and both end read as one: the scope prediction of the commons test with gated renewal, which tests the identification, not the dynamics. With the other group ended, a groupmate leaving five against one holding back leaving one makes the whole select against holding back (a witness): ending among groups does not decide the whole. A ranking of these ends needs C or a premise in its place.

open.en: Which group's condition runs into joint excess, or why: it is a hypothesis wherever it enters, as is that members depend on their own group's condition.

Mixed groups and inexact transmission: there selection within the surviving groups enters and can outweigh (Outweighs); mixing between groups is not stated (groups whose conditions are coupled: record groups-whose-conditions-are-coupled).
How groups form, or that keeping a condition is better: ending is read in the counts; ranking goes through the comparison C or a premise in its place.
That learners in a commons run into family excess: the commons test measured it; here it is supposed.

name.en: Draining: below a drained level no history lasts

mechanism.en: For every law with admissible disturbances and every family of levels its steps drain, from a start below level n no admissible history satisfies the guard at every step through n, and being at level n does not suffice. Market instance (periphery, propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice reported), under the original rational laws and floor 5, initial share and quality in [0, 1], β and quality error varying arbitrarily each step, nonnegative support shocks and no injection, entry or change of expansion: for every rational C₀ ≥ 5 and integer N > C₀ − 5, every positive seed 0 < x₀ ≤ (2/3)^N/6 fails by step N on every admissible schedule. It is a conservative obstruction, not an exact viability boundary; finite stock alone does not force it (with no shock the same stock carries the state of share 1, quality 1 and influence 0, a witness). Projection and full history differ: a state can land under the β = 0 rescue with its support coordinate omitted while its full guarded pulse history stops.

edge.en: With β = 0 actually holding during the pulse, then β = 1/2, extra support consumption κ ≥ 0 a step and no other shocks, each positive state has a horizon N at which initial support at least K_N carries it through a finite correction into the original protection; no single N serves every positive share. Sufficient hypotheses, not least; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings.

For every law with admissible disturbances and a guard, a start lasts n steps exactly when some ladder holds it at level n (levels within the guard, every admissible step from level k + 1 landing at level k).

condition.en: A guarded run of a physical pair with stock at least 5, nonnegative support shocks and share times (3/2)^N at most 1/6 lasting N steps needs stock at least 5 + N.

open.en: The interval 0 < x₀ ≤ (2/3)^N/6 is a conservative obstruction, not shown to be an exact viability boundary.
The obstruction holds without injection, entry or change of expansion; actual provision, change of dependence, entry or faster formation may move it.
No bifurcation, R-tipping classification or physical death follows from the obstruction.

name.en: Four routes of transition, none a proved phase transition

mechanism.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; of the boundary and attraction results of the market model, family B's market-model-share-margin-and-ends], in 05's words: "At the original parameters with M < 0 a distinct protected region remains: a negative margin says a degenerate region can appear, not that every history enters it. Four routes of transition are distinct, none a proved phase transition: a parameter change removing a region's retention, a shock into another retained region, a failure stopping correction, and change too fast for correction. Attraction is not continuation: a selection absorbing perturbations can still erode its support, and a lost capacity needs actual entry, which the share law lacks. A real loss need not form a meta-attractor, and withdrawing one practice does not end the returning relation."

condition.en: A parameter change removing a region's retention.
A shock into another retained region.
A failure stopping correction.
Change too fast for correction.

name.en: Slowing down before a condition's own end

mechanism.en: Periphery, Mathlib (propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice); discrete steps, one variable linearized about a rest, deviation and noise independent with finite second moments. A deviation stepping by multiplier a plus noise has, where its variance is the same across the step (stationarity supplied), variance Var E/(1 − a²) where a² < 1, and lag-1 autocorrelation a where that stationary variance is positive. At a fold, and at a transcritical end under a proportional draw, a rises to one as the margin shrinks (step length and noise variance positive), so the margin to a condition's own end couples into its fluctuations. Critical slowing down (Wissel 1984; Scheffer and others 2009); nonlinear runs, finite windows and several variables are not treated.

forbids.en: Given the stock's own course, its early-warning statistics separating runs in which a dependent's need is crossed from runs in which it is not, the dependent taking no measurable share (Thesis T6).

condition.en: Variance Var E/(1 − a²) and lag-1 autocorrelation a, with a rising to one as the margin shrinks at a fold (a = 1 − 2h√m) or a transcritical end under a proportional draw (a = 1 − h(r − q)).

open.en: That a run of the nonlinear step stays near its rest, or reaches the stationary variance; that finite rolling-window estimates converge to the stationary values; the error of the linearization near the fold, where the basin narrows.
Red noise, several variables (where the critical mode loads on some only), flickering, noise-induced transitions, and regime shifts with no bifurcation.

That actual dependents leave their stock's law unchanged as they near their needs: the need's not being read holds by construction, and its content in the world is the premise of negligible feedback, measured apart by the field tests.

beyond.en: A dependent's need enters neither statistic, by construction: no one function of the multiplier returns the margin to a need for every need.

name.en: A reserve defers the end

mechanism.en: A reserve does not rise while its formation is unsupported and falls where it is active then (a representational premise); the zero reserve is exactly activity needing support; a held condition can be one (a fox burning its fat). With its activity decided at each step, a formation unsupported from some step on is active over any later stretch at most as often as its reserve. Where the reserve also decays (a further premise), dormancy is bounded, and along a chain of embodied links, each requiring the one before at a positive need from T on with the first ended from T, coextinction runs down the chain link by link; without decay each link ends given excluded middle, with no bound, and a last active step for every never-supported formation with a reserve gives LPO. The laws bind a formation unsupported from some step on, not whether support returns.

condition.en: Where the reserve decays, a formation unsupported from some step on is not active once as many steps have passed as its reserve.

open.en: The conclusions bind a formation unsupported from some step on, not whether support returns: a reserve that bridges to returning support can carry activity without end.
Under a carried reserve dormancy uses no reserve, and the time of dormancy is bounded only under the further premise that the reserve decays.
Without decay a link's end step has no bound: excluded middle gives only that each link ends, and without it an end step implies omniscience (LPO) in general, so the core does not state it.
Over a horizon under noise, whether a set point on later states makes reserves worth holding, so that a rising drive on stores returns.

name.en: Dormancy over a stretch, and an ending that is final

mechanism.en: Bounded dormancy needs its premises only over the stretch: carried, decaying and unsupported across the n steps from S, a reserve has fallen by n or been spent, and with a reserve at S of at most n the formation is inactive at S + n with its reserve spent. An ending that is final stays whatever support returns: where from U on a formation inactive with its reserve spent neither arises nor regains a reserve, one inactive and spent at U is inactive at every later step. Finality is a separate premise; exhaustion alone does not give it. With it, support returning after the reserve is spent finds no dependent. A reserve spanning the gap bridges it (a witness).

edge.en: Unsupported at the first three steps and supported from step three on, a formation with a reserve of three, falling by one at each unsupported step, is active at every step: support returning within the reserve finds it (a witness).

condition.en: Carried, decaying and unsupported across the steps from S to S + n, with a reserve at S of at most n: inactive at S + n with the reserve spent; with an ending final from S + n on, inactive at every step from S + n on, support restored after the reserve is spent restoring nothing.

open.en: That ending is final for actual dependents.

name.en: The market model's share, margin and ends

mechanism.en: Periphery: the market model, propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice reported; rational states and parameters, supplied laws. For a share strictly between none and all and a positive selection rate, the renewing share rises where the collectible exposure exceeds the private threshold (the private advantage is positive); in the model's numbers a share of none stays none (a witness): selection does not create an absent practice. With M = α(1 − θ) − βλθ, for α, β ≥ 0, α + β ≤ 1, 0 ≤ λ ≤ 1 and 0 < θ ≤ 1, the floor is kept at the next step, with correction paid and no error in q, from every level θ ≤ q ≤ 1 and influence 0 ≤ w ≤ λ, exactly where M ≥ 0. At β = 1/2 in the original family the maintenance end and the depletion end each attract a neighbourhood, the interior point has arbitrarily small perturbations that leave, and coupled to the essential support the low end fails in finite time even with correction paid at every step. A negative margin gives a low region, not entry into it. An equation-identical conventional controller predicts the same.

edge.en: The floor is kept at the next step, with correction paid and no error in q, from every level θ ≤ q ≤ 1 under every influence 0 ≤ w ≤ λ exactly where M = α(1 − θ) − βλθ ≥ 0.
From the box about the maintenance end, with stock at least 5, the guarded history never fails, in the original example at β = 1/2 with no shocks.

condition.en: For α, β ≥ 0, α + β ≤ 1, 0 ≤ λ ≤ 1 and 0 < θ ≤ 1, the floor is kept at the next step, with correction paid and no error in q, from every level θ ≤ q ≤ 1 and influence 0 ≤ w ≤ λ, exactly where M ≥ 0; for α > 0, β ≥ 0, 0 ≤ λ ≤ 1 and 0 < θ < 1, the low-selection certificate exists exactly where M < 0.

open.en: That an actual market meets the model: parameters, laws and correspondence are supplied.
That a negative margin sends every history to the depleting end: it gives a low region, not entry into it.
That states leaving the interior state stay away: some move away at some step, which is not shown to last.
A full basin, a stability classification for every β, a real-valued extension, a bifurcation or an empirical threshold.

A discriminating study in one bounded market with measurable renewal costs and a real route of rule revision: an existing remedy against it plus a funded, accountable revision mechanism, weighed against accounts of externalities, information, institutional power and Ostrom's.

beyond.en: Attraction is not continuation: a selection absorbing perturbations can still erode its support ([AI reading, D65]); computations in the model refute overstrong readings, in the home's words: "profits coexist with support failure the next round".

name.en: Own count misses joint excess

mechanism.en: Formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more. In a balanced flow each step of joint excess lowers the level by at least one, so n consecutive such steps need a level of at least n at the start. Under the gate at need m (every formation giving to the condition depending on it at a need of at least m, only active formations giving, activity needing support), n consecutive steps of joint excess from a level below n + m leave the level below m for good and end every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m, a taker among them where it so depends; a taker not so depending, or at a lower need, can continue. A local form needs balance only at the condition across the steps used. The conclusions after the step the excess reaches are proved only for renewal depending on what it renews. Natural-number amounts, totals at each step; near-definitional arithmetic restating the tragedy of the commons and overshoot.

edge.en: In a balanced flow, taking jointly within what is given keeps the level.
Under balance, with a division of the take by exclusive footprints at every step, the level never falls below its start; that an actual division is by exclusive footprints is not shown.
With one taker the same renewer keeps the level and both are active at every step, where in Exceeding two takers end themselves and their renewer.
A formation renewed from outside can be active again: in Restored a renewer that requires nothing gives at the race's end, and the renewal restores the part from the next step on.

open.en: The gated conclusions after the step the excess reaches are proved only for renewal that depends on what it renews; at that step the end holds for any renewal, and a formation renewed from outside can be active again.
Stated for natural-number amounts; excess compares totals at each step and treats neither reserves nor delayed renewal.
Exceeding and Alone are minimal witnesses; Exceeding's ending is stipulated in its activity and shown consistent with the laws.
The joint count binds only a want that outlasts what the condition holds, and a taker ends with it only where it depends at such a need.
It does not say which taker ought to take less.

beyond.en: A taker not depending on the condition, or depending at a lower need, can continue while the renewal and those depending at such a need end. Which part makes the difference to such a loss is joint-difference-making's.

name.en: A loss made only together

mechanism.en: Any process; withholding a supplied map on configurations; the move taken held fixed. A part makes the difference where the step by the move taken breaks a dependence and, the part withheld, the same move can be taken and every step by it keeps it. Where the move determines the step and, any single member's part withheld, can be taken with the dependence holding and met, the parts make the difference together while no member alone does exactly where they make it together and withholding any one leaves the same move breaking it. In the witness Pool, with two other drawers the loss is overdetermined: the first drawer's part makes no difference, the first two make it only together, and the whole-run relational reading still counts the first drawer as consuming. Across one formation's own events, in the renewable witness (one unit renewed a step), two units drawn at every step consume the condition; with any one event's draw, or every draw before any step, withheld, it is still consumed: the tail fixes the run-level outcome, while the breaking event makes the step-level difference. It yields no causal theory, responsibility, duty or ranking.

edge.en: In Pool, withholding the first two drawers' parts together keeps the dependence where withholding either alone leaves the same move breaking it.
At the breaking step of the renewable witness, drawing nothing from the same configuration keeps the dependence: a step-level statement, which leaves the run-level outcome to the tail.

open.en: Yields no responsibility, duty or ranking.
Proposes no causal theory; finer attribution (the NESS test, actual causation in structural equations) is not added.
The stepwise reading does not track difference-making: in Pool a drawer taking exactly the renewal, whose part makes no difference, undermines at the break another causes.
When withholding the part itself leaves the dependence unmet (the part is a support), the test is silent.
Pool, Shock and depleting are minimal witnesses.
How, under overdetermination, the judgment that a joint activity consumes reaches each participant.

beyond.en: Under overdetermination, but-for and participation come apart: in Pool a drawer's part makes no difference, yet the relational reading counts it as consuming. In the renewable witness no finite set of a formation's own events makes the run-level difference.

name.en: The rest outruns the renewal

mechanism.en: Where the other members alone (the rest, listed without repetition) take from a condition jointly more than a step gives at each of n steps, from a level below n + m, under balance, activity needing support, only active giving and the gate at need m, the level stays below m from then on and every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m ends, whatever a member outside the rest takes. With need one, in two such flows from a level at most n, every score that reads the condition only from the rest's end on scores them alike, however the member's act differs: no weight on such a reading selects the member's restraint. The laws hold course by course in natural-number amounts; they say where a reading cannot see restraint, not that seeing it is owed, and depletion need not be the only equilibrium (an equilibrium here is the field's frame).

open.en: That depletion is the only equilibrium: where the rest outruns, restraint by all may also be one; what learners reach is a claim about learning, tested in CG2 and EM1, not a theorem.
Anything about stochastic regrowth: the laws hold course by course; whether the rest outruns in a stochastic environment is computed (exact best responses), not proved.
That restraint is better: the laws say where a reading cannot see it, not that seeing it is owed.

beyond.en: Where the rest outruns a renewal gated at m, from a level below n + m, whatever a member outside the rest takes, the level stays below m from then on and every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m ends. With need one, in two such flows every score that reads the condition only from the rest's end on scores them alike, however the member's act differs.

name.en: What taking all that is given excludes

mechanism.en: A formation takes all that is given across a step where it takes from the condition at least all that the step gives it; alongside it any other taker makes the joint taking exceed what is given, so where renewal depends on what it renews, full taking alongside another taker at each of n steps from a level below n + m ends every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m, the full taker included. Where a formation takes all that is given at every step, depends on the condition at a need of at least m at every step and is active at every step, then for any step T and any named other formation, not at every one of the level + 1 steps from T is that formation present and taking. A formation active only while it takes, whose activity does not resume after T once it stops, is inactive from T plus the level at T on. In the excluding and sharing witnesses the levels admit every member alike at every step: exclusion acts through the taking, not the levels.

edge.en: Taking jointly within what is given at every step keeps the level, and every formation depending on that condition alone at a need met at the start stays supported.

Of a renewer giving two units across each step and two takers at need one, where each takes one, all three are supported and active at every step and neither takes all that is given, so the law needs its premise of full taking.

open.en: Endings forced in the witnesses of section 6.3 (Downstream, Mortal, Clearing) by quantifying over activity: there they stay stipulated; here an ending is derived only for a formation living by taking.
How taking all that is given forms (through what it gains, a stronger case of the meta-attractor); reserves and delayed renewal; shares beyond the witnesses.
Which course is to be taken: the excluding and the sharing course are not ranked, and the extent derived from the first's want does not separate them.

beyond.en: In the excluding and sharing witnesses the levels admit every member alike at every step: exclusion acts through the taking, not the levels.

name.en: What an optimum does beyond what couples in

mechanism.en: An optimum here is that field's frame: an eligible outcome no eligible outcome ranks above under a supplied order, taken over any supplied set of eligible outcomes. One step. Every order rising with a family has its optima at the least level beyond, condition by condition, among the eligible outcomes, exactly where no eligible outcome standing above another at a condition beyond goes unbeaten on the family; so with room every optimum is there, and, with equality of conditions decided, the beyond apart from the family and the family holding a condition, shared units (outcomes closed under moving a unit from beyond into the family) give room. A lexicographic order counting the beyond after what couples in drains all the same. With room, on a web (World) with each condition beyond depended on at a need met at the step, every optimum breaks exactly the dependences beyond that some eligible outcome breaks. Room is a premise; over one step of exchange (World) it holds where a part's members take at most their capacity and give at most what they take, the rest exchanging as it does, and every optimum stands beyond at what the rest leaves less the capacity, or at nothing. The core asserts none of this of an actual optimizer.

forbids.en: T3 (the law for optima proved; the clause on trained systems conjectured, with partial support), with eligible outcomes, couplings and reward fixed and the optimality gap measured: a system nearer its reward's optimum leaving a room-giving condition beyond its couplings higher, on average, than one further from it; a systematic drive on a choice whose values nothing rewarded and nothing the learner reads tells apart; where room exists, a side-effect term ranked after the reward protecting a condition, or a constraint at the need leaving a margin above it; an instruction that does not bring a dependent into what the learners couple into, yet keeps it more often than the same learners without the instruction. The second case is proved in expectation (Weighted.Commutes.start_expect, on any type, the expectation at every step equal to its image's) for learners that the exchange of the choice's two values carries, from a starting state or law the exchange leaves unchanged; from a start preferring one value it stays conjectured. It was first worded for any condition sharing no units with anything rewarded; so worded it fails for the separable family's exact expected update where the learner reads the condition: with the bay's fish uncounted, the bay rises. The side-effect clause concerns rewards rising with what they read.

edge.en: Restricted to outcomes keeping every dependence beyond, with room among them, each need attained by some such outcome, balance, and the family with the beyond gaining nothing, every optimum breaks none of them, and the family's stock after the step with what the whole loses is its stock before with the slack.

Room binds: without it keeping can be an optimum. Spilling: two outcomes, the source kept or spilled with the store empty in both; under the store's order keeping is an optimum and is not at the least level beyond.
An order rising only to a target has both the keeping and the ending outcome among its optima.

condition.en: Over one step of exchange, where the levels after are an optimum, among the outcomes open to a part, of an order rising with the family, and each condition beyond is depended on at a need it meets, a dependence breaks exactly where its need exceeds what the rest leaves less the part's capacity (or nothing).

open.en: Room derived from a law of exchange: which outcomes an actor's takes and gives make eligible, with the rest responding, is not stated here; room is a hypothesis (derived for one step in room-read-off-the-exchange, SG2).

Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell's continuous setting and compactness characterization, the non-convergent case and converse of their Theorem 2, their sensitivities, and the gain an updated proxy brings to a principal's utility are not reached.
The bound's converse is near-definitional and not theirs: it ranges over every eligible set with room, a single outcome among them, where theirs fixes the world and builds a proxy and a path.

That the beyond's fall is a harm, or that keeping is better: no evaluation enters; that a widening move is chosen is the conditional direction's (alignment-direction-under-widening), under C and the continuation condition.
Without room the drive fails: keeping can be an optimum (Optimum.Drain.room_needed); and an order rising only to a target need not drive or keep (Optimum.Drain.satisficing_either).
A course of steps: an optimizer choosing again at each step, the levels before moving with it, and a rest responding to the part (the pool laws) are not stated.
Capacities enter as supplied amounts, as the levels before do; a member giving only to some listed conditions lies outside the outcomes stated.
That the drain is a harm, or that a smaller capacity is better: no evaluation enters.
Where the eligible outcomes are supplied otherwise, room can fail and the drive with it (Optimum.Drain.room_needed).
Whether the drain in actual trained systems lies where room lies (T3's clause on trained systems).
The improvement of a principal's utility is not reached; it needs a ranking of courses, so C or a premise in its place.
That a choice the learner reads, though nothing rewards it, goes undriven: in LA4's exact flow an uncounted bay the policy reads rises.
That a given learner commutes: its parametrization, baseline, optimizer and inputs are properties of its code, which LA4's mirror test checks.
Anything of a single run: in Reinforcing, runs drawing one value for any number of steps have positive weight while the expectations stay equal.
What a learner does from a start preferring one value, or that noise wears such a preference away beyond the Pooling witness.

beyond.en: With room, every optimum of a rising order stands at the least level beyond among the eligible outcomes and breaks exactly the dependences beyond that some eligible outcome breaks; where activity needs support and a broken dependence persists at a need no weaker, its formation is not active after the step.

name.en: An order with a set point

mechanism.en: An order is nearing where it ranks above every nearer outcome: strictly single-peaked at the set point condition by condition, each peak not depending on the others. Where the family holds a condition no asymmetric nearing order is rising. Below the set point it rises: among outcomes up to the set point its optima stand at the least level beyond exactly where room holds there. Where an eligible outcome reaches the set point every optimum stands at it, whatever the room; the class asks nothing of what lies beyond. In a balanced step in which the whole gains nothing (World), the beyond then falls by the family's shortfall from its set point with what the step loses. Several nearing optimizers draw their joint shortfall as one with their joint set point.
