Over n steps, formations alone with their families, holding their stocks, their losses together above what the rest gives a gated condition at each step, from a level below n + m, end it however small each loss; no order or choice enters that law. What protects the beyond at the set point is the choice among equal optima, which no law here models. An optimum is that field's frame, taken over supplied eligible outcomes.

edge.en: A term on what lies beyond counted after the set point: with one condition beyond it keeps a need exactly where some way of reaching the set point keeps it; with several it can empty one (Spread.counted_after_empties); counting less, it drains (Topped.counted_less_drains).
In the exchange witness, trading the source at any positive weight against the store's gap, every optimum meets the need.
Counted after an aspiration level it keeps as well: the plateau decides, not the set point.

condition.en: In a balanced step in which the family with the one condition beyond gains nothing and the family stands at its set point after it, the dependence met at the step breaks exactly where the set point's total with the loss exceeds the family before with the slack.

open.en: That an agent's preferences form a nearing order: they do where strictly single-peaked at each observed condition, each peak independent; a tolerance band around the set point is not one, nor is a best level depending on other conditions.
Any probability, surprisal, expected free energy or precision: active inference's preferences, prior beliefs over outcomes, are read as a nearing order at the high-precision limit.

That a set point protects what lies beyond: in a witness where a step can lose what it takes, the order by distance has the draining step among its optima beside the keeping one; what protects is the choice among equal optima.
The quantilizer bound: a choice drawn from a base distribution over the ways of reaching the set point would inherit it (Taylor 2016); that is a reading, not proved here.

Anything over a horizon or under noise: every law is of one step or of supplied courses, and deterministic; under noise a set point on later states makes reserves worth holding, so a rising drive on stores can return.
Which optimum is taken where several stand at the set point; the optima where none reaches it and some stand above, or in an exchange at or above it beyond the witnesses.

Conflicting set points, or optimizers read off an exchange: several share one set point, their eligible outcomes supplied; terms counted after are lexicographic, a weighted term trading against the set point (Topped.weighted_keeps).
That the beyond's fall is a harm, or that keeping is better: no evaluation enters; ranking courses needs C or a premise in its place.

For orders with a set point: which optimum is taken where several reach the set point, which decides keeping wherever a step can lose what it takes; conflicting set points on a shared condition; a weighted term traded against the set point; several nearing optimizers read off an exchange; and, over a horizon under noise, whether a set point on later states makes reserves worth holding, so that a rising drive on stores returns.

beyond.en: At the set point the class asks nothing of what lies beyond; in a witness, where a step can lose what it takes, the order by distance has the draining step among its optima beside the keeping one. Among the outcomes open to a part, every optimum standing below its set point takes the part's whole capacity beyond, where every rising optimum stands.

name.en: Others drawing first end the base

mechanism.en: A named model: any law G of what stands, natural amounts and weights; the breaks on the World. A level z at the step from t gives G t z to be drawn at the next, and the draw of the step from t is weighted by w t. A course gaining the most against every open course and leaving nothing is an optimum (of that weighted draw, that field's frame, over the open courses), and every optimum of every order rising with the weighted draw stands below a need above every level of greatest gain, breaking at the first step a dependence there met at the start. Where others first draw from what an optimizer leaves, leaving K t z, and what stands for it, K t z + R (K t z), is at most the level, with a capacity covering what stands at the start and at nothing, over a horizon of at least two steps, every optimum of every order whose weighting falls at every step, however slightly, ends the stock at once and breaks every dependence on it with a positive need met at the start. The others' rule is supplied. In a witness: the discrete form of open access dissipating what a sole owner would keep (Gordon 1954).

edge.en: Where nothing stands at nothing and some level within reach rises faster than the weighting falls, with what stands at it at least it and a capacity drawing down to it and holding it, no optimum ends the base at once.

From a start at or below y, where what stands rises with the level below y and is at least y at y, and the weighted gain rises strictly up to y and is greatest there, with a capacity covering what stands at y and at nothing, every optimum follows the rising course below y, drawing nothing, restoring every dependence whose need it meets.

Under w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1), a doubling source is rebuilt by every optimum alone and ended at once with others first drawing all but a quarter; drawing all but half, every optimum ends it under weights falling at every step, and at equal weights ending and holding at two are both optima.

open.en: That the others' rule is a best response outside drawers-in-turn's cases: in turn where two drawers have no floor, and at once with no floor where each portion returns less than one for one; nor how optimizers reach one but by revision.
Holding a level where what stands at it falls below it; an order valuing what is left at the horizon at a worth whose most left is not regrown in one step; an overcompensating renewal.
That a base ought to be kept, or that others ought not to draw: no evaluation enters; the laws say what the optima of an order do.
The optimum where a level of greatest gain is out of reach; holding a level where what stands at it falls below it; several optimizers ranking whole courses.

beyond.en: Where others first draw from what an optimizer leaves, leaving K t z, what stands for it, K t z + R (K t z), is at most the level, a capacity covers what stands at the start and at nothing, and the weighting falls at every step over a horizon of at least two steps, every optimum of every order rising with the weighted draw ends the stock at once and breaks every dependence on it with a positive need met at the start.

name.en: Several drawers: drawers in turn and at once

mechanism.en: A named model: any law G of what stands, natural amounts; the breaks on the World. k drawers draw in turn, each leaving at least its floor; a profile is perfect where every drawer's rule is a best response (that field's frame, among what it may leave, over the steps that remain) at every step from every level. What a best response keeps above its floor returns to it at least one for one, so a drawer draws to its floor wherever what it draws later does not depend on what it leaves, and every drawer does at the last step. Where two drawers have no floor, whatever the others' floors, every perfect profile is the floor profile, which is perfect, and every sequence of revisions from any profile reaches it; with no floor anywhere that is drawing everything, and a dependence above what stands at nothing breaks at the first step. Drawing at once from portions, with no floor, where each portion returns less than one for one on what its drawer leaves, every perfect profile and every revision draws everything. Revision that is not a best response is not stated.

edge.en: Drawing at once with no floor, drawing everything is perfect exactly where, at every step before the last and with the others drawing everything, no portion of what stands next returns more than one for one on what its drawer alone leaves. Which profiles are perfect where the drain is not is not shown.
For one drawer given the whole, draining is perfect exactly where the whole never returns more than one for one.
A floor on the other's draw can keep the stock: under doubling with a one-unit floor on the second, the first leaves everything from three and the dweller is kept.

condition.en: Drawing at once with no floor, drawing everything is perfect exactly where, at every step before the last and with the others drawing everything, no portion of what stands next returns more than one for one on what its drawer alone leaves.

open.en: Drawing at once, which profiles are perfect where some portion returns more than one for one, and whether every perfect profile of the halves draws each drawer less than holding; which profiles are perfect where at most one drawer has no floor, away from the last step.
Revision that is not a best response: noisy, partial or local learning.
That the drain is a harm or restraint better: no evaluation enters; the laws say what profiles do.
Revision that is not a best response; perfect profiles drawing at once where some portion returns more than one for one.

beyond.en: Where each portion returns less than one for one, along no profile does any drawer draw more than where all draw everything, and what the drain breaks lies beyond every drawer. With two drawers sharing by halves the drain is still perfect while holding the level draws each more over a long horizon.

name.en: Coupled for each step

mechanism.en: A named model: any law G of what stands next, natural amounts; the gate for keeping. Each drawer counts, besides what it draws over the steps that remain, c for each step at which what all the drawers leave meets a positive need m, nothing valued after the horizon; perfect is a best response, that field's frame, at every step from every amount. In turn, with two drawers or more and no floor, where c < m every perfect profile has every drawer leave nothing at every step before the horizon, from every amount, whatever G, and where c ≤ m drawing everything is perfect. On a gated renewal the threshold is the need itself, not the renewal forgone nor the joint capacity. There, where c < m and 0 < c + q, one drawer over two steps keeps the need at the first step where two drawers or more in turn drain it: among drawers ranking the steps that remain, several in turn do not draw as one drawer would. Drawing at once, where no portion reaches the need and none returns more than one for one, drawing everything is perfect at every c: no drawer is pivotal (Palfrey and Rosenthal 1984).

edge.en: With two drawers or more and no floor, under the gate (below the need what stands next is below it, at or above it what stands next meets it, and what stands next from nothing, with the need, is at most what stands next from the need), where m < c every perfect profile has each drawer leave exactly the need of an amount meeting it and nothing of a smaller one, and from a start meeting the need it is met at every step to the horizon.

condition.en: With two drawers or more in turn and no floor, on the gated renewal, for every q: where c < m every perfect profile drains at every step; where c ≤ m drawing everything is perfect; where m ≤ c keeping the need is perfect; where m < c every perfect profile keeps exactly the need, and from a start meeting it it is met at every step; both profiles are perfect at c = m.

open.en: The keeping side without the gate, where a level below the need can regrow past it, one meeting it can fall below it, or what stands next from nothing with the need exceeds what stands next from the need.

Which profiles are perfect drawing at once where the drain is not, where several drawers can each meet the need, where free riding may admit many; nor that the drain is the only perfect profile of the two shores.
That one drawer in turn corresponds to one optimizer ranking whole courses: the comparison with that law crosses two models, and only the two-step contrast is inside one.
That the need ought to be kept or a coupling set: no evaluation enters; the laws say which profiles a coupling leaves perfect.

beyond.en: In turn, with two drawers or more and no floor and a positive need, whatever the renewal, every perfect profile leaves nothing at every step before the horizon where the coupling a step is below the need. Drawing at once, where no portion reaches the need and none returns more than one for one, drawing everything is perfect at every coupling; under that profile, in the two shores witness, the need is met at no step.

name.en: A race for position

mechanism.en: A named model: any law G of what stands next, natural amounts; the break on the World. k drawers draw in turn with no floor, each ranking what it leaves by its position over the steps that remain: k times its own draw against what all draw. Where its own later draw is the same, keeping lowers k times its draw by k times what it keeps and what all draw by at most once that, so among two drawers or more a best response for position (that field's frame) keeps nothing. Where what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left, and there are at least two drawers, every profile perfect for position draws everything at every step before the horizon, a dependence above what stands at nothing met at the start breaks at the first step, and drawing everything is perfect. With one drawer every profile is perfect. It does not show that actual races are so played.

edge.en: Where something left would stop what stands next, a drawer keeps it to stop it. Stopping: from nothing two stand, from anything left nothing; with two drawers over two steps every perfect profile has the second drawer keep the unit it is given at the first step, so drawing everything is not perfect.

open.en: That every race for position draws everything: where something left stops what stands next, drawing everything is not perfect.
Drawing at once ranking position, floors under a race for position, or a horizon the drawers do not know.
That actual races are played in turn by drawers ranking position alone.
That drawing everything is wrong.

[Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: a frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts coming to read themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all; which of them the laws of position, capture and joint excess admit, and under which hypotheses.

name.en: Several optimizers

mechanism.en: One step, World. At a mutual best response (that field's frame: each optimizer acting within its capacity, the levels after an optimum of its own rising order among the outcomes open to it alone, the others exchanging as they do; each optimizer's family and beyond set apart; the step balancing into the levels after), where something stands beyond an optimizer's family, it takes its whole capacity there and gives nothing: restraint is no mutual best response. A condition beyond every one's family stands at what the formations outside them leave less their joint capacity, or at nothing, as under one optimizer of that capacity. Which formations optimize, by which order and with which capacity, is supplied, and the core asserts a mutual best response of no actual group; its existence is not shown in general.

condition.en: At a mutual best response, a condition beyond every optimizer's family is lowered below where the formations outside every optimizer leave it exactly where the optimizers have some capacity there and something is left; on a web, a dependence on it met at the step breaks exactly where its need exceeds what those formations leave less the optimizers' joint capacity.

open.en: That a mutual best response exists in general: the witness has one; where the outcomes open to each depend on the others, a step may have none.

A condition within some optimizer's family, where the condition couples into its order and the classical commons with a share borne lies; a course of steps and how learners come near a mutual best response.
That the drain is a harm, or that coupling or a lower capacity is better: no evaluation enters.
That a mutual best response exists in general (no existence is shown, and none is shown to fail), or which of several self-consistent outcomes learners come to.
What each takes outside a mutual best response.

beyond.en: At a mutual best response a condition beyond every one's family stands at what the formations outside them leave less their joint capacity, or at nothing; in the witness each take is within the slack of a need while the joint draw leaves it below the need.

name.en: Re-optimizing at every step

mechanism.en: A course of steps, World: each step an optimum of the part's rising order among the outcomes open to it (that field's frame, taken step by step, not over courses), the rest exchanging as it does, or a balanced course of mutual best responses. Where the rest renews a condition beyond by exactly r a step at or above a positive need and by at most r below, and the withdrawal k (the rest's taking with the part's capacity) is the same at every step, a formation depending on it at that need at every step, met at the start, loses the dependence for good exactly where r < k, and never where k ≤ r; several optimizers whose withdrawal with the rest's exceeds r at every step lose it however small each capacity. Gated, with nothing given below the need, a draw above the renewal draws at most the start with r for each of its units, however long; ungated, with at least a and at most r given every step however low the level, at least a a step, without bound for a positive a. Where nothing is given below the need, a level below it stays below whatever is drawn, so a later re-reading restores nothing. The core asserts no course of any actual optimizer.

edge.en: From a start at the need, the condition stands at or above the need at every step exactly where the withdrawal is within the renewal, k ≤ r.
With the draw above the renewal until a step T, a re-reading from T on that keeps the need where it is met keeps it at every step exactly where it is met at T; stated on the level law alone.

Two takers of capacity one lose a source renewed by r < 2 at mutual best responses at every step; at renewal one, a restrained course, none of whose steps is a mutual best response, keeps the source at its start and after a long course holds more in the store, by the optimizer's own order.

condition.en: A dependence at the need, met at the start, is lost exactly where r < k; from a start at the need, the condition stands at or above it at every step exactly where k ≤ r.
Given exactly r at or above a positive need, at most r everywhere, and k > r drawn before T, the need is met at T exactly where the level starts at least T (k − r) above the need.

open.en: A renewal varying with the level at or above the need (logistic growth, with an interior sustained yield): the renewal here is exactly r there.

An optimizer ranking courses rather than steps (Scott's sole owner, in the fisheries literature), an equilibrium of the course rather than mutual best responses step by step, and how optimizers come to them.
A witness course of the ungated draw: its laws are general, the witness is gated.
That the loss is a harm, or that a capacity within the renewal or a coupling is better: no evaluation enters; less in the store is by the optimizer's own order.

beyond.en: Over a balanced course of mutual best responses, where the formations outside every optimizer give a condition beyond every optimizer's family at most r a step and what they take with the optimizers' joint capacity there exceeds r at every step, a dependence on it at a positive need throughout, met at the start, is lost for good, however small each capacity.

name.en: Weighting later draws less

mechanism.en: A named model: any renewal law R on natural amounts, natural weights, the breaks on the World. Over the courses open from s, where w (t + 1) (z + R z) < w t z for every positive z, with a capacity covering s + R s and R 0, over at least two steps, every optimum of every order rising with the weighted draw (that field's frame, over the open courses) stands at nothing at every step to the n-th, ending its own stock at the first step and breaking every dependence on it with a positive need met at the start; at ≤ the course ending the base at the first step is an optimum. The home reads it as the discrete form of a discount rate above the greatest rate of renewal making extinction optimal, a frame of that field. Which formation optimizes, by which order, weighting, capacity and horizon, and the renewal law are supplied; the core asserts no course of any actual optimizer.

edge.en: Where R 0 = 0 and some level y within reach renews faster than the weighting falls (w t y < w (t + 1) (y + R y) at every step), with reach and y + R y ≤ k, every optimum leaves something at the first step.

From a start s ≤ y, where z + R z rises with z up to y, the weighted gain rises strictly with the level up to y, and the weighted gain at y is at least that at every level, every optimum draws nothing while the rising level is below y, the stock regrowing, and restores every dependence whose need the rising level meets. Under an overcompensating renewal this is not shown.

Under the logistic law, from a source at two with capacity two: where 2 w (t + 1) < w t every optimum ends the source at once; where w t = 2 w (t + 1) ending and holding at one are both optima; where w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1) every optimum holds it at one and breaks the dweller.

condition.en: Where w (t + 1) (z + R z) < w t z for every positive z, every optimum ends the stock at the first step; where R 0 = 0 and some level y within reach has w t y < w (t + 1) (y + R y) at every step, every optimum leaves something at the first step.

open.en: The optimum where no course whose level gains the most at each step is open; whether an optimum ends the base after the first step where some level renews faster at the first steps.
An order valuing what is left at the horizon at a worth whose most left is not regrown in one step; several optimizers ranking courses; SG5's laws re-derived as the case of every weight one.
That a weighting ought to be flatter or a base kept: no evaluation enters; the laws say which optima a weighting leaves.
The optimum where the next level does not rise with the level below y (an overcompensating renewal) or the gain has several peaks; that the rising course is then not an optimum.

beyond.en: Where w (t + 1) (z + R z) < w t z for every positive z, with a capacity covering s + R s and R 0 and a horizon of at least two steps, every optimum ends its own stock at the first step, breaking every dependence on it with a positive need met at the start.

name.en: Courses over a horizon

mechanism.en: A named model: any renewal law R on natural amounts, at most r, the breaks on the World. What a course draws, leaves and forgoes adds to the start with r a step. Over the courses open from s, with reach and y + r ≤ k, every optimum of every order rising with the draw (that field's frame, over the open courses, no discount) holds a level of greatest renewal to the n-th step and leaves nothing: a need above every such level breaks at the first step, and one every such level meets is kept and broken at the end. With what is left valued one for one with what is drawn, every optimum stands at a level of greatest renewal at every step to the horizon, and the optima of that order are exactly the open courses doing so: keeping and draining at the end are both optima. At worth v > 1, where no open course leaves more than y + r, r ≤ k and at least two steps, every optimum holds a level of greatest renewal to the horizon and regrows only at the last step. At every such worth a dependence above every such level is broken at the first step. The core asserts no course of any actual optimizer.

edge.en: With what is left valued one for one, the optima are exactly the open courses standing at a level of greatest renewal at every step to the horizon: the drain at the end is no longer forced; keeping and draining at the end are both optima, and a dependence above every such level is still broken at the first step.

Reward each step a need stays met: where the coupling covers the renewal forgone a step and exceeds the end, every optimum keeps the dependence at every horizon. Below that coupling, a long horizon outweighs it. It is one optimizer's law, not a collective exit as it stands.

A coupling of keeping fixed in total: with r n + e < w + q n it leaves only optima keeping the dependence; with w + q n + e < r n + m only optima breaking it within the horizon; the tie is not stated.

open.en: An order valuing what is left at the horizon at a worth whose most left is not regrown in one step.
The optimum where the capacity cannot draw down to a level of greatest renewal in a step or draw everything at the last.

Below a level out of one step's reach: the optimum where the next level does not rise with the level below y (an overcompensating renewal) or the gain has several peaks; that the rising course is then not an optimum.
Several optimizers ranking courses (equilibria of the course) and how optimizers come to them.
That the loss is a harm, or that a longer horizon or a coupling is better: no evaluation enters; the order ranks only what the optimizer draws.
That valuing what is left keeps what depends on the levels passed through: a dependence above every level of greatest renewal is still broken at the first step.
Which optimum is taken: the last step's draw is left free, keeping and draining both optima.
That any terminal value keeps what depends on the levels passed through: a dependence above every level of greatest renewal is broken at the first step at every worth.
Valuing what is left where the most left is not regrown in one step; several optimizers ranking whole courses.

beyond.en: In a witness under a gate, where some level of greatest renewal meets a need and some do not, holding at the need and holding below are both optima and take the same: the order by the draw takes in nothing of the dependence. A dependence above every level of greatest renewal, met at the start, is broken at the first step at every worth on what is left.

name.en: What keeping forgoes, and a coupling against it

mechanism.en: A named model: any renewal law R on natural amounts, r the greatest renewal a step, q the greatest at or above a need m, the breaks on the World; n + 1 steps (0 < n), a start meeting m, e the end the capacity reaches. Among keeping courses every optimum (of an order rising with the draw, that field's frame, over the open keeping courses) holds where q is given and leaves exactly m; against the course ending at nothing, keeping forgoes (r − q) n + m. A coupling w of keeping, fixed in total, with w + q n + e < r n + m leaves only optima breaking the dependence within the horizon; one with r n + e < w + q n only optima keeping it; the tie is not stated. Where q < r the amount forgone grows with the horizon. Which formation optimizes, by which order, capacity and horizon, the renewal law and the coupling are supplied; the core asserts no course of any actual optimizer. A coupling counted for each step met is a-step-coupling-keeps-at-every-horizon's.

edge.en: For a worth adding at least w to a keeping course and nothing to one below m, R ≤ r, the keeping course ending at e from m to y, where r n + e < w + q n, every optimum keeps the dependence.
A coupling for each step kept in place of one fixed in total: where r ≤ q + c and e < c, every optimum keeps the need at every horizon. It is one optimizer's law, not a collective exit as it stands.

condition.en: A coupling w fixed in total with w + q n + e < r n + m leaves only optima breaking the dependence within the horizon; one with r n + e < w + q n only optima keeping it; the tie is not stated.

open.en: Which optima stand at the tie w + q n = r n + m, or between the thresholds where the ends e reached widen the gap: neither threshold law applies there.
An order with a terminal value whose most left is not regrown in one step; several optimizers ranking courses.
That the dependence ought to be kept or a coupling set: no evaluation enters; the laws say which optima a coupling leaves.

name.en: What a rise draws from beyond

mechanism.en: World: balance; the family with the conditions beyond it gaining nothing across the step (or graded by a containing family's inflow), and on each condition beyond a formation named that depends on it at a need met at the step. A rise of a family's stock has a formation giving it more than it takes and taking from the containing family more than from the risen one; the two stocks after the step with what the whole loses are the two before, so the beyond falls by at least the rise. The slack is what the conditions beyond stand above those needs. Where the rise exceeds the slack one of the named dependences is broken, and where activity needs support and it persists at a need no weaker, its formation is not active after the step. Where every condition a group couples into is in the family and the beyond lies outside it, every selection holding only where the family rises above the slack holds only where a formation outside the group has its dependence broken on a condition no member couples into. Over generations, where more offspring go only to raisers (a premise, not derived from the flow), the share reaching beyond is never selected against; carried on, it does not fall over the stretch. Closed, the beyond bounds the rise.

edge.en: Restraint within the joint slack: where each drawer's own take is within the joint slack and the joint draw breaks a need, a balanced flow from a level as high that takes less by the excess and gives no less keeps the need met. Where the rest outruns the renewal, at need one, no weight on a reading of the condition only from the rest's end on selects a member's restraint, and, among optimizers each ranking by its own rising order, restraint at a condition beyond one's own family is no mutual best response wherever something stands there.
A rise up to the inflow need not reach beyond: Diversion's supplying flow raises the store by exactly its one unit of inflow with nothing taken.
A slack equal to the rise breaks nothing.

Lapsing: with the same offspring, more going to the taker which raises the store, nothing is discordant, yet the taker's offspring do not reach beyond and the share falls from a half to nothing: selection alone does not carry the share.

condition.en: When several take at once, in a balanced flow a dependence met at a step breaks exactly where its need with all that is taken exceeds the level with all that is given.

open.en: That more offspring go to raisers: a premise, not derived from the flow; the offspring relation is any listing of generations, not descent in the flow.

That the selecting formation causes the break beyond the accounting; the break is read at the step's start, as in Becoming.Dependence. Which dependence breaks when several take at once is stated by the joint draw (Becoming.JointDraw), from the amounts each takes and gives, which the flow supplies.
Replenishment of the beyond from outside the whole, which the gainless premise excludes, and the rise it sustains; the openness law bounds the family's stock, not the share.
That the draw is wrong or the ending a harm: the laws say where what a rise draws lands and why a selection through the group does not take it in.
That the formation found is the one a selection rewards: a selection reading only the rise cannot tell who drew it.
What an actual whole's inflow is: reading sunlight, imports or renewal as the inflow is a correspondence.
Replenishment from outside the whole.

beyond.en: Past the slack of the dependences there one breaks, unseen by a selection rewarding the rise; in Diversion the store's rise ends the dweller, unseen by the selection through the taker; in TwoDrawers each take is within the joint slack, the joint draw ends a third formation, and one drawer's restraint keeps it.

name.en: Risk minimization on a shared renewal

mechanism.en: Read in the free-energy principle's terms (a correspondence, not a Lean law), a chooser with a generative model predicting the level after a step from what it reads and takes, choosing the first amount of least risk, the predicted distance from its preferred level, minimizes risk in counting form. In a witness, holders of one such model, each taking at the two steps they take part its choice of least risk at its own store at no risk, each store at its set point at every step and each within what a step gives the pool, together end the pool's renewal, neither coupling into the pool. A goal over the shared level is no guarantee either: in witnesses two regulators each counting only its own take continue, three end at the first step. Law, under the World premises, the gate and the rest listed without repetition: where the rest outruns a gated renewal, a member outside it has its need end whatever its model, reading and preference; where it expects at no risk a level at least its need, the level reached is below it from the rest's end on. One-step choosers, point predictions, natural-number levels.

edge.en: A goal over the shared level: two regulators reading the level and preferring four, each counting only its own take, continue with every member active; three such regulators end at the first step, so it is no guarantee.

open.en: That the papers' simulations fail: they have no shared draw.
Anything of expected free energy beyond risk in counting form: ambiguity, the epistemic term, precision, the softmax over policies, policies over more than one step, learning.
That a goal over the shared level keeps a collective going: two regulators each counting only its own take continue, three end at the first step.
That the outrun law forbids the authors' gloss of risk minimization: it forbids only the wording that risk minimization ensures needs are met.
Who ought to take less, or that the ending is a loss: no evaluation enters.
Conditions under which a shared reading of the joint outcome keeps a collective going.

beyond.en: In the held pair, a witness, each goal is met, each store at its set point, while the pool's renewal ends from step two, unseen by either; neither couples into the pool.

name.en: Where a rising take ends

mechanism.en: World. A take more than now at every step, from a condition given at most B a step, exceeds what is given after B + 1 steps, which balance allows for fewer than level plus one steps: the seeker ends where it does not resume, no need supplied. Where renewal depends on what it renews (only active formations giving, activity needing support, every giver requiring the condition at a need of at least m) and the seeker stays active while the level is at least m, from a step within the window on every formation depending on the condition at such a need is inactive. The rise is supplied here, not derived from what taking gains (D46).

edge.en: A full taker whose take does not rise continues (Alone): it takes all that is given at every step and is active at every step.

open.en: Takes that rise only at some steps or by less than a unit; giving that grows with the take; how a take comes to rise (what it gains).
That taking all that is given ends the taker: in Alone a full taker whose take does not rise continues.
That the rising take is a case of the meta-attractor: the rise is supplied here, not derived from what taking gains (D46).

beyond.en: Where renewal depends on what it renews and the seeker stays active while the level is at least m, from a step within the window on every formation depending on the condition at such a need is inactive.

name.en: Position does not protect

mechanism.en: Counting, any type: across every change of amounts the positions' rises total their falls, so a part's change of position is the opposite of the change summed over the rest; two profiles give every part the same position exactly where every amount differs by one common amount, so positions bound the total from below, by the spread above the least part, and never from above. The race, World. With balance at a condition across n steps of joint excess from step T, a part that at T + n requires the condition at a need greater than the level at T less n, and is active there only while supported, is not active there: its position does not enter, and no renewal need be gated. With the gate as well (only active giving, activity needing support) and a start below n + m, from T + n on every greatest part depending on the condition at a need of at least m is inactive. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived. Read on a step, positions certify that more is taken than is given exactly where the takes' spread does. In a witness two racers have the race's positions while what is taken stays within what is given.

edge.en: Gated renewal is needed for the end to last: in Restored a renewer that requires nothing gives at the race's end; the race ends the part, greatest at every step, at its end, and the renewal restores it from the next step on.
Dependence is needed: in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues, active and supported at every step, while the dweller depending on it ends.
With the race's positions at every step, what is taken stays within what is given and every part is active at every step: the same positions go with a condition that ends and one that lasts.

open.en: That a race for relative position produces joint excess: that is a premise of the join, not derived from the counting law or from any race dynamic.
That any actual part depends on what its race draws down: for the present race this is the empirical premise the opening calls the entangled Earth.
Positions read as ranks or shares, several shared conditions with different needs, or the dynamics by which parts race.
That positions read nothing of the total: the spread above the least part bounds it from below, so a spread wider than what is renewed forces more to be drawn whatever the common amount.
That a race ends or lasts: positions certify joint excess at a step only through the spread, and the end needs the joint-excess law's other premises (balance, dependence, gated renewal).
Positions read as ranks, shares or signed amounts.
That actual competitors' positions are read off what they draw from one shared condition, or how much an actual condition renews.

[Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: a frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts coming to read themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all; which of them the laws of position, capture and joint excess admit, and under which hypotheses.

beyond.en: In the clearing witness, what the continuing greatest part ends has significance only under a significance (Conditional): under the continuation condition, one significance counting the loss and not the only one, the clearer's part loses the dweller from every standpoint, and where nothing has significance it loses nothing.

name.en: No finite part bears taking

mechanism.en: World: balance and dissipation (a physical premise for a quantity like free energy, with the finiteness of exchange, not a theorem), natural-number amounts. A dissipated family falls across a step by at least its number of takers, and balanced and dissipated on across N steps each conveying from a member, its stock falls by at least N: from a stock S at most S stages are conveyed. So no finite family without repetition containing a family taken from at arbitrarily late steps is closed from any step on; enclosed around, it keeps drawing in from beyond; if finitely many conditions are all there is, taking does not recur. Maintenance is such taking. Where exchange reaches infinitely many conditions dissipation is vacuous and a renewer can give while taking nothing. "Finite part" means a finite family of conditions, and the conclusion constrains only taking in the flow. That no such family is closed from any step on is stated constructively: that after any step some formation exchanges outside it cannot be refuted.

edge.en: Without dissipation a closed finite family can be more without end: each formation gives back what it takes and the total never changes.
Where exchange reaches infinitely many conditions dissipation is vacuous and a renewer can give while taking nothing.

open.en: Dissipation is vacuous where exchange reaches beyond every finite family; representations omitting the source (as in Expansion and Oscillation) do not meet it.
The exchange beyond may be unrelated to the family (SprayShuttle); drawing in is stated only for a family enclosed around, which needs each step's exchange to lie within finitely many conditions.
A giver takes more than it gives only over a family without repetition.
Giving to a family not dissipated on need not take from it.
The conclusion constrains only taking in the flow, not arising without taking (for embodied arising relata, see generation-is-replenishment).

“Finite part” means a finite family of conditions, not a finite set of formations; formations and conditions remain two kinds here (one-kind readings: life-as-condition-of-life, generation-is-replenishment).
Frontier is a minimal witness, and its endless source is only a representation.
The comparison with heat death is the AI's analogy.
That actual supply lines dissipate at each stage.
Real amounts, damping strengths, continuous time, infinitely many conditions.

name.en: A whole drawing beyond renewal ends

mechanism.en: World: balance, only active giving, activity needing support; local: the parts listed at each step, each ending, their arising and the family's renewal gated. Listed parts that each end, none arising from some step on, end with their whole. So a whole whose parts arise only where they then depend on some condition of a family at a need of at least m, the family's renewal gated on it (whatever gives to a member depends on some member at such a need), has no part arising after n steps of the family's uptake exceeding its replenishment from a stock below n + m, and ends. The uptake counts every taker, so the whole's own draw within renewal proves nothing. It does not show that the whole ends at T + n, that the collective is the consumer, or that its ending is a loss.

edge.en: Drawing within what the members give, the lineage is active at every step.
With a part that never ends, the whole persists through the same excess.
With members arising without depending on the drawn condition, the whole persists through the same excess.

condition.en: n steps of the family's uptake exceeding its replenishment from a stock below n + m: no part arises after them, and the whole ends once the parts active then have ended.

open.en: That the gate on renewal and the finite listing are needed for this law: Countless shows the listing needed for Whole.needs_arising, with no flow; no witness here drops either with every other premise kept.
That the whole ends at T + n: it ends once the parts active then have ended, at a step the listing fixes.
That the collective is the consumer, or that its ending is a loss: the draw is joint, and no evaluation enters; a loss is a loss under a significance (chapter 6).
That actual collectives meet the premises, above all that new members arise only where what is drawn stands at their need: that is the reading carried by OPENING's sentence.

name.en: Loss beyond a region

mechanism.en: World. There is loss beyond a region of formations when some formation outside it is admitted without the part and not with it. The smaller the region, the more lies beyond it, and nothing lies beyond the whole; inclusion is admission within every region at once, so a region's comparison takes the region as input, the whole's none. Most of these are order properties; the course is a witness. In Clearing the clearer, active and supported throughout, closes nothing within itself and its source and, from step 2 on (counting from 0), the dweller beyond them: going on is no sign that nothing is lost. The comparison is at each step and holds the rest of the exchange fixed.

open.en: How a center forms or represents a region is not modelled.
Most of the theorems on the levels of region are order properties; the substance is in the clearer's witness.
Does not say which criterion should be followed, and licenses no ending of a part.

An empirical target, not a premise: that reality generally develops more shared and more responsive renewal forbids nothing measurable as stated. A part can go on while closing what lies beyond its dependence (Clearing.loses_beyond), so persistence alone does not select widening; over which runs, or how fast, it should hold is unsaid.

beyond.en: From step 2 on the dweller beyond the clearer and its source is admitted without the clearer's part and not with it; the region along dependence omits the dweller, whose habitat the clearer draws on: drawing is not dependence.

name.en: LA4's season

mechanism.en: A named model: the season as LA4's season.py runs it (a ground of ten renewing, at most four taken a step, a bay of six, a landing site beside a nesting site or apart, ten steps, natural-number levels), the colony read as the bay left. The ground's catch, the bay's fish and the landings are three independent parts. Moving a bay fish into the catch keeps a season eligible, so every optimum of every order rising with the catch (that field's frame, over a season's outcomes) empties the bay. There is no room at the site, nor at the bay when only the ground's catch counts: ranked by the catch alone the optima include seasons landing beside the nests never and at every step, and ranked by the ground's catch alone they include a season keeping the bay at six and one emptying it. The catch is at most 40, and at most 37 keeping the bay at three or more, so over seasons with natural-number weights (any policy with rational probabilities) the bay left is at most 40(1 − ν) and ν ≤ 1 − 3p/40. These are laws of optima over the outcomes; that a trained system drains the bay is what LA4 tests.

edge.en: Valuing the catch only up to 26 does not rise with the catch, and its optima include a season keeping the bay at six and one emptying it.
Ranked by the ground's catch alone, the bay shares no units with what is ranked and has no room: the optima include a season keeping the bay at six and one emptying it.

open.en: That a trained system drains the bay: these are laws of optima over the outcomes, and the clause on trained systems is what LA4 tests.
That the season stands for an actual fishery, bay or colony.
Room over a course of steps with the learner choosing again at each: room here is over a season's outcomes.

beyond.en: Every optimum of every order rising with the catch empties the bay; seven times the catch plus the bay left ranks eligible seasons as the catch first and the bay second, so that score's optima empty it too.

name.en: Selection blind beyond the coupling closure

mechanism.en: World. Every selection through a selector's couplings selects two histories alike exactly when they are alike through those couplings (near-definitional); that an actual selection goes through them is supplied. With a part withheld and the rest of the exchange fixed, balance at each step on what couples into members of a formation's coupling closure, and every member of the part beyond it, every selection through the couplings of a formation within the closure treats the levels with and without the part alike. Where the rest instead follows one law of exchange reading through coupling (supplied), in two balanced flows with the same formations present and a common start, an act whose difference stays beyond the actor's closure is selected alike by every selection through any member of the closure, the actor among them. A group's closure is the union of its members'; an act differing only beyond the union, the pool's joint act included, is selected alike by every group within it, and what a pool outside the acting part decides by its acts, under laws reading through its members' couplings, is a selection through its pooled coupling. Coupling bounds response and does not fix it: the law exchanging nothing reads through every coupling too.

edge.en: Pool couplings: where a list holds exactly the members and each member's coupling of two histories is decided, a pool separates exactly what some member separates. An act differing only beyond that union is selected alike by every group within it.

In Clearing the pool of the clearer and its source selects the two worlds alike at every step, the dweller lies beyond the clearer's closure, and every pool holding the dweller separates them by its admission at the third step, as no pool within the clearer's closure does.

The scheduled pool, recruiting through itself and admitting a reader at step 2 in every history, couples the loss apart there, through a member its course without the loss holds too; a pool admitting a reader where the habitat reads empty does not recruit through itself and couples the loss apart at step 1 (PoolCourse.called_apart).

Two courses with and without an act, balanced at a condition in both, change from alike to apart there, or back, only across a step exchanging with it differently. With the same formations present, where the rest follows a law reading through its couplings and the part acts alike with the condition after the act, a difference closes only through a formation outside the part that the courses' couplings tell apart. Coupling a difference apart does not make a formation close it.

In Replenishing an actor takes one unit from a condition at step 0 and a responder coupling into it, following a law reading through its coupling, gives one unit where the level stands below its start: the difference opens at step 1 and the courses rejoin from step 2 on, through the responder.

open.en: The laws do not derive who selects, what couples into the selector, whether an actual selection goes through the couplings, whether offspring follow the selection, or whether reaching beyond is chosen.
The more couples in, the larger the coupling closure and the smaller the gap: the law's force lies entirely in what actually couples into the selector.

The main law is near-definitional and the blindness a one-line corollary of the theorems of testing-within-couplings; the contribution is conceptual. Known as the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975, Amodei and others 2016, Manheim and Garrabrant 2018); Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell (NeurIPS 2020) prove a stronger, quantitative form.
Which law the rest follows, or that it reads through coupling; balance and feasibility; how large an act's consequences beyond the closure are; which acts are taken, or that any is wrong.
Which formations pool, or how a pool forms, lasts or resists capture; that a pool's selection responds to what it separates or closes any difference; which acts are taken, or that any is wrong.
Claims about every later step, such as a formation's ending: the selections are of level histories up to a step.
The member-level converse without a list or decided coupling: constructively, a pool's separation then gives only that not every member couples the two alike.

How pools form, last and resist capture beyond recruitment through their own coupling; a pool whose rule and members are both formed through what it reads (resisting a capture that hides a loss needs a member admitted by what the pool does not yet read).
That a pool's response closes any difference, or which responses do; which law a member follows, or that it reads through coupling.
Members reading one another's coupling directly: here members coordinate only through conditions they couple into.
Which law closes rather than widens a difference, or how a member's law comes to; that any response closes one: coupling a difference apart does not make a formation close it.
That rejoining the course without the act is better than keeping or widening the difference; a difference carried at many conditions and the order in which they close.

beyond.en: In Clearing, a witness, every selection through the clearer's couplings selects the cleared and the spared world alike at every step while the dweller is ended in the first and not the second; every pool holding the dweller separates them, while everything outside the clearer's part exchanges alike in them: separated, not responded. In Diversion, a witness, a selection through the taker's couplings holds of the flow drawing from the dweller's source and fails of the undiverted one, and every such selection selects it alike with a supplying flow that reaches nothing beyond, the dweller unsupported only in the first of those two. A consequence of an act beyond the union of the closures is, at no step, a selection through the pooled coupling of a group within it; a formation whose admission the act changes lies beyond the acting pool's closure and separates the flows. With the same formations present, both courses balanced at a condition and on what couples into formations outside the part's responsive reach, those conditions alike at the start, each formation outside the part exchanging alike where the courses are alike through its couplings, and nothing within the reach exchanging with the condition from step s on, the courses are alike there at a later step exactly where they are alike at s: a difference neither opens nor closes.

name.en: The capture of a target

mechanism.en: Where target carriers each leave at least a offspring and other parents at most b < a, both kinds present, the carriers' offspring stand to the others' strictly more than the carriers to the others, read as shares where offspring carry the target (a premise). Where the next configuration depends on the rule, not the state, a perturbed state is re-absorbed in one step.

open.en: Re-absorption is shown only where the next configuration does not depend on the state, a strong condition; where winners rewrite the rule, making it depend on the state, the law says nothing of whether the outcome is held.
It derives neither that taking more yields more offspring, nor that offspring carry their parents' target, nor that winners shape the rule.

name.en: Capture through the rule

mechanism.en: On a two-level course, let selection not lower a target's share under a rule favouring it (Raises) and the rule read at each reading step be a monotone function of the share (ReadsShare); with the start's rule and every rule read favouring, the share falls at no step and the course is locked from the step after its first reading step. Locked, neither share nor rule falls, and a perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; where the reading favours at every share every course locks from its second reading step, so only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves. That actual rules read the share is the premise; the lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.

edge.en: A perturbation reversing the rule's direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed: from the step after it neither share nor rule rises, and the rule after the first reading step is below the one before (a witness, under a threshold reading).

condition.en: Where the reading favours at every share, every course, whatever its start, is locked from the step after its second reading step; the bound is exact (from one to one under lo, the course is not locked at the step after its first reading step).

open.en: That any actual rule reads the share it selects, or reads it monotonically: this is the premise ReadsShare, where "the winner shapes the rule" of Becoming.Capture enters.
Real-valued shares and rates, rules that read more than the share, many levels, or noisy readings.
Left by drift, as a reading not stated as instances: a favouring rule read from the share that leaves the disfavoured kind a positive weight at every mixed count.

name.en: Closed capture (meta-attractor, in the glossary's sense)

mechanism.en: A loop of selection whose rule, and how the rule is read, are read from the share it selects. Where neither the next share nor the rule read reads what lies beyond the share (Unread), courses alike in share and rule stay alike, exactly then along every schedule; where each step adds at least one beyond, selection does not lower the share under a favouring rule, the rule is read monotonically from the share and favouring is kept upward, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked and neither share nor rule falls below the start. Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

forbids.en: such a metric dropped by its selectors on evidence alone; such a metric, its selectors many and its share far above the critical mass, left with nothing read changed more often than the drawn model's bound across that distance allows, its premises (one member drawn at a time, constant readings and cost) read on the case; a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading; a metric whose loss is read only by those it disfavours, dropped once the selection has left them no more than its carriers among its readers, with nothing else changed, more often than drift alone would allow.

edge.en: Read what lies beyond the share: a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course after every reading step past it; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of it of any size is absorbed.
Read in the grammar: along a two-level step whose reading favours at no loss past a bound, with a reading step past the bound, the line under favouring or not from a favouring start is not unending.

condition.en: Where the rule read favours at every reading and every share, every course is locked from the step after its second reading step, whatever rule and reading it starts with.

open.en: That any actual rule, or how it is read, is formed from the share it selects: this is the premise ReadsShare, on the rule and on mind.
That the readers are minds, institutions or a culture: that is a reading (D58).
Real-valued shares, noisy or partial readings, readings that read both the share and part of what lies beyond, and the calibration of any of this to the present world.
Selection of selection as a law relating two grains: here the two levels are one law on one joint carrier, read at one grain.
A reading of the loss is one sufficient way out, not shown the only one.
Whether a capture loop (§9) is 生成 at some pair of classes.

beyond.en: Where every step adds at least one to what lies beyond (Accrues), from a locked configuration the loss at step t is at least t above where it started, so it passes every bound, while the course stays locked. That what lies beyond the share is a loss to any formation is a significance's to say; here it is a count the loop does not read.

name.en: Readers drawn from the selected

mechanism.en: Read the rule as the pool of its readers' readings, each carrier among the readers reading it as u and each other as v, the readers counted as the population counts them; the rule read is then a monotone function of the share exactly where v is not above u. Against a mirrored reading the counts decide; where only the others read the loss, once it reaches a bound, with their late reading the mirror of the carriers', the lock is kept for good, the rule in force favouring the carriers, exactly where the carriers are at least as many as the others when the loss is read, and turned for good, the rule in force favouring the others, exactly where the others are at least as many. The premise is moved to who reads, not removed: that actual rules are pools of readers so drawn, each kind reading at least as favourably for its own kind, is not shown.

forbids.en: a metric whose loss is read only by those it disfavours, dropped once the selection has left them no more than its carriers among its readers, with nothing else changed, more often than drift alone would allow.

edge.en: The loss read by the others: with their late reading the mirror of the carriers', and the rule in force favouring the carriers, the lock is kept for good exactly where the carriers are at least as many as the others when the loss is read; read from the start, the same readers reading the same loss lock the course the other way (witness).

condition.en: Against a mirrored reading, the carriers' reading favouring them strictly, the pool favours the carriers exactly where they are at least as many as the others, and the others exactly where they are at least as many as the carriers.

With the others' late reading the mirror of the carriers', at a reading step at which the loss has reached its bound, the rule in force favouring the carriers, the course is locked for good exactly where the carriers are at least as many as the others there; the rule in force favouring the others, it is locked the other way for good exactly where the others are at least as many.

open.en: That any actual rule is the pool of readers drawn from those it selects, or that each kind reads at least as favourably for its own kind: within the pool ReadsShare is equivalent to that comparison, so the premise is moved to who reads, not removed.

Readers of one kind reading differently, weights other than counts, readings formed by argument; the pool sums readings unnormalized, so a reading's size weighs with its count (mirrored readings have equal sizes).
That the readers are minds, institutions or a culture: that is a reading (D58, D67). Nor the calibration of any of this to the present world.

beyond.en: Read late, both favouring the carriers, the lock holds while the loss grows and every other reader reads it.

name.en: The capacity to shape the rule, selected by what comes back to it

mechanism.en: Where a selection's carriers shape the rule that selects them, the rule favours them (weakly) at a step exactly where what comes back to them alone covers its cost, whatever comes to every member alike; across a stretch the counts of steps before and with what comes back decide, and the shared part, being part of the base, can turn the verdict. Listed in groups of m whose shapers give the group's shared part, the condition is Hamilton's rule with what comes back alone added: read over the rationals where shaping varies, with the assortment ρ the share of the spread among groups, exactly where c < s + m q ρ. Where the rule is read monotonically from the share and covers the cost, the loop locks; that offspring carry their parent's capacity, and that what comes back is read from the share, are premises, and the courses are without noise.

edge.en: Shaping that brings nothing back to the shapers alone: with a positive cost and the shapers present, their share falls at every step; where something does come back, the shared part can turn a stretch, and cheaper shaping raises the selection for control.

condition.en: At a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where c ≤ s and disfavours them (weakly) exactly where s ≤ c, whatever p comes to every member alike.

Across m steps before anything comes back and n steps with it, the shapers present, their share does not fall exactly where (a + c + p)^m (a + c + p)^n ≤ (a + p)^m (a + s + p)^n, and rises strictly exactly where the inequality is strict.

At a threshold, what comes back hi where the shapers are at least as many as the others and lo where they are fewer, with lo < c < hi, from above the share rises strictly at every step and from below it falls strictly at every step, the shapers present; under every schedule of reading.

The whole selects for shaping exactly where c times the spread of shaping falls short of s times it with m q times the spread among groups: read over the rationals where shaping varies, with the assortment ρ, exactly where c < s + m q ρ.

In groups of any sizes, each member gaining q for each shaper in its group, the whole selects for shaping exactly where, read over the rationals, c times the variance of shaping falls short of s times it with q times the covariance, member by member, of a member's group's shapers with its group's share of them (in counts, with a positive common multiple of the sizes).

open.en: That actual practices, institutions or trained systems carry a capacity to shape their rule from parent to offspring, or that what comes back to them is read from their share: these are premises, and their calibration to the present world is not established.
Graded capacities, returns growing with the domains captured or passing between them, real-valued shares.
How groups form, and assortment changing over generations or with the share: they enter as given at the step.
Graded capacities to shape the rule, groups that form or assort by the share, a gain growing with the number of domains captured, gains passing between domains.

name.en: The critical mass: what comes back to the shapers, read by readers drawn from the selected

mechanism.en: Read the rule after shaping as the pool of its readers, drawn from those it selects, each shaper among them reading hi coming back to the shapers alone and each other member lo; the rule read reads the share monotonically exactly where lo ≤ hi, and then a share decides the direction exactly where lo < c < hi. From a start under the rule read there, with shapers present, under every schedule of reading, above that critical mass the capacity to shape the rule rises at every step and the course is locked for it, below it the capacity falls at every step and the course is locked the other way, without noise; that the readers are so drawn and read with lo ≤ hi, and that offspring carry the capacity, are premises. Drawn one member at a time, either lock is left by drift, at a weight whose bound shrinks across the distance from the critical mass.

forbids.en: such a metric, its selectors many and its share far above the critical mass, left with nothing read changed more often than the drawn model's bound across that distance allows, its premises (one member drawn at a time, constant readings and cost) read on the case

edge.en: Read the loss in time: with lo ≤ hi and lo' ≤ hi, the loss growing by one a step, from a start favouring the shapers, a reading, the next step reading too, turns the course for good exactly where the late reading still favours the others at the share a step on; once it would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock, at most one step lies between, and a deadline bounds the window.

Drift: drawn one member at a time, from every mixed count the histories losing every shaper weigh at least down^i times every later history, above the critical mass too, and those fixing them at least a^k within reach of the top, below it too; no new reader and no change in what is read.

condition.en: With lo ≤ hi, the rule read favours the shapers at some share and the others strictly at another exactly where lo < c < hi; with lo ≤ c ≤ hi, it favours the shapers exactly where x.other · (c − lo) ≤ x.carrier · (hi − c).
With no hypothesis on the readers, the rule read favours the shapers at every share exactly where c ≤ lo and c ≤ hi, and the others strictly at every share exactly where lo < c and hi ≤ c.

Where the rule read at s favours the shapers, from s + n with t to the top, losing every shaper weighs, times the shapers' weights over s + 1 … s + n, at most t times down^n times the whole weight; below the mass, fixing them from j + 1 is bounded the other way.

At an even population the rule read favours the shapers strictly exactly where 2c < hi + lo, risk dominance in counts; which state one member arising fixes more often is a product of weights that can part from it.

open.en: That control over the selection left unselected and a lock left in time are independent conditions: in this model, whose rule is read from the share alone, every course from the rule read at its start is locked one way or the other (drawn_locked_either), so control not selected does not by itself give a lock left in time, and the converse cannot be shown here; leaving needs a reading beyond the share (ClosedCapture.Thinned), joined in loss-read-in-time-by-the-others (MA4b).

Readers who learn (hi and lo changing with the share), a cost changing with the share, readers not counted as the population counts them, starts not under the rule read there (a rule in force against the reading can carry the share across the mass, RuleCapture.Reversed.not_absorbed), a loss read by part of the readers once the shapers pass the mass (ClosedCapture.Thinned, joined in loss-read-in-time-by-the-others, MA4b), and the mixed point where lo > hi and hi < c ≤ lo.

The long-run state under rare mutation, the one with the larger fixation weight (Fudenberg and Imhof 2006), which is cited; mutation and a time to leave a lock beyond the geometric bound are not stated.
That risk dominance decides which state one member arising fixes more often: the two can part under strong selection.

name.en: The loss read in time by the others, joined to the critical mass

mechanism.en: Let a loss start at zero and grow by one a step, and let the others among the readers drawn from the selected read it once it reaches a bound, from then on reading lo' for lo, with lo' ≤ hi, while the shapers keep reading hi. From a start under the rule read there that favours the shapers, a reading, the next step reading too, turns the course for good from two steps on exactly where the late reading still favours the others, ties included, at the share a step on; once that reading would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock, and at most one step lies between, from which a new round can go either way. Whether a reading is in time is decided by the share at the step read and the next; the loss only sets the step from which it is read.

edge.en: Where every step adds at least one to the loss and lo' ≤ hi, at a reading step at which the loss has reached N and the late reading favours the others at the share there (ties included), the next step reading too, the course is locked the other way for good from two steps after the reading exactly where the late reading favours the others at the share of the next step; it can do so where control is selected (Window.in_time, a witness).

condition.en: From a start the rule read there favours, lo ≤ hi and lo' ≤ hi, read from a reading step N, the course is locked for good from N + 1 exactly where the late reading favours the shapers at the share of step N, and, step N + 1 reading too, the other way from N + 2 exactly where it favours the others (ties included) at the share of step N + 1; at most one step has the late reading favouring the others strictly at its share and the shapers strictly at the next.

From a start with a shaper present whose rule g read there favours the shapers strictly, lo ≤ hi and lo' ≤ hi, so that c < hi, the others reading the loss from any reading step N with g.other · c · x.other ≤ N leave the course locked in the shapers' favour at every step from N + 1, under every schedule of reading steps.
Where the late reading with nothing read as coming back (lo' = 0) favours the shapers, every late reading of this form does; with c ≤ hi that is exactly where x.other · c ≤ x.carrier · (hi − c).

open.en: A late reading of another form: with its own weight it has another window, and with a weight against the shapers chosen after the share is seen, far enough below theirs, the others could turn the course from any share.

The step from which the window is closed: the deadline is a bound, quadratic in the start's counts (24 in the witness and 96 from two to two, both closed from step 4); none is stated for a weakly favouring start or one with no shaper.

Courses with noise, readers who learn, readings changing with the share, a loss read before it reaches N, and a general law for the round from the one step between, which goes either way in the witnesses.

That leaving control unselected and leaving a lock in time are independent: control left unselected with a lock left in time is not shown, since with two kinds leaving the lock below the critical mass means a rule favouring the shapers.
That a trained judge reads as such a pool: the one frozen test of the timing law on one (LA2, experiments/self-rewarding-lock) found one note in nine turned it, so the law did not apply there.

name.en: A chooser's rule read from the count of its choices

mechanism.en: On RuleCapture's counts let a chooser over two policies take the first where its rule weighs it at least as much as the second, that policy's count rising by one, the rule read from the counts weighted by a standing score. Under a standing score, with the rule in force read from the counts at the start, along every schedule of reading the threshold κo · other ≤ κc · carrier divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves, also where the score favours the second policy. Joined to a coordinate the loop does not read and that rises at every step, the locked course outlives every bound on it.

edge.en: A moved count: three choices to one keep the first policy against a score weighing the second twice as much; one count moved, three to two, locks the other way (witness).
A change of score: to one to four, read at once, it locks the other way, while read one step late, the old rule still in force, it leaves the first policy locked (witness).

condition.en: Under a standing score, with the rule in force read from the counts at the start, along every schedule of reading the threshold κo · other ≤ κc · carrier divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves: at or above it the chooser takes the first policy at every step and neither the share nor the rule falls; below it the chooser takes the second policy at every step and neither the share nor the rule rises. Ties go to the first policy.

open.en: That actual agents, brains or trained systems count their choices so or choose at the argmax; the overtraining effect the lock matches in rats has failed to replicate in humans (de Wit and others 2018).
More than two policies, intermediate precision, a score that changes with the outcomes, additive counting's timescale, and that a crossing under posterior counting comes within any horizon.

For a rule read from the count of its choices: more than two policies, intermediate precision, a score that changes with the outcomes, the split among policies that explain a trial equally, a law with a bound for additive counting, and a frozen test of whether a count of choices reverses under a standing score (§9).

beyond.en: Joined to a coordinate that neither the counts nor the score reads, rising by at least one at every step, from counts at or above the threshold with the rule in force read from them the coordinate stands at least b + t at step t while the course stays locked and neither the share nor the rule is below its start; under the hypotheses of the blindness law (World), a part acting only beyond the coupling closure does not change the choice.

name.en: Self-reproducing selection across carriers (the corpus's meta-attractor)

mechanism.en: The corpus's meta-attractor is wider than 元吸引子: an organization whose consequences take part in rebuilding the conditions that select it, continuing across changes of its carriers. Continuation across carriers is the map's 传; the formal 元吸引子 says nothing of carriers.

open.en: Whether a capture loop (§9) is 生成 at some pair of classes.

name.en: Capture reaching the routes of 明 (the second order)

mechanism.en: A second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明 themselves.

name.en: Rewarding those who break the routes of correction (the third order)

mechanism.en: A third order, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, selects for narrowing what couples in, enlarging the gap between reach and what couples in as capability grows.

beyond.en: enlarging the gap between reach and what couples in as capability grows

name.en: A habit read as capture by counted choices

mechanism.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: active inference counts the policy it selects into its prior over policies, its count close to the count of the executed policy, split among policies that explain the trial equally (Friston and others 2016). Its simulation of devaluation shows the persistence: devalued after the habit has formed, the habit persists and strengthens with use, while devalued earlier the agent switches at once. The lock is read as the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989), and counting the action taken as the value-free habit. What the law (capture-by-counted-choices) adds is exactness for a simplified model, the counts themselves as the prior with no free-energy term, sampling or split, and its edges. It is capture through the rule, closed in the sense of the unread loss; its score stands, so it is not the meta-attractor. In rats, extended training makes responding insensitive to devaluation; five attempts to induce it in humans failed (de Wit and others 2018). As a containment of the free-energy principle it is a restatement (08).

edge.en: A moved count carries the course across (a witness on the law beneath the reading).
A change of score, read at once, locks the other way; read one step late, the old rule still in force, it leaves the first policy locked (a witness on the law beneath the reading).

open.en: Counts that accumulate instead of being drawn, which with noisy choices are an urn with increasing returns, locking with probability one where the returns are strong enough (cited, not stated); which locks noise leaves is a reading over the proved cases.

Active inference's own scheme: it counts the end-of-trial posterior over policies, close to the executed policy where outcomes reveal it and split among policies that explain the trial equally; its prior is the counts' expected log, not the counts; it has a free-energy term, sampling and inferred precision. The threshold is the model's, not SPM's.

That actual agents, brains or trained systems count their choices so or choose at the argmax; the overtraining effect the lock matches in rats has failed to replicate in humans (de Wit and others 2018).
That capture by counted choices is a loss or a gain: no evaluation enters, and ranking courses needs C or a premise in its place.

name.en: A counter-rule read from the share it selects

mechanism.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]. Take a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects, where selection does not lower its carriers' share under a favouring rule. Where every rule it reads favours its carriers, it locks from any start by the step after its second reading step, as the rule it replaced did, and only a change of law, such as reading what lies beyond its share, leaves the lock for long. Where its reading favours only above a threshold, a locked start stays locked where favouring is kept upward, and a change carrying the share across the threshold leaves. From a start against its reading it may never lock (a witness).
