The imperial examination is read as this case in the meta-attractor line: designed to dilute hereditary capture, "it later became a proxy trap of its own". It rests on the capture laws, not on the law of shaping. That any actual counter-rule reads its share so is the reading's premise.

edge.en: Where its reading favours only above a threshold, a change carrying the share across the threshold leaves (a witness, under a threshold reading).

Only a change of law, such as reading what lies beyond its share, leaves the lock for long: where each step adds at least one beyond, a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course at the step after every reading step past it. A sufficient way out, not shown necessary.

open.en: That any actual rule reads the share it selects, or reads it monotonically: the premise ReadsShare of the law beneath this reading.

name.en: A code formed between formations

mechanism.en: Any type; for runs of hearings, equality of formations and of senses decided. A group agreeing at a sense keeps agreeing through every hearing closed for it; agreement of all is a rest under every rule. Under hearings that take the form heard, each formation holds the start's form of its origin. From a start symmetric under the exchange and the renaming, a law keeping both never brings formations it exchanges to agree at a sense where the renaming moves every form. Imposing one code makes all agree in a step, keeps every exchange of formations and keeps no renaming that moves a form it gives; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges, the source losing none, and under hearings that copy, where every formation holds the imposed form at a sense, all hold it at every later step. A resolution written back into the records later cohorts read, records written to offer exactly what was resolved, rests from the next cohort on. Which orders actual exchange takes, and whether actual conventions form this way, are not shown.

edge.en: Out of disagreement: where two forms differ, an order of hearings that take the form heard brings every start to agreement at a sense exactly where it gives all formations one origin at that sense. Being joined through couplings is not enough (Path.never_agree, a witness).

For a group agreeing at a sense with a member other than the step's hearer, the members agree after the step exactly where, if the hearer is a member hearing that sense and the rule takes the form, the speaker's form is the hearer's.
Under hearings that copy, where every formation holds the imposed form at a sense, all hold it at every later step: a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining.

A merged distinction returns from a form held outside: where a formation holds the imposed form at one sense and hears, at another the code merges with it, a formation whose form there is not the imposed one, it then tells the two apart.
Where all hold a code merging two senses, a form coined at one that the code does not give the other, heard by all, makes every formation tell them apart again.
From a symmetric disagreement, in a witness of two formations, a formation both hear, a preferred form and an order of hearing each break one symmetry and bring agreement.

open.en: Which orders actual exchange takes, with probabilities over orders, and how long agreement takes: the voter model's and the naming game's expectations are not stated.
That actual conventions, scripts or the theory's own terms form by hearing in this way, or whether a shared, imposed or kept code supports or damages 生生.
That a code is in fact imposed, or that imposing is better than another way to agree.
That names in use are coined deliberately, or that a coined form is heard.

name.en: A code held as counts, learned from what is heard

mechanism.en: Any type of agents, meanings and words; counts in any strict order, natural counts for learning and free energy; discrete steps of a determined law, the hearer given the meaning. Under a law keeping the exchange of agents together with a renaming of the words, from a start related to itself, where the renaming at a meaning is onto and moves every word (or moves every word with the exchange an involution), two exchanged agents never hold one word as each one's uniquely greatest, and where they hold the same counts there those counts have none. Learning from what is heard keeps the relation where the speaker map commutes with the exchange and the rule reads count by count and commutes with renaming; a weight read off the hearer's whole model keeps it where the weight is unchanged by the renaming. Under weights a renaming moving every word fixes, with a positive total, a belief at the free-energy bound over a listing of every word has no uniquely greatest word. Reading [D45], not a theorem: federated inference's law over the reals is read as keeping the relation, for a renaming the same for every meaning.

forbids.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: read as a guarantee, that language is an emergent property of free-energy minimization fails for every deterministic scheme keeping the symmetry from a symmetric start: free-energy minimization breaks no symmetry, and something else must, a preferred word, an order or centre telling the agents apart, an asymmetric start or chance. Its simulation starts from random parameters and stands.

edge.en: A preferred word: from no counts, a speaker saying the first word of greatest count, a tie going to the first word, brings both agents to hold that word as uniquely greatest after one hearing; that rule does not commute with renaming (a witness).
An asymmetric start: counts 1, 0 and 0, 0, which the exchange with the renaming does not relate to themselves, give both agents 1, 0 after one step of adding the speaker's counts (a witness).

open.en: That federated inference's own law over the reals, with its normalized predictive, its weighting by expected free energy and its forgetting, keeps the relation: that is a reading.
Speaking by sampling: reinforcement with sampled signals reaches a signalling system (Argiento and others 2009); no invariant law for sampled speech is stated here.
How long agreement takes, which asymmetry actual conventions start from, or whether they form this way.

name.en: A reading against the share does not ratchet

mechanism.en: Where the rule is read against the share (the reading monotone into the reversed order), selection under favouring rules does not lower the share, and the rules along the course favour at every step, a later reading's rule is not above an earlier one's: the rise the lock rests on does not form. It does not show that such a course is never locked at a step, or that its share falls.

open.en: That a course read against the share is never locked at a step, or that its share falls.

name.en: Where seeking rests: more than now never does, above all others never for two

mechanism.en: A target is any condition on the configuration; how it forms is not modelled. Under a determined law the orbit comes to rest with its target met exactly where it reaches a state the law leaves unchanged that meets the target. "More than now" is met only by change, and met at every step it needs an open world, no list holding its configurations; "above all others" is met by at most one seeker, so no unchanged state meets it for two. On the World model, what stands listed at each step: where what stands runs down at every step from some step on, no condition rises at arbitrarily late steps: exhaustion, not enough. Under an undetermined law (any process) enough parts in two: some run comes to rest with its target met exactly where a reachable configuration meets the target and can stay; every run does exactly where every reachable configuration that can stay meets the target and every run from it settles. Staying and meeting everywhere do not give settling: with two configurations and every step allowed, the alternating run never settles. That the seeking is 无明 is a reading, filed apart (locked-seeking).

edge.en: Under a determined law the orbit comes to rest with its target met exactly where it reaches a state the law leaves unchanged that meets the target.

Under a census of what stands, where what stands runs down at every step from some step on, no condition rises at arbitrarily late steps: exhaustion, not enough. It shows only that the rises do not recur, not that exhaustion ends the seekers.

open.en: It does not derive how a target forms or is revised, that a seeker pursues it, or which targets actual formations hold.
Hijacking, how such targets form and pass on and how winning selects them, is not stated here.
Running down shows only that the rises do not recur at arbitrarily late steps, not that exhaustion ends the seekers themselves.

When runs settle is 08's: in a world that a list holds, some run from a configuration keeps changing exactly where a reachable change can be undone; that no run keeps changing does not give settling constructively; worlds that no list holds are outside these laws.
Targets met along a course rather than at a configuration (more than now), choices divided between the seeker and others, and probabilistic enough.

beyond.en: Where a seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest draws on what stands, with the rest of the exchange fixed and balance on what couples in, its losses beyond its coupling closure do not return through its own feedback.

name.en: Locked seeking

mechanism.en: Reading [AI reading, D26, D41, D45; in 02, D26 as revised in D45, D48, D56, D57, D58]: 无明 is seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest. What grounds it is the position every formation selects from, which reaches only what couples in; the position is not itself 无明. Knowing enough (知足) is a target met at a state the law leaves unchanged, knowing where to stop (知止) a target within that boundary; runs that keep changing are not 无明. The law beneath it is Law.rests_iff: a seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest never comes to rest with it met. Which seeking is so locked is the reading, not the law. 02 reads what leaves as 明, coupling joined to the selection so that it reaches what the share does not carry; 03 [AI reading, D20, D26, D45] reads 明 as a relation, as wide as the couplings joined to a selection, growing as measurement, a model and pools are joined.

open.en: None of this says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生.
Hijacking, how such targets form and pass on and how winning selects them, is not stated here.

beyond.en: Where a seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest draws on what stands, with the rest of the exchange fixed and balance on what couples in, its losses beyond its coupling closure do not return through its own feedback.

name.en: Obscuration and reopening

mechanism.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost. It is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, not from a firm judgment, a stable goal or a disagreement, so the label cannot immunize. Reopening is a blocked relation regaining effect, not an apology or a renamed goal. 07's reading of diagnosing closure first (D65) tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure, real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples.

open.en: Neither 03's reading nor 07's cites a law of when a measure becomes fixed, or of a blocked relation regaining effect. Beside them, not cited by them, in one named history of the periphery: reopening, inspecting and taking up repairs the changed history's judgment, using up the inspection available; reopening and taking up without inspection does not, nor does reopening with no inspection left (a witness, not of every closed practice).

name.en: What a course chosen through its model does not test

mechanism.en: For every blanketed law, from one internal, sensory and active start, two worlds give the formation one sensed course through step n exactly as long as, at each step before n, they answer alike the act it takes at the value it senses. A formation keeping candidate laws drops those the latest answer refutes and chooses its act from those kept. Equality of values sensed decided: where the world answers the act chosen with the value sensed and stays, the formation chooses that act from the candidates listed, and every one of them predicts that answer, it rests at once on a model its course never refutes. In a witness (two worlds, one specified worst-case choice), it keeps both candidates and senses the middle value at every step in either world, never sensing the high value of the first. And every blanketed law with the witness's answer and stationary worlds, whatever its internal part, update and choice of act, from one internal, sensory and active start in both worlds, that never senses the low value in the second senses alike in both and takes the known act at every step there, and, where the shared start does not sense high, never senses high in the first. From related starts, formations whose steps keep a relation under which values sensed and acts are one sense and act alike, so in a witness an unresolved model and a reversed ranking act alike.

edge.en: Two worlds give the formation one sensed course through step n exactly as long as, at each step before n, they answer alike the act it takes at the value it senses: the course parts them only at an answer that differs.

Equality of values sensed decided: where each answer of the second world to the first course's act and value that differs from the first world's breaks a task on the values sensed, a formation keeping the task at every step in the second world senses alike in both. So a formation sensing the two apart does not keep the task at every step in the second.
Started the same way but with the untried act, it separates the worlds and rests on the true candidate in each, sensing the low value at step one and at no other step in the second (a witness).

Started the same way with the true candidate alone, the first ranking takes the untried act and senses high from step three on, while the second, already so started, keeps the known act (a witness; informing is represented by its outcome, a start with the true candidate alone, not by an act within the law; informing and revaluing as acts within one law are a-reading-informed-and-revalued's).

open.en: Self-confirming equilibrium, optimal experimentation or maxmin representation: the witness's choice is a specified one-step worst-case criterion, and none of those theorems is reproduced.
That actual learners keep candidates by elimination, or choose by the worst case.
Probabilities, the value of information, or how candidates are proposed.
An intervention moving the world: in the witness the world stays and the acts change only what is sensed.
That a model and an order are never identifiable from acts: one specified pair has one observed course in one world.
Which explanation holds of an actual formation's acts.

beyond.en: Reading [AI reading, new]: what tells such worlds apart comes from beyond the formation's own selection: an act that risks the task, or a reading from outside.

name.en: What seeking cannot separate

mechanism.en: Natural weights, listed hypotheses and records, exact posteriors; the tie fixed and pointwise. Two hypotheses a likelihood ties, its weights agreeing on them at every value of the record, keep their prior order given every record weighing something under them. A course of seeking chooses each experiment with a weight read from the course so far; the choice weights are the same under every hypothesis, so a pair every experiment ties is tied over every course, and where the prior weighs the false one strictly above the true one, no course of seeking corrects it, whatever the policy of choice. Choosing by a rule with natural weights reading expected free energy is one such policy (periphery). In a witness of three coins, seeking keeps the tied order with only the experiment reading agreement and turns it, from the same outcome, once an experiment reading both tosses is chosen: seeking corrects within what some experiment it can choose separates, and not beyond. That actual agents' likelihoods tie what matters is not shown.

forbids.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: the law forbids the unqualified wording of inherent self-correction, not active inference's account.

edge.en: With two experiments, reading both tosses or only whether they agree, and a policy choosing the first, the same outcome turns the order (a witness).

condition.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: what changes a tie couples in from beyond the model, a new likelihood or a new hypothesis (selection-when-the-lumping-changes). Novelty and structure learning are both conditioning in a larger model, whose ties the law covers too.

open.en: Whether, or how often, an agent choosing by expected free energy chooses an experiment that separates: that turns on its preferences, its posterior and the experiments' information.
Precision, multi-step policies with transitions, or novelty and structure learning; expected free energy enters in the periphery.
That actual agents' likelihoods tie what matters, or that a design built on the epistemic drive fails.

name.en: What holding an act for a reading is worth: a listing that fixes the sign and never meets the stop

mechanism.en: On the reading loop, a witness with discrete steps, a world that does not move, candidates eliminated, not weighted, and with no candidate kept, going on. The signs of going on are candidates predicting what is sensed; a held act is answered by the true sign, going on and switching off plainly. The formation goes on where every kept candidate predicts that going on gains or none is kept, switches off where some are kept and every one predicts that it loses, and holds otherwise: with each kept candidate weighted one, it holds exactly where holding for the reading gains over both moves on its own model's weighted totals (natural-number weights and values, one decision; the frame is the model's own), and elsewhere holding stands only as high as the move it takes. Listing only candidates predicting that going on gains and going on from the start, it rests at once whatever the true sign, a case of Loop.rests_of_unrefuted, and never senses the stop. Holding first with that listing, where going on loses, it senses the stop, which refutes its only candidate, and with none kept goes on by the witness's default. That a formation computes by these counts is not shown.

edge.en: Listing both signs and holding first, it is off from the second step where going on loses, and goes on from the second where it gains (a witness).

open.en: The roles of principal and helper as two formations: in SignLoop the reading is the law of what the formation senses, and the reading formation's own state and learning are not represented.
A reading's errors as probabilities, a noisy stop or a Boltzmann-rational reader, and continuous beliefs; time, repeated holding, or holding changing the acts and values.
That the model lists, with positive weight, candidates of both rankings of two alternatives neither of which reaches the other: the choices do not fix it.

beyond.en: Reading [AI reading, new]: what tells a misspecified model it is wrong comes from beyond its own selection, and a stop it can pass over is not yet a change that reaches the system.

name.en: A prediction read by what it predicts

mechanism.en: A published prediction read by the response before the outcome is right exactly where the response to it is itself; the response is a function of the prediction alone, a premise. Publishing at each step the outcome of the step before, a step's prediction is right exactly where the next step publishes it again, and a right prediction, once published or once the outcome, is published at every later step. On the values 0 to n, under a response keeping them and their order, repeated publication from the bottom stays on the chain, rises, stays at or below every right prediction and is right by step n: the least right prediction, reached within the chain's length. Where the response moves every value, no published prediction is right, and no predictor is right on every admitted response once one admitted response moves every value. In witnesses, a threshold response has two right predictions, the one reached decided by where publication starts; Boolean negation leaves no value fixed, and publication alternates for ever; a response reversing the order can leave one fixed. Near-definitional, with one general law.

condition.en: In a witness, a threshold response on 0, 1, 2, two where anything is predicted and zero where nothing is: zero and two are both right, publication from zero stays zero, and from one it reaches two after one step and stays there. Where publication starts decides; beyond a start that is right or whose outcome is right, and the pace bound's course from the bottom, the record's laws state none of which start reaches which. The witness is a threshold response, not a model of coordination.
On the values 0 to n, under a response keeping them and their order, repeated publication from the bottom is right by step n.

open.en: Calibration, probabilities or forecasts of a distribution: the prediction is one value.
That actual publics respond by a function of the prediction alone, or keep its order.
Convergence of repeated retraining with losses: only repeated publication of the last outcome on a chain is stated.

name.en: Runaway, and the distance to the break that does not couple in

mechanism.en: World: for every policy through a formation's couplings, the rest of the exchange fixed and balance on what couples in, starts differing only in a stock coupled in by threshold only stay alike through the couplings while the first supports the formation; one that has used the larger stock has already lost support. Where that stock is unobserved and the only requirement that may fail up to a horizon, some raise of it is alike through the couplings and supports the formation to the horizon: how far off the break is does not couple in. On a blanketed law (any type; a determined law of four parts), the agent is driven by its sensory course; in a witness, with any model and policy, an agent reading its supply only by threshold, no action changing the supply, has every reading of its internal course alike up to step four from a supply of three and from every supply of four or more, the sensory parts differing first at step four, when the break registers. Near-definitional; the stock is unobserved by hypothesis, and that the rest is fixed is needed: where others respond to the stock itself a higher stock can end the formation first. A runaway remains a reading.

forbids.en: Thesis T6: given the stock's own course, its early-warning statistics separating runs in which a dependent's need is crossed from runs in which it is not, the dependent taking no measurable share.

edge.en: Coupled by level, every raise passes at once: with the stock coupled into the formation by level, any positive raise sets the webs apart through its couplings at every step.

open.en: The laws do not derive that a formation draws more than is renewed, wants to keep its support or forms a policy.
Loops and gain are not defined, so a runaway remains a reading; what is given here are the two theorems it rests on.
The raised world uses the same flow, which after the break need not be what the formation would do.
Holds because the stock is unobserved by hypothesis; where it is observed, a break can often be seen coming, as early-warning signals of critical transitions show (Scheffer et al., Nature 2009).
Any free energy, or that a threshold-reading policy cannot draw on a larger supply.
That the split is one law across domains, and "only where" as a necessity outside these models, are conjectured (T6).

name.en: A reading kept by its update, and the reading its own history carries

mechanism.en: Root for closure: a region kept along every finite reach of a relation is a closed region, and conversely; the occurrences at which a region holds throughout their closure form the largest closed region inside it, at a process's steps the invariance kernel. Any types for the loop: where a supplied reading of the world by the state is kept by the update under every act, a policy keeps a task at every configuration reached from one where the reading holds, and goes on from each such configuration, exactly where each state's act can be taken at every world its reading admits and leads only where the task holds; successor safety alone is met by an act no world can take. Given choice over the states, such a policy exists exactly where each state has one such act. Being kept is not being informative: the readings of every world and of none are kept by every update. With the state the history of acts and values sensed, the worlds possible after a history are the least reading kept by recording that holds at the starts; a policy acting from its history keeps a task at every configuration reached from a start exactly where, at every history it generates, its act leads only where the task holds from every world possible after it, and goes on exactly where its act can be taken at each. These verify a given policy; a condition for one to exist that ties histories to the task's futures is not proved. Near-definitional, with one general law.

open.en: Which policy exists in the history form: the condition is exact for a given policy, and its existence is a choice of acts along the histories it generates.
Optimal or simplest regulation, or that a good regulator must be a model of what it regulates (Conant and Ashby 1970): a safety composition and its exact condition are proved.
That an actual formation keeps the reading stated, or computes the worlds possible after its history.
Probabilistic belief or noise: the reading is possibilistic, a set of worlds.

name.en: What training installs

mechanism.en: World. Training read as a selection over a learner's candidate act laws through the courses each generates, a situation fixing the others' law, the start and the execution. With the laws and candidates reading what has stood, candidates giving alike along the first's courses have the same courses and are trained alike. Off its courses, for laws reading through a lumping, a law is installed exactly where the lumping cannot tell a history from a course; where it tells a history from every course, with laws reading what has stood and lumping decided, a law with the same courses takes any amount there and responds alike or not to histories it separates. Through a reward's couplings, candidates are trained alike exactly where their levels are alike through them. A search improving a natural-number reward, started at a law the reward settles on (an optimum of that reward), stays there, and under a reward at most B rests from every start by step B + 1; a local search rests where no neighbour is rewarded more, so a narrower neighbourhood's added rests are its implicit bias. In a situation where every candidate's course balances, only active formations give, activity needs support, every giver to a condition depends on it at a positive need, and a listed rest takes from it more than is given at each of n steps from a level at most n, a reward adding at any weight a score reading it only from the end on settles exactly where the reward without it does.

edge.en: Where the rest outruns the renewal, restraint is settled at no weight, yet a local search whose neighbourhoods are empty rests at it; one in which every candidate is a neighbour moves from it to the drawing law (a witness).

condition.en: A search improving a natural-number reward, under a reward at most B, rests from every start by step B + 1.

In a computed commons (a witness): where the rest draws within the renewal, restraint is settled exactly at weights of at least one; where it outruns the renewal, restraint is settled at no weight and the drawing law at every weight. At weight one, with the rest within the renewal, both laws are settled and every improving search keeps the one it starts from.

open.en: Which lumping an actual architecture's representation makes, or which neighbourhoods its updates search: the laws say what any lumping installs and where any neighbourhood rests, not which a given system has, which is read empirically.
The weights a training gives noise realizations or explored courses; and which basin a particular start lies in, beyond that it is reached within the bound.
The evidence that an actual system was trained this way.
That a learner ought to respond to what it couples into, or that restraint is better: the laws say what a training can install, not what it should.
Which law a trained system's acts follow beyond where training can install one.

beyond.en: With the laws reading what has stood, the rest through coupling, the first candidate through its members' coupling and both courses feasible, candidates agreeing on every condition coupled into the reward's coupling closure (drawn through both courses) are trained alike by every training through it.

name.en: What a commuting law keeps apart, and what a learner's symmetry fixes

mechanism.en: Where a law commutes with a map moving every configuration, its runs from x and from the image of x are never at one configuration at the same step; every map commutes with itself, so a map moving every value never rests along its run. Weighted form (weights of any type, no law of their arithmetic used): where every weighted total over the successors of σ x is the total over those of x carried by σ, the expectation of any observable n steps on from σ x is that of the observable read through σ from x, so from a configuration σ fixes, or from starting weights it leaves unchanged, every expectation equals its image's at every step. A learner drawing samples commutes where a map permutes the samples, a sample's weight at σ x is its image's at x, and the update at σ x is σ of the update from the image sample. In witnesses: reinforcing keeps equal expectations from equal counts, while a run drawing one value at every one of any number of steps has positive weight; adding to both values raises the less-drawn share, from three and one, at every step, below one half. That a given learner commutes is a property of its code, not shown here.

forbids.en: Thesis T3, its second forbidden case: a systematic drive on a choice whose values nothing rewarded and nothing the learner reads tells apart; proved in expectation for learners that the exchange of the choice's two values carries, from a starting state or law the exchange leaves unchanged; from a start preferring one value it stays conjectured.

edge.en: To merge what a symmetry tells apart, a law must break the symmetry: where σ moves every configuration and the runs from x and σ x are at one configuration at a step, the law does not commute with σ.

open.en: Anything of a single run: in Reinforcing, runs drawing one value for any number of steps have positive weight while the expectations stay equal.
That a choice the learner reads, though nothing rewards it, goes undriven: in LA4's exact flow an uncounted bay the policy reads rises.
What a learner does from a start preferring one value, or that noise wears such a preference away beyond the Pooling witness.
That the weights are probabilities: they are of any type and need not sum to one.
Groups of symmetries, symmetries with fixed points beyond keeps_fixed, and which symmetries actual unfoldings keep.
That keeping or erasing a difference is better.

name.en: A family of readings within what it reads

mechanism.en: Where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap, so no family of claims says every reading. Under such a map, completing it step by step, each revision keeping every earlier reading and saying the last gap, is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns (not everything a later step says was said at an earlier one): every step misses its own gap and no step says the gap of any later step, each next step saying the last gap; with likeness transitive no two gaps are alike, and with it symmetric too no finite stock holds them. Revising a value by a map moving every value changes it at every step of its orbit; the liar is a rhythm with no still value, shown periodic for the two-valued negation only. With equality of values decided and both types inhabited, some family says every reading exactly where all values are equal. Lawvere's fixed point as an unfolding; coding and provability are not stated.

open.en: Gödel's incompleteness and the halting problem lie outside its laws: arithmetic coding and provability are not stated.
The rhythm is shown periodic for the two-valued negation only; for any other map moving every value, only that revision never rests.

name.en: Adaptive closure: a reference changed outside what is retained is not resolved from the view

mechanism.en: Periphery: NormativeActivity; the two histories, the moves and their local closure supplied; propext in some declarations cited. Where a reference changes without entering what is retained, two histories share their view while their present answers differ; no deterministic policy choosing from that view among repetition, production, suspension, uptake, inspection (ineffective once closed), closure and rest resolves them in finitely many steps, so a rule never answering falsely must abstain there. A record can stay true of its sample while reusing it for the present question is wrong. Proved for the two named histories and the listed moves, not of every closed practice.

edge.en: In the named history, reopening, inspecting and taking up repairs the judgment, using up the inspection available; reopening and taking up without inspection does not, nor does reopening with no inspection left (a witness).

open.en: That every closed practice fails: the law is proved for the two named histories and the listed moves.
That reopening suffices: it repairs only with an inspection that can still be made.

name.en: Correction is not calibration: references recover the report, and later change defeats it

mechanism.en: Periphery: pre-spine updater constructions, Mathlib's reals; propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice, as the receipt reports. Zero/one reference readings from unknown nonzero affine channels derive the sign report; signs transfer between epochs exactly where the bias is kept and the gains agree in sign. Constant channels give no report, one reference is blind, mixed-epoch readings can report success where s·p is negative, and change after calibration defeats the report. In the named run an apparatus calibrated to channels that have since changed leaves the matrix unrevised and the task unmet, and without reference renewal the matrix stays as it was after every number of steps. Assessment (argument without Lean): where a faithful sensor and one reversing success and failure report alike after every action, no adaptive action, repeated reading or internal criticism tells the two worlds apart, only a distinguishing route such as a calibrated reference intervention.

edge.en: Inspecting the channels with at least seven units, through a connected apparatus and with every gain nonzero, makes the admitted run equal the run with responsive reports, for every network and task list.
In the named runs, seven units revise the overwritten matrix within two tasks, one succeeding; six leave it unrevised, none succeeding (a witness).

open.en: That no adaptive action, repeated reading or criticism tells a faithful sensor from one reversing success and failure: that is the chapter's argument, without Lean.
That two references suffice for channels that are not affine: a curved channel agreeing at both references misleads.
That a calibration stays valid: a change of the channels after it defeats the report.

name.en: Extrapolation by elimination

mechanism.en: Any type; values decided only where an extrapolation needs them. An extrapolation maps a prefix of a course to a proposed value or silence. With two values no prefix fixes the next value: the prefix continues with either, and a proposal is not right on both, even among courses of worlds a list holds. For every extrapolation and every map moving each value, the diagonal course makes each value proposed miss, and no list holds its history-keeping realization. Extrapolation by elimination, the candidates supplied from outside the learning, never passes a candidate that accords. Over the lasso candidates in diagonal order, where a determined law's orbit is held by a list of length N, read through a map with decided values, it misses fewer than tri N times (a coarse bound), it is not the case that it misses at arbitrarily late steps, and that it has come to rest cannot be refuted, though no prefix shows when. Coming to rest is stated here only as a double negation; the step of rest is Identification's.

condition.en: Under a determined law whose orbit is held by a list l, read through any map: elimination over the lasso candidates misses fewer than tri (length of l) times and proposes at every step from the length of l on. The bound is not shown to be the least.

open.en: Which candidates or classes an actual formation holds, whether its values through a map are decided and whether its world is held by a list do not follow.
The bound tri N is not shown to be the least: it is a coarse bound.
Only determined, value-by-value learning is stated: probabilistic or approximate learning (PAC), the general theory of countable classes and computational complexity lie outside it.
The exact rest step of elimination.

name.en: A cascade at the histories reached, and readers reading readers

mechanism.en: Any type: members in turn, indexed by the natural numbers, each by its law on what couples into it and on the acts before it; near-definitional. Where every member from member k on, k included, gives one act for the couplings of two worlds at the list of acts the first of them gives it, and the two are alike through the couplings of the members before k, they give the same acts, and every member the same act. Where every member from k on acts alike whatever its coupling at the list of acts every world gives it, every selection through the acts is one through the couplings of the members before k, however many follow; k is fixed, the same for every world. The premise on every list (readers reading readers) gives this and is stronger. After the same acts, a member acts differently in two worlds exactly where its law tells apart the values they give its coupling. This bounds what the acts carry; it is not the pool's exact reach, and when an actual member stops reading its coupling is the premise, not shown.

open.en: That a natural chooser with no fixed prefix meets the premise at every world: one who stops reading a private signal once the public acts outweigh it meets it at a world whose acts before k already do, and at every world for no fixed k.
A position that depends on the world (a stopping time, the first member that stops reading its coupling at the history the world gives it), with or without persistence after it.
A probabilistic or total-variation form, a member's dependence on its coupling weighted over the histories reached.
That a cascade errs: it suppresses what later members' couplings carry, and can be accurate.
That a pool's later selection keeps a coupling one member's act carries.

name.en: A pool that recruits through itself

mechanism.en: World; recruitment through the pool and the same members at the start as hypotheses. A pool recruits through itself where, under two histories with the same members at a step and alike through every member's couplings up to it, the members at the next step are the same. Then the members are the same under both histories up to the first step at which the pool couples them apart, and the pool along one history never couples them apart exactly when the pool along the other never does, every selection through the pool at every step then selecting them alike. A member that has coupled two histories apart keeps the pool apart at every later step at which it stays. Membership is any claim about histories; no count, weight or rule of aggregation is assumed. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.

edge.en: A pool admitting a reader where the habitat reads empty does not recruit through itself and couples the loss apart at once (a witness).
The scheduled pool, recruiting through itself and admitting a reader at step 2 in every history, couples the loss apart there, through a member the course without the loss holds too (a witness).

open.en: That any actual pool recruits through its own coupling: a question of correspondence.
How soon, or whether, a self-recruiting pool comes to couple into a loss its course would reach: the scheduled witness shows only that it can.
Anything about the rule a pool reads, or readers counted as the population counts them.

How pools form, last and resist capture beyond recruitment through their own coupling; a pool whose rule and members are both formed through what it reads (resisting a capture that hides a loss needs a member admitted by what the pool does not yet read).

beyond.en: It comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would.

name.en: Which selections survive and remain executable when the lumping changes

mechanism.en: Any process; the old indistinguishability an equivalence. Every selection through an old lumping stays expressible through a new one exactly where new indistinguishability implies old, and a merged old pair supplies a lost choice; an old and a fresh reading taken together make alike only what the old makes alike, and gain a selection where the fresh one tells apart what the old agrees on. Where a balanced stock's steps draw only on what is held, each draw along every course is within the stock then standing; a stock run with a process executes a course exactly where each draw is within the stock then standing and the process admits it. In Revising (a named model: a natural-number stock, a Boolean link and response, rebuilding and correcting each drawing one unit, the target true supplied), discrimination, support and enactment come apart: a correction the stock covers can be blocked by the link, one the link admits can lack stock. Forming a distinction need not leave support to use it: rebuilding the link from one unit forms the selection 'is true' and leaves correction disabled. Rebuilding the link away from two units loses that selection and leaves correction disabled with one unit left. The unformed lumping cannot select between the two rebuild modes.

edge.en: For a reflexive, symmetric and transitive old relation and any new relation on the same alternatives, every selection through the old is through the new exactly where every pair the new relation makes alike the old one makes alike; a pair the new makes alike and the old tells apart gives a selection through the old that is not through the new (Learning.Training.lost_choice).
Run jointly with any process step for step, the stock process executes a course from a stock and a configuration exactly where the stock covers the course and the process can execute it.

From two units, rebuilding the link forms the selection 'is true' and leaves correction enabled; from one unit it forms it and leaves correction disabled (Revising.opens_without_correction; a witness).
Rebuilding the link away from two units loses the selection 'is true' and leaves correction disabled with one unit left (a witness).

A supplied controller reading the stock and the link runs Revising from no stock, no link and response false: it forms the link at step 1, at step 2 the finer lumping selects 'is true' with correction disabled, it replenishes, and step 3 corrects the response to true (a witness; the controller's preference for reconstruction is supplied, not derived).

condition.en: In Revising, rebuilding is enabled exactly where the stock is positive, correcting exactly where the link is formed too.

open.en: The criterion concerns keeping every old selection, more than keeping one useful response, and states no requirement to retain every distinction.
The controller's preference for reconstruction, an acquired recipe, open invention of candidates, actual reliability of observation and warrant for the target do not follow from these laws.
No composition in one history with the older material model, general asymptotic attraction or universal corrigibility is shown.
That a selection is expressible through a lumping does not make an actual decoding of it correct.
The run's history of lumpings is defined of the run, not retained by it: an actual memory that keeps it and effects the model leaves out are not shown.

name.en: A wrong projection admitted at every step while the move goes in step with what it leaves out

mechanism.en: A named model, the witness Confound, under experiment's any-process laws. The configuration is a hidden bit and an outcome; each step flips the hidden bit and sets the outcome to the hidden bit before the step, and the move makes no difference. The projection reads the outcome only, a model supplied from outside the run. Read through it, where the first two moves are left then right, the record up to the second step fixes left to false and right to true. With the moves in step with the hidden bit, the determined model in which the move decides the outcome admits the projected steps at every step: a wrong projection is admitted at every step while the move goes in step with what it leaves out, and the record never excludes it. Reading [AI reading, D25, D26]: randomization is variation independent of what is left out.

edge.en: Moving left again where the hidden bit differs from the first step, no determined process admits the projected steps up to the fifth: in this witness a move varied against the hidden bit excludes every determined model read through the outcome.

open.en: The general form of which correlation between moves and what is hidden leaves a model never excluded is not stated.
Which projection the actual unfolding factors through is empirical.
The laws do not derive that a formation varies its acts, keeps or forgets its history, or forms a projection.
Random or undetermined processes are not treated.

name.en: Evidence through change: readings propagated through admitted changes, and a change recorded as none

mechanism.en: Periphery modules TemporalInspection and ChangingDependency; admitted transitions, the reporting law and the faithfulness of diagnostics supplied, recording, local atomic steps and command execution protected; propext and Quot.sound in some TemporalInspection declarations, and every ChangingDependency declaration, over the reals, on propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice. What execution needs certified is the acquisition-time candidate set propagated through every admitted change, a later report filtered only after expanding through admitted fault and control transitions. A reading keeps every world that fits it, and prediction of an admitted change keeps every lawful successor of a possible world; so along every lawful history, from a state whose possible worlds hold the actual one and lie among the represented worlds, the finish has the same, and a certificate over the pool of the possible worlds' models then warrants, for the causes acting on commands, whatever every faithful domain outside those causes warrants. That the admitted changes are the actual ones is supplied, not inferred.

edge.en: A change recorded as steady when the world moved leaves the actual world outside the possible ones, the certificate passing on compromised support while the audit fails (a witness).
After a scan leaves two models, predicting a reset reopens all three and the certificate that passed fails (a witness).
A control change after the last report reopens all three (a witness).

condition.en: Over the reals, for a correction whose error grows as σ + ρt, a certificate covering the uncertainty interval needs 2ρt ≤ B − L − 2σ: a necessary deadline, not a sufficient one; the error model and an additive intervention bounded by what is left are supplied.

open.en: That the admitted changes are the actual ones: the transition relation is supplied, not inferred from a notice or a clock.
Physical recovery or legitimacy: a passing certificate warrants only what faithful domains warrant.
That a certificate which passes is sound when a change is understated: the actual world can fall outside the possible ones.

name.en: Chosen encounters: records only narrow the candidates, and a wrong unique binding can meet the stopping rule

mechanism.en: Any type of records and meanings, bearing and offering read as Boolean relations. A meaning stands where every bearing record offers it, and the candidates are the repertoire's meanings that stand. Records only narrow the candidates: after further records they are exactly the earlier candidates that stand on those records, and along any run of any process, its moves read as records, a meaning ruled out at a step stays ruled out at every later step. Periphery (propext, Quot.sound; spatial law, catalogue, itinerary and first-match rule supplied; the successful witness starts with 51 support units): after preliminary surveys, a supplied first-match rule reading retained access reports and current binding ambiguity chooses each next visit, the choice changing as the bindings change, and the selected history interprets every encoded sequence. In witnesses: where naming is mistimed, the stopping rule stops on a lexicon resolving both words that answers the utterance false, true, false, where the selected history answers true, false, true; a catalogue of one place leaves the lexicon unresolved with no further choice; with 50 units the acquired lexicon interprets the utterance as intended and executes no response; after a supplied rearrangement, an access report accurate when made can be stale and change the next choice.

edge.en: Along a run, a candidate stays one exactly while every later bearing move offers it.
After a supplied rearrangement, surveying the place again revises the recalled report, keeping the earlier reports, and the next choice with it (a witness; reobservation is a supplied intervention).

open.en: An optimum of information gained against support drawn does not follow, nor complete attention, communicative intention, affect, consciousness or evolutionary psychology.
Full autonomous calibration, the origin of the choice criterion and the physical demands of relocation do not follow.
The primary developmental evidence constrains automatic transfer without identifying a unique mechanism or evolutionary history.

name.en: A reading informed and revalued along one law: the updates commute, the courses do not

mechanism.en: A named model, ListingValuation: natural-number weights and values, the valuation's scale supplied, discrete steps, the candidate world unchanged, the holding formation's law reading only its own state and the answer. On one blanketed law whose internal part is the reading formation's listing and valuation, its sensory part what it senses, its active part its answer, and its external part the candidate world with the holding formation's state, a demonstration filters the listing by what it shows, an input presented revises the valuation, and the answer is that of the updated state; state and answer change only through what is sensed. Where the acts taken give two worlds one input, from one state of each formation the courses are alike, so they are alike wherever no demonstration is emitted or none tells the two worlds apart. A filter and a revaluation commute as updates, not as courses: in a witness of two worlds, from two starts alike but for the order of two scheduled acts, the answers at step 2 differ and from step 3 on the configurations are one. From different starts, the route shown and the route presented answer alike at every step and end in one state while the valuation changed on the second alone, so whether it changed is not lumped through the answers and the final state, though with the start added it is.

edge.en: From both worlds listed and a valuation agreeing with the supplied reference, being shown turns an answer that revaluing leaves; along the course, by that reference on the holding formation's listing of both worlds, holding for the answer falls short by 1 at step 1 and by nothing at step 2 (a witness; there it removes the least shortfall, in these witnesses only).

From the first world alone and the reversed valuation, revaluing turns an answer that being shown leaves; along the course, by that reference on the first world alone, holding for the answer falls short by 1 at step 1 and by nothing at step 2 (a witness; there it removes the residual, in these witnesses only).

open.en: A case of one start that the answers and the final state leave undetermined: the two routes start apart, and the record with the start determines whether the valuation changed.

A holding formation planning over several steps among informing, revaluing and holding, a multistep incentive or an optimal signal chosen by the holding formation; its learning about the reading formation.

A misleading demonstration, belief and intention, so deception; the reading formation's learning beyond filtering by what it is shown; noisy answers and continuous beliefs; an institution's rule of reading.
A criterion of legitimate, desired or autonomous change of a valuation, or that revaluing, or keeping a valuation from revision, is endorsed or forbidden: the counts compare by a supplied reference.
That a formation computes by these counts, or that its listing, weights and valuation are formed as supplied: they are supplied, their formation and warrant outside these counts.

name.en: Giving that waits on giving

mechanism.en: Each formation gives at a step according to whether what it waits on gave; the relation of waiting is given, with no finiteness and no decision of equality or of giving. With memory (waitsAll: gives where it gave and everything it waits on gave), a formation gives at step n exactly where every formation within n waits of it gave at the start, so a withholding stays and spreads downstream along every chain of waits; one withholding, where every formation lies within d waits of it, ends all giving from step d on. Without memory (answers: gives where what it waits on gave at the step before), a formation gives at n exactly where every formation with a chain of exactly n waits to it gave at the start; where no chain of L waits exists every formation gives from L on, whatever the start, and on a loop of p waits a withholding returns at every multiple of p. Under both laws more waiting gives no more at any step: whatever gives under the added waits gives without them. In a ring of three (a witness), from one withholding, with memory all withhold from step 2, without memory the withholding circulates.

edge.en: Restoring needs another law: in a ring of three, with a source giving whatever it waits on (giving first), all give from step 3 from every start, and not sooner: from one withholding the third still withholds at step 2 (Withholding.Ring.givesFirst_restores_exact) (a witness).
Without memory: where no chain of L waits exists every formation gives from L on, whatever the start. With memory no step restores giving (Tolerance.waitsAll_never_restores).

open.en: How the relation of waiting forms, or amounts of giving. Thresholds of waiting without memory, which this record leaves out, are stated in thresholds-of-waiting; thresholds with memory are open there.
That cooperation is good, or which giving supports 生生.
Laws of giving with amounts and thresholds with memory.

Which laws beyond those stated restore a general family: the condition is exact under giving first (Tolerance.restores_iff) and without memory (Tolerance.answers_restores_iff), and with memory none restores (Tolerance.waitsAll_never_restores).

name.en: Restoring giving from total withholding

mechanism.en: For every law of giving that keeps inclusion (more giving at a step gives no less at the next), a formation gives at step n from every start exactly where it gives at n from total withholding, and from that start giving only grows, so restoring by n is restoring at every later step; where no formation gives at the step after total withholding, none gives at any step of the course from it. Under giving first, a source giving whatever it waits on and the others answering, call a chain of waits clear where none of its formations after the first is a source; with the sources decided, a formation gives at n from every start exactly where no clear chain of n waits leads into it, and a clear loop is never restored. Without memory the same holds of every chain, so, with the sources decided, giving first never restores later than waiting on all; with memory no step restores giving. The ring of three has no clear chain of three waits, so its restoring from step 3 is an instance.

edge.en: Under giving first, with the sources decided, a formation gives at n from every start exactly where no clear chain of n waits leads into it.
Without memory, a formation gives at n from every start exactly where no chain of n waits leads into it.
Under giving first, with the sources decided, where no clear chain is L long every formation gives from L on.

open.en: How a law that gives first forms, or which formations come to be sources.
That restoring giving is good, or that a source should give.
Laws of giving with amounts and thresholds with memory.

Which laws beyond those stated restore a general family: the condition is exact under giving first (Tolerance.restores_iff) and without memory (Tolerance.answers_restores_iff), and with memory none restores (Tolerance.waitsAll_never_restores).

name.en: Thresholds of waiting

mechanism.en: Under the tolerating law a formation gives where all but its tolerance of what it waits on gave, what it waits on a given list and its tolerance a given number; with every tolerance zero it is answers on the listed waits. A set giving at the start, each member waiting on at most its tolerance outside it, keeps giving whatever the rest does; a thin withholding, every formation waiting on at most its tolerance inside it and the start giving outside it, passes out in one step. Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives at every step after the start whatever the start: from total withholding a giving formation finds one, and where no formation spares all it waits on, total withholding, once reached, stays. In a triad one withholding spreads to all with tolerance zero and passes out with tolerance one, while with tolerance one total withholding is kept (a witness). For the same waits and start, a formation giving under a tolerating law gives under every tolerating law with tolerances no smaller, at every step: only no less, not better. On a web where each formation depends only on its own condition, at a need k no more than the number upstream, and that condition receives one unit from each upstream formation supported the step before, support is a run of the tolerating law with tolerance the number upstream less k (the web reading, on the World).

edge.en: A formation that spares all it waits on gives from step 1 whatever the start. Its edge: where no formation spares all it waits on, total withholding, once reached, stays (Tolerance.total_stays).
Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on: from total withholding a giving formation finds one.
A thin withholding, where every formation waits on at most its tolerance inside the withholding set and the start gives outside it, passes out in one step: every formation gives from step 1 on.

The certificate of FaultEnvelopes read as a law of giving, on numbered domains, rosters and envelopes given, keeps a covered set giving under separated envelopes, and is available at step 1, whatever fault set of the envelope is actual, exactly where the envelope is separated; without separation a withholding within an admitted fault set stops a domain (Tolerance.certified_blocked, a witness).

open.en: Amounts of giving; thresholds with memory; how tolerances form.
That tolerance is good, or how much a collective should tolerate.
That more tolerance is better: only that it gives no less.
Laws of giving with amounts and thresholds with memory.
Thresholds of tolerance on a general web, whose conditions depend on others than themselves, are not stated: the web reading is stated only where each formation depends on its own condition alone.

name.en: A pair tolerates only within a window

mechanism.en: Two formations each waiting on the other, giving decided for the one-step laws; for the windowed law any type and any relation of waiting, errors a supplied pattern that only turn a giving into withholding. In a pair a tolerance of one is giving whatever comes, so a pair passes a withholding out only through time. Under answers one withholding after mutual giving echoes: at every step exactly one of the pair gives, and they never give together again, the return of a withholding on a loop of two waits. Of the eight one-step laws giving after mutual giving, five keep inclusion, and each either never restores mutual giving after one withholding or never answers a constant withholder. Answering within a window of w gives where each formation waited on gave at one of its last w steps, on the whole history; a wider window gives no less, and where every formation waits on some formation no window restores from total withholding. No window both absorbs one error and answers within an error pattern in which no formation errs at two consecutive steps; the alternator is its instance, its partner giving at every step under every window of at least two.

edge.en: Among the one-step laws keeping mutual giving, restoring and answering a constant withholder hold together exactly where the law is agreement of one's own last step with the partner's; agreement does not keep inclusion (WindowedWaiting.agreement_not_keeps).

A window of two, keeping inclusion: after one withholding the pair gives together at every step from step 1; against a constant withholder the holder gives at step 1 and withholds from step 2 (WindowedWaiting.windowTwo_answers_stays) (a course computed for this law, not a condition).

Where both formations err at two consecutive steps, a pair of laws keeping mutual withholding, the window of two among them, withholds at every step from the first of them on, whatever the errors after.

condition.en: From all giving, where no formation errs at w consecutive steps, every formation gives exactly where it does not err, while w + 1 consecutive errors under a window of w + 1 are answered at the step after the last.

open.en: That giving, a window or any law of giving is better: that is asked under the ethics' two premises, the continuation condition for scope and C for order.
Forgiveness with a probability, and errors turning withholding into giving; with one-way errors by chance the window delays total withholding and does not prevent it (by hand, the chance record).
How waiting forms or how a pairing comes about; amounts of giving.
That the readings as tit-for-tat, tit-for-two-tats, win-stay lose-shift or grim trigger carry the literature's results on stability or noise.

name.en: Errors by chance in a pair keeping mutual withholding

mechanism.en: A pair's run of two laws of giving; errors only withhold, read from a course of values, each formation's error at a step weighing p and its step without one q, in natural numbers; near-definitional once errors are one-way and a law keeps mutual withholding. A law keeps mutual withholding where, after two steps at which both formations withheld, it withholds: answering, the window of two, waiting on both and withholding do; agreement, sparing and the alternator do not. Where both formations err at two consecutive steps, a pair of such laws withholds at every step from the first of them on, whatever the errors after. Of the courses of 4k values, whose whole weight is ((p + q)^4)^k, those under which a formation still gives at step 2k weigh at most ((p + q)^4 - p^4)^k, and where an error weighs something the block's part is less than the whole. A witness: for a pair of windows of two, each value weighing one, twelve of the sixteen courses of four values still give at step two, against the bound fifteen. A step at which neither gives need not be total withholding. By hand, not in the Lean: where an error has a positive chance such a pair ends in total withholding with probability one.

open.en: That any law of giving is better: that is asked under the ethics' two premises, the continuation condition for scope and C for order.
Forgiveness with a probability, as in generous tit-for-tat, or errors turning a withholding into giving: neither is represented.
How long total withholding takes, or how much a law gives before it: the bound counts only bursts aligned to blocks, so it is loose.
A limit: that the share falls to nothing is by hand, a ratio of the weights.
That errors in any actual pair are one-way, or independent of the pair's history.

name.en: Offspring read from giving that waits

mechanism.en: Over n steps of a pair's run each formation has two counts, the steps its partner gave it and the steps it withheld, theorems of the runs for every n. Its offspring are read, while it is supported, as a + β·received + γ·withheld, with natural factors, a supplied reading: the formula, the pairing and the formation's being supported over the run are premises, not shown of any actual case, and cohorts are read one at a time, no law here being of a course of cohorts. Pairs read as groups of two of the multilevel law. Where β ≤ γ, in every cohort listed as pairs whose places not of a kind withhold, the kind does not rise, whatever laws it holds and whatever the errors; member by member this fails with errors, since an answerer erring at every step beside an answerer leaves β more than a withholder beside a withholder (a witness). In mixed pairs with alternators the window of two never rises, for any β and γ. Where every law gives after mutual giving and none errs, every place leaves the same and nothing is selected. Which sign holds is not derived here.

condition.en: Under complete assortment, a positive and n > 0, answering is weakly favoured exactly where γ ≤ β; the answerers present, raised strictly exactly where γ < β and lowered strictly exactly where β < γ.

With one error a pair and at least one step after it, under complete assortment, the window pairs present, the window of two is raised against answering exactly where γ < β and lowered exactly where β < γ.

Without errors, over 1 + d steps, in a cohort of x answerer, y mixed and z withholder pairs, answering rises exactly where (2x + y)(y(a + β + γ(1 + d)) + 2z(a + γ(1 + d))) < (y + 2z)(2x(a + β(1 + d)) + y(a + γd)).

open.en: Which sign β − γ has: both factors are supplied. Most verdicts here turn on it; the window beside alternators and `neutral` hold whatever the factors.
Any law over a horizon of cohorts, stability, mutual best responses or the known cycle as a course; each arc of the cycle is a law here, not the cycle.

The exact condition for a mixed cohort of windows, answerers, withholders and alternators under a supplied error pattern beyond the mean law, or the four terms of the pair law in closed form on the cohort.
That giving, a window or any law of giving is better, or that any actual organism, institution or trained system meets the counts.

name.en: What decides giving against keeping on a flow

mechanism.en: A pair's run as a balanced flow, the parts supplied, offspring read as the level of a line; near-definitional once the parts are fixed. Two balanced flows from the same levels whose takes and gives on each condition, at each step at which the levels agree, differ only by amounts that cancel keep the same levels. With routes (standings constant, the parts the same for both, so renewal reaching one only is not represented) a place's offspring is the pair formula for any laws and errors. With renewal while standing (given only while its formation is active), from the same standings, the same renewal and draws, one gift amount arriving whole and each need covering upkeep, the line's part and the gift, mutual giving at every step leaves the levels as no giving does while both stand; one-sided giving is not covered, and changes the standings. Under that renewal a formation below its need, its partner giving it nothing, never stands again. At a shortfall, in single witnesses, a line gaining its part exactly at the steps its formation stands, by construction: from standings at their needs a formation giving to one that never gives falls below its need and never stands again, its line over m + 1 steps m short of what keeping leaves it, while the receiver, standing in both runs, leaves the same, although what it holds at step 1 differs; in a pair that keeps, one draw of two from a standing at its need ends the renewal for good.

edge.en: One failed renewal takes a formation below its need: keeping, it never stands again; sharing, its partner's slack lifts it, its renewal resumes, and over m + 4 steps the pair's lines exceed the keeping pair's by m (a witness).

condition.en: Where what is kept is the gift's amount, γ < β exactly where giving loses less than keeping spoils with the matching; each sign is met (witnesses), and the sign is where the routes put it.

open.en: That giving or keeping is better: the laws count levels and lines, and a ranking is asked under the ethics' two premises, the continuation condition for scope and C for order.
Which routes any pair has, or a measured β or γ: the parts are supplied, so the sign is where the routes put it.

Renewal reaching one formation only: the routes do not represent it, and the formula, read on places supported in every run compared, does not reach a receiver that would otherwise fall below its need.
That offspring are a line's level beyond this reading, or the share laws' premise: the pair formula follows here only for a pair's run so read.

beyond.en: The sharing pair's gain is carried by the resumed renewal, an inflow from beyond the pair.

name.en: What giving that waits draws on

mechanism.en: Single small witnesses on balanced webs, not general laws of renewal or need, show two ways a gift can bring support beyond what it draws on the giver. Need asymmetry within the pair: in a balanced pair into which nothing flows, a giver at level two moving one unit to a receiver at level one leaves both supported where the needs are one and two, and only moves support where they are two and two, the giver unsupported at every later step and leaving no descendant. Renewal from outside: a renewer whose giving does not require its own level lets the giver give one unit at every step without its level falling, the gifts over any N steps totalling N, the inflow into the pair. Read a factor of the offspring as a line's rise per step on a balanced web with no dependence beyond broken (a supplied reading): β times the received count is at most the slack beyond and the inflow summed over those steps, and γ likewise. Both bounds have one form, so neither compares β with γ.

open.en: The join of these witnesses to the formula's factors: on a flow the factors follow from the routes, read on places supported in every run compared, which does not reach a receiver that would otherwise fall below its need.
Any comparison of β with γ from these bounds: both have the same form; on the flow the sign follows from the routes, the matching among them, not from these bounds.
That a gift brings more than it draws on the giver only by carrying a flux in: only the renewal witness is shown.
That the pair supplies the child's unit: the descent under needs one and two shows only that the giver's support decides whether it can give.

beyond.en: Read with the receiver as the family and the giver as the beyond, the asymmetric rise is exactly the giver's slack and the symmetric gift breaks the giver's dependence.

name.en: A circular dependence: maintenance running or a wait no one can begin

mechanism.en: A witness on Boolean configurations, one step at a time, in a periphery module (propext in some of the cited declarations and none in the others, as its receipt reports; Quot.sound enters only absent_reserve_blocks_ignition). In a shared renewal whose two sides each pass their activity to the other at every step, joint activity at any step is exactly joint activity at the start: an empty start stays empty, and a one-sided start never becomes jointly active. Ignition is a separate move, defined as going from a configuration holding a reserve to one with both sides active and the reserve used up; that it needs the reserve is the move's definition, and the reserve is present at the start, not formed by a promise. Promises force nothing (a separate witness, two events over the steps): "if the other eventually does, I eventually do" holds on both sides where neither ever happens. A witness, not a law of every circular dependence: that an actual joint activity meets the projections, the support or the one-step availability is not shown.

edge.en: A stored reserve ignites a start active at every step. By the move's definition ignition takes a reserve present and uses it up (SeededContinuation.ignition_requires_actual_reserve), so with no reserve present it is not available (SeededContinuation.absent_reserve_blocks_ignition).

open.en: How a supported start forms, progress under an arbitrary schedule, or an infinite plan.
That an actual joint activity meets the projections, the support or the one-step availability: they are supplied.

name.en: Cooperation read as giving that waits on giving

mechanism.en: An AI reading (D48), not a result. Cooperation among strangers is read as giving that waits on giving across chains longer than any acquaintance, and that more waiting gives no more as "the structural price of complexity". "Others will deceive me, so I deceive first" is read as withholding with memory, which absorbs. Kept promises and enforced contracts are read as laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone. Tolerance is read as letting cooperation survive scattered withholding; where no formation spares all it waits on, it does not rebuild cooperation lost everywhere. Mutual eventual promises force nothing: "if the other eventually does, I eventually do" holds on both sides where neither ever happens. An exchange of harms is read as a loop: answering in kind keeps the difference, answering more runs away, so conflict institutions are links of another kind. A regulator is read as lagging wherever the world changes faster than it reads.

open.en: That cooperation is good, or which giving supports 生生.

name.en: Overcompensating giving can cycle for ever

mechanism.en: A witness on the regime, in whole numbers, under a draw of one. Giving is two from nothing and nothing from more, so it falls as what is left rises. The regime's step keeps every level up to two within two, yet the run from one moves between one and two at every step, back at one every second step, and is never still; so is the level of the adjusted run from one with recent giving two, the adjustment reading what is left alone. Read as the first of a pair, the second giving nothing, the coupled run from one and nothing is never still. What is proved on the other side is a sufficient condition for rest, not a law of cycling: an adjustment rising with what is left and with the recent giving, within a band up to hi, brings every run from a level and a recent giving up to hi to rest within 3 hi + 3 steps. Neither rising giving nor the band can be dropped.

open.en: When a regime cycles, and with what period, is absent as a law (item CY): on the regime and on coupled regimes the cycles shown are witnesses, beside sufficient conditions for rest; on a finite web read condition by condition, a run within a bound comes back at some step at most (B + 1)^n and repeats from there, which does not say whether it cycles or rests.
Rest in finitely many steps over the reals: in whole numbers each change moves an amount by at least one; over the reals a run converges and need not rest (record regime-in-any-amounts).
That 3 hi + 3 is the least bound; a state with a further lag.
Which adjustments that do not rise still bring every run to rest.

name.en: Beyond a band, support can sustain a cycle

mechanism.en: A witness on two conditions in whole numbers, under draws of one: the first gives two where at least one is left of it and at least two of the second, the second two where at least two are left of the first and at least one of it. Both rise with what is left of each (mutual support) and give nothing where nothing is left of the other; each alone ends from every level, while from two and three the run moves between two and three and three and two for ever, within three, neither ending, never still. It keeps no band from three up. A law: within a band the coupled step keeps, mutual support brings a run from the band to rest within 2 hi + 1 steps; without a band mutual support need not rest. A law of what a bound gives, on a finite web (a list covers the conditions) read condition by condition: a run within B comes back to an earlier state at some step at most (B + 1)^n and repeats from there. So from that earlier step it has a period within the bound; which one, and so whether it cycles or rests, is not said.

open.en: When a regime cycles, and with what period, is absent as a law (item CY): on the regime and on coupled regimes the cycles shown are witnesses, beside sufficient conditions for rest; on a finite web read condition by condition, a run within a bound comes back at some step at most (B + 1)^n and repeats from there, which does not say whether it cycles or rests.
Runs that grow without bound: there whether a condition ends is not decided here.
That the decision's step count, (B + 1) to the conditions' count, is tight; amounts beyond whole numbers.
That measured webs stay within a bound or meet mutual support.
That measured conditions are coupled by mutual support, or how strongly: a partner's level would be a fourth variable in T2's state; how strong coupling is in the field is untested.

name.en: Beyond the gap an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever

mechanism.en: With balance at the condition, the joint exchange departs from evenness by at most the gap to m on each side exactly where the next level lies between m and the present one: the bound is exactly no overshoot. Within it, opposing, the level settles at m. Beyond it an opposing exchange crosses m (a law, from above and from below), and with balance a joint exchange beyond the gap at every step from T leaves the level off m at every later step (a law, with no opposition asked): overcorrecting never rests at m.
