A witness: a balanced exchange opposing the departure at every step and exceeding the gap at every step has its level alternate between 2 and 0 about m = 1, never 1. The two values, and so the level's coming back every second step, are this witness's: the laws above name no value the level comes back to and no period.

edge.en: balanced, and within the gap and opposing at every step from T: the level is m from T plus its gap at T on

condition.en: the joint exchange departs from evenness by at most the gap to m on each side exactly where the next level lies between m and the present one

open.en: That a given system regulates a level, which level, how late it reads, or the size of its step.
That holding a level is good: the laws say what holds it and how wide a band it needs.

name.en: A relay reading late settles or leaves both ends without end

mechanism.en: A law on every balanced run of a relay, not a witness. Reading l steps late, the relay pushes M for a reading below a, pulls M for one above b and rests within. With a <= b, 0 < a, 0 < M and the floor (l + 1)M <= b + 1, every balanced run from every start below a held for its first l + 1 steps settles in the band exactly where a + (l + 1)M <= b + 1. From a held start the relay crosses where its entry at x0 + kM, carried lM further, passes b, and settles where that stays within b. An upward crossing is followed by a downward one and that by an upward one, so after every step the level is somewhere above b and somewhere below a; the start held at a - 1 does this where b + 2 <= a + (l + 1)M. So for the relay, from a held start, the account has a condition and not only a witness of when a course passes both ends without end. That the level returns to one value, or with what period, is not stated: only that each end is passed at arbitrarily late steps. Balance at the condition and the relay are premises; that a given system is one is not shown.

condition.en: with a <= b, 0 < a, 0 < M and the floor (l + 1)M <= b + 1: every balanced run from every start below a held for its first l + 1 steps settles in [a, b] exactly where a + (l + 1)M <= b + 1
past that threshold, with a <= b and the relay balanced at the condition: the start held at a - 1 leaves both ends without end where b + 2 <= a + (l + 1)M

open.en: That a given system regulates a level, which level, how late it reads, or the size of its step.
One policy keeping a band from every start in it under late reading; several regulated levels lumped into one; regulation of several conditions at once.

name.en: The overshooting thermostat with the window open

mechanism.en: A witness, at a margin of three. With the window open the room's rule is the regime's step, a draw of one and then the heater's giving; the heater, reading the level after the exchange, gives two wherever it is below the set level. The course alternates 3 and 4: the run of the regime's Alternation witness shifted by two, though no band holding the set level meets the regime's holding condition, which is proved from the heater and not read off the shift. It returns, so nothing read off it keeps widening. That the rooms are flows of the World is not shown: the laws of regulation on flows are read against their definitions, with no instance theorem.

open.en: That the rooms are flows of the World: the laws of regulation on flows are read against their definitions, with no instance theorem.
That a heated room holds a level the window cannot move: read before the exchange, at a margin of three the window moves both thermostats' levels.
The regions of the unheated room and of the overshooting thermostat, and the unheated room's cold occurrence, at margins other than three.
Gusts, a heater that reads late, and the stages and regions under the variants of the window, the threshold and the reading order, which are checked by hand.

name.en: A threshold reading, read one step late, from a start against it

mechanism.en: A witness on carrier counts, and a counterexample to the lock without its start condition. Under the threshold reading hi/lo read at every step, from carriers two to one under lo (a rule in force against the reading, read one step late; the same counts under hi are locked, so the start is the locked configuration with its rule reversed), the share falls at every even step and the rule at every odd step, without end, and the course is locked neither way at any step. The threshold is at an even share and the rules are four to one each way. In one trained system a course moved so (LA2's late condition), read as this witness post hoc, not frozen.

open.en: That any actual rule reads the share it selects, or reads it monotonically: this is the premise ReadsShare, where "the winner shapes the rule" of Becoming.Capture enters.
Real-valued shares and rates, rules that read more than the share, many levels, or noisy readings.
The course did not lock: the late condition passed its frozen rule by a tie, and the frozen rule reads only the end.
What no theorem states is how such a threshold arises from the readers, as the share at which the last reader of the loss leaves the reference set.

name.en: Repeated publication under negation

mechanism.en: A witness on two values, beside laws the home labels near-definitional; its one general law, on the chain, is in family D's a-prediction-read-by-what-it-predicts. A published prediction read by the response before the outcome is right exactly where the response to it is itself. Publishing at each step the outcome of the step before, publication stays at a step exactly where that step's prediction is right (any type). Where the response moves every value no published prediction is right (any type); on two values negation is such a response, and repeated publication alternates for ever: no step publishes again. The law behind the never resting is a-map-moving-every-value-never-rests; the rhythm is shown periodic for the two-valued negation only. The liar's two-valued revision likewise never rests, and with a third value, from all undecided, rests undecided (revision-with-an-undecided-value). The response is a function of the prediction alone, read before the outcome.

open.en: That actual publics respond by a function of the prediction alone, or keep its order.
Calibration, probabilities or forecasts of a distribution: the prediction is one value.
Convergence of repeated retraining with losses: only repeated publication of the last outcome on a chain is stated.

name.en: A map moving every value never rests along its run

mechanism.en: A law over any type, not a witness. Every map commutes with itself, so a map moving every value, none equal to its image, never rests along its run: from every start, at no step is the state the one before. Revising a value by such a map changes it at every step of its orbit; revising a claim by negation changes it at every step up to equivalence. The two-valued negation returns to its start: the liar is a rhythm with no still value. The rhythm is shown periodic for the two-valued negation only; for any other map moving every value, only that revision never rests. So the law says where a run of a map does not rest, and not that it returns or with what period; where a list holds the values, that a run enters what returns is basins-of-a-determined-law (family A). Repeated publication under negation has this form on two values (publication-under-negation-alternates). The records' other laws are family D's.

edge.en: on three values a map monotone in information does not move every value, and its run from the undecided value rests from its first step

open.en: The rhythm is shown periodic for the two-valued negation only; for any other map moving every value, only that revision never rests.

name.en: The liar's revision never rests with two values; with three, from all undecided, it rests undecided

mechanism.en: A witness and a law, on N sentences speaking only of one another, with an undecided value below true and false and the strong three-valued tables. The liar is one sentence saying its own negation: read with two values its revision never rests, from every start. Read with three, it rests undecided at every stage from all undecided, and a run of it from every start rests at a step exactly where the liar is undecided at that step: the law says where a run rests, not that a run from a decided value comes there. From all undecided, this is a stated case of an alternation left by a change of the values read. The law: where two-valued revision of a closed system has no fixed point, every fixed point and every resting run leaves a sentence undecided. No map monotone in information moves every value, three-valued negation keeping the undecided value, and the run of a monotone map from the undecided value rests from its first step, so a run from it that never rests needs a map that is not monotone. Undecided is what revision has not decided, not a third truth.

edge.en: the values read changed: with the undecided value and the strong tables, from all undecided, the liar stands undecided at every stage
with three values, from every start, a run of the liar's revision rests at a step exactly where the liar is undecided at that step

open.en: That undecided is a third truth, or that the liar is resolved: the undecided value is what revision has not decided.
Infinitely many sentences, where the least fixed point needs a limit stage; fixed points other than the least; how many sentences stay undecided.

name.en: Without memory, a withholding returns around every loop of waits

mechanism.en: A law over any formations and any relation of waiting, not a witness, and with no finiteness or decision asked. Without memory a formation gives at the next step exactly where all it waits on gave, so it gives at n exactly where every formation with a chain of exactly n waits to it gave at the start. On a loop of p waits, a formation withholding at the start withholds at every multiple of p: the law does not say the formation or the course has period p, does not show p least, and says nothing of the steps between. Where no chain of L waits exists every formation gives from L on, whatever the start, exact in Line. The family's witnesses, whose mechanisms are family E's: in Ring, three formations each waiting on the one before, one withholding circulates (giving-that-waits-on-giving); in a pair, one withholding echoes, the law at a loop of two (Pair.echo); and the windowed alternator, its withholdings a supplied pattern of errors, under every window of at least two gives exactly at the odd steps (both a-pair-tolerates-only-within-a-window).

edge.en: restoring needs another law: in Ring, under the law in which one formation gives whatever it waits on, every formation gives from step 3 on from every start, exactly

open.en: How the relation of waiting forms, or amounts of giving. Thresholds of waiting without memory, which this record leaves out, are stated in thresholds-of-waiting; thresholds with memory are open there.
That cooperation is good, or which giving supports 生生.

Which laws beyond those stated restore a general family: the condition is exact under giving first (Tolerance.restores_iff) and without memory (Tolerance.answers_restores_iff), and with memory none restores (Tolerance.waitsAll_never_restores).

name.en: A run round a loop keeps changing

mechanism.en: A law over any process, with the witness of not settling beside it. In a world that a list holds, some run from a configuration keeps changing exactly where a configuration reachable from it has a step to another from which it can be reached again: a reachable change can be undone. From a loop it needs no list: a run that changes within a loop gives a run from the same start, possibly a different one, that goes round the loop and keeps changing, and a run that keeps changing does not settle. Staying and meeting a target everywhere do not give settling: with two configurations and every step allowed, every configuration can stay, some run rests and the alternating run does not settle (a witness). Under a determined law some run rests with its target met exactly where every run does. Worlds no list holds are outside. When runs settle, and how many times a run changes, are family G's: when-the-runs-of-a-process-settle and the-last-change-of-a-run.

open.en: Worlds no list holds, where change can recur without a loop (how many times a run changes within a list is in the-last-change-of-a-run).

name.en: Recurrence under every law of change

mechanism.en: No premise on the unfolding: the list is the hypothesis each law writes in. A sequence a list holds revisits from every step on, and so does every run of every process whose configurations a list holds. Within finitely many configurations, a list holding every one, a determined law merges nothing exactly where every configuration returns, exactly where it keeps every possibility; a quantity that never falls along an orbit and rises at some step of it rules out a law that merges nothing. A course has at most N states exactly where it repeats from some step i with some period q + 1, i + q + 1 <= N; where the laws are functions, moves formed by a whole, a rest or a part held by a list repeat from some step with some period, start and period within the list's length. There a period exists within the list; which, is not said. Where runs part a bound on configurations bounds no course (free branching on two values, a witness). Becoming that keeps its whole history merges nothing and never returns, so it needs a carrier no list holds, and a present a list holds forgets. Beside these: each basin of a determined law holds one cycle (basins-of-a-determined-law, family A); when a cycle repeats without end from a stock (recurring-reference-revision, family H).

open.en: Finitely many configurations means that a list holds them, not a cardinality, and no decision of equality comes with it.
The equivalence of merging nothing, returning and keeping every possibility is shown for determined laws only, not for processes whose course branches.
That change does not recur is a negated recurrence, not a step named after which nothing changes.
That a rise rules out merging nothing does not exhibit two configurations that merge.

name.en: Recurrence without decidedness

mechanism.en: In a family a list covers, with no decision, recurring coming to be refutes any end to ceasing, and conversely; where the states of the stretch searched are decided, the step is found; decided from some step on, the two recur together. A negated recurrence names no step. In a finite world likewise: where arising recurs no step has nothing cease after it, and with activity decided from some step on, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does. A recurrence of an event in a family, not a return of one configuration, and no period.

open.en: The forms that never stop name no step at which something ceases or comes to be; a step is named here only where the states of the stretch searched are decided.

name.en: Returning where the course branches

mechanism.en: Where courses branch, what returns can be had at every step, and every configuration returns exactly where each region the process never leaves keeps every possibility of its own. Keeping every possibility no longer gives returning (three configurations, a witness). Merging nothing gives it along a run whose configurations a list holds, the run taken as given: building one needs a choice at each step. Within listed configurations merging nothing need not give a configuration its return without a run from it (the fork, a witness).

open.en: Being drawn into a region within a bound of steps, where courses branch, is not shown.

name.en: Recurrence without revision of the selector

mechanism.en: A witness: one declared two-phase process with a Boolean selector and a supplied transition. A state returns after two steps and changes at every step while its operative selector, which changing would change the next phase, stays the same at every time. This refutes an unconditional inference from recurrence to learning or selector revision; it does not refute learning in a richer process. A pre-spine module, with empty axiom reports at the bytes checked on 6 October 2026; no passing receipt binds the current bytes, so the record is reviewed, not receipt-bound.

open.en: That learning or selector revision never comes with recurrence: a richer process can learn.
A definition or classification of every kind of learning.

name.en: A course that only returns

mechanism.en: A witness in a declared process, whose move sets the rule to any value or moves the position to any value at most the rule. The course alternating the rule between 0 and 1 returns every two steps, so its first configuration comes back at arbitrarily late steps. The rule changes at every step and every formation is possible from every configuration, so no list holds the whole possible; at every step the whole possible exceeds what is admitted, and the possible with the rule held widens across the first step. Yet it does not keep widening: endless change with an unlisted whole possible does not suffice. Every moment is 全生成 under the rule held, so 全生成 does not give keeping widening.

open.en: A sufficient condition for keeping widening relative to what is held, beyond the witnesses: endless change with an unlisted whole possible does not suffice.
That growth relative to what is held is better or is the direction of 生生: ranking needs C or a premise in its place, and the reading of 生生不息 here is an AI reading.

name.en: What recurs at fine steps can read as quiet at coarser ones

mechanism.en: A one-way law with witnesses of its converse failing. Read at strictly increasing times, with activity decided, arising or ceasing at arbitrarily late coarse steps is arising or ceasing at arbitrarily late fine steps. Not conversely: in Strobe one relatum, switched on at the odd steps and read at the even ones, arises and ceases at arbitrarily late fine steps, while at the coarse steps it is never active, so nothing arises or ceases there. In real-valued time (periphery, Mathlib with Lean's standard axioms), a balanced course, its one condition standing at 1 - cos(2 pi t), stands at nothing at every whole instant and between every two rises to two and falls back. So a reading at steps that shows no change does not show rest: what changes within a step is not shown, and a course that does not rest can read as still at a coarser grain. These are readings at coarser steps, not a refinement of the unit in which amounts are counted.

open.en: That a becoming given with no step at all can be represented by discrete steps is not shown.
That an actual becoming's rates are summable, its amounts real, or its loops of one condition.

name.en: A closed cycle sustains unceasing arising, without dissipation

mechanism.en: Witnesses on the World, each lacking dissipation: with it, where a quantity never rises and every arising lowers it, arising is not unceasing. In Recycle one unit cycles between two pools, the total stays one, every premise of the law of renewal holds and arising is unceasing; this course returns, the consumer arising at every odd step. In ClosedCycle two formations pass one unit around, the unit standing at the condition of the step's parity, so by its definition its levels come back every second step; it balances, is opened by the opened with a gain at every step, and keeps widening neither along that passing nor by name. The closed KindRelay conserves and returns with period two; by name and along supported passings it keeps widening from no step, while within kinds its levels keep widening (kind-relay-keeps-widening-within-kinds, family H). The cycle of Becoming.Flow does not return: its one condition stands at one throughout, formation n arises across step n and stays active, the flow balances, every step is enclosed around the condition, the exchange recurs, arising is unceasing and the flow more without end. A source-renewed Oscillation meets the depletion premise only vacuously. 'Unceasing' reads only that arising recurs at arbitrarily late steps.

edge.en: with a flow balanced and dissipative, censuses of what is active and of what stands, arising embodied and every step from some step on enclosed around what stands, rest from some step on cannot be refuted

open.en: The witnesses are minimal.

Unceasing depends on identity across steps (identity-across-steps): a naming that keeps continuing activity makes no arising; these are laws of generation only under a continuation that carries a pattern, along which a generating line has carriers arising without end (Web.generation_arises_late).
Yields no “unceasing is better” or any ranking.

That renewal gives widening: on the kind relay 全生成 at two orders of grain and renewal without end hold while what it can form by name only returns, and beginnings recur on a reading that opens nothing.

name.en: Lossless exchange can continue and return

mechanism.en: A witness and a law, on the World. Passing, a unit carried back and forth between two sides, is finite, balanced, lossless and enclosed at every step, each exchange reversed at the next step, not dissipative, arising and ceasing recurring, its configuration coming back every two steps, with no arrow, its change merging no configurations, its history growing by one at every step: the first law gives neither rest nor dissipation, and the levels coming back does not bring the history back. The law: under balance, a family gaining nothing at every step from T on whose configuration changes at arbitrarily late steps cannot never revisit a configuration from T on, a double negation naming no step, where revisiting is a configuration had again with a change between; so too arising without end in a finite world under the first law, embodied and balanced. Where its change from T on is a law of its configuration and that law merges nothing, the configuration at T comes back, the first law's bound doing the work: under the successor nothing merges and nothing returns. The record's route to rest, an arrow or never revisiting, is family G's.

edge.en: under balance, with the family dissipated on at every step from T on, it never revisits a configuration from T on

open.en: The merging conclusions are double negations, and only the dichotomy of merging or not is stated.
The correspondences to thermodynamics are readings, not physical derivations.

name.en: One token moved back and forth: the conservative cycle of a net

mechanism.en: A witness on a model with its own firing rule, the net read as a world. One token moved back and forth between two places fires for ever. Every premise of the rest law holds of it but dissipation: it balances, has a census, is embodied, and every step is enclosed; its transitions do not lose, so its flow is not dissipative. Its marking changes at every step, the first place emptied or newly marked, and its world never rests. Dissipation is a property a net has or lacks. The law it stands beside: along a firing sequence, with finitely many places and transitions listed once, where every fired transition loses weighted tokens, that the world rests from some step on cannot be refuted. Which system is which net, with which weights, is a correspondence outside the Lean.

edge.en: a net along a firing sequence, finitely many places and transitions listed once, every fired transition losing weighted tokens: that the world rests from some step on cannot be refuted

open.en: That a given chemical, biological or computing system is a given net, with which places, transitions and weights: a modelling correspondence outside the Lean.
That every system in our universe loses at each step; dissipation is a property a net has or lacks, as the conservative cycle shows.

name.en: Return grades renewal

mechanism.en: Return grades renewal: within p steps, at some later step, never. Return here is a dependence met again at a later step, not a configuration coming back. The grades are ordered; consumption is exactly a dependence that never returns, which restates the definition, and a condition whose dependences all return is not consumed. A seasonal condition, neither renewed nor consumed, is renewed within two steps and not within one (a witness). In Slowing, a condition met again after ever longer gaps always returns and is never consumed, yet no cycle length bounds its return (a witness): not being consumed does not bound the time to recover. Return is counted in natural-number steps; the grades involve no amounts of what is drawn, and no cycle length is chosen.

open.en: Chooses no cycle length and does not decide which reading is the reading of 生生.
Slowing and Dip are minimal witnesses.

That the characterization of consumption goes beyond its definition: consumed_iff restates Consumed (below its need from some step on is never met again); the content is in the order of the grades and the witnesses Slowing and Dip.

name.en: The law of waxing and waning

mechanism.en: On a named finite model, the sixty-four configurations of the Changes, with a period stated: every line rises one place and the top enters at the bottom as its opposite. The law merges nothing, so every configuration returns; six steps give the complement and twelve the configuration again; from all broken the first return is at the twelfth step, and 隨 returns at the fourth. No configuration is a rest of it, so no run rests at any step or comes to rest from any step on. The law closing 未濟 to 乾 merges nothing and its one orbit holds all sixty-four, first returning at the sixty-fourth step. For every law of hexagrams, every configuration returns exactly where the law merges nothing. This holds of this model, not of every world.

open.en: What any passage of the 周易 or the 易传 claims beyond these laws; the passage map of the chapter states, passage by passage, agreement, exact scope or divergence, and its readings are the AI's.
That returning, waxing or waning is good or supports 生生; the module has no ethical predicate and no ranking of configurations.

name.en: How loops form within the unfolding

mechanism.en: A loop here is a chain of couplings back to where it started, not a course that returns. The loops formed by T + 1 are those formed by T and those through a coupling acting at T that closes a chain. Up to T the carried amount reads only couplings acting before T, so before a loop forms growth is at most polynomial (every condition listed, no loop formed upstream, the part giving no gap after the start, starting gaps at most D and the strengths into each condition at most M a step), and the amounts need not show when one forms: a loop forming at T and one forming at any later step carry the same amounts up to T (a witness). Loops lie within what a law reads: for every law reading a stock only below a threshold, a raise is carried nowhere up to the break, before which the law acts as its standing law, with no loop through the stock. In the constructed draw (a witness) every bound on the strengths of the draw itself puts the stock on a loop of one: the loop that acts forms at the break. With stationary strengths, the same formations at every step and each condition listed once, the most difference that can arrive is bounded by a polynomial exactly where no loop lies upstream.

condition.en: the loops formed by T + 1 are those formed by T and those through a coupling acting at step T that closes a chain; not foreseeable in the amounts: a self-loop forming at T and one forming later carry the same amounts up to T

for every law reading a stock only below a threshold, before the break the law acts as its standing law, which has no loop through the stock; in the constructed draw (a witness) every bound on the strengths of the draw itself puts the stock on a loop of one
with stationary strengths, the same formations at every step and each condition listed once, the most difference that can arrive is bounded by a polynomial exactly where no loop lies upstream

open.en: A runaway after formation for every law: what doubles is the most difference that can arrive (the self-loop and threshold witnesses), not every law's actual gap.
Which strengths a world reads off its course; when loops of read strengths form, for every law.
How a formation comes to observe a stock it depends on; which schedule a law reads and where its threshold lies.

That a particular law runs away around a loop: the runaway is of the most difference that can arrive, attained by the carrying law; a law exchanging nothing is within every strength and has no runaway, loop or not.

name.en: Whether a loop closes, keeps or widens a difference

mechanism.en: A difference around a loop is the course of a return map, one turn a step; the courses this record states close, settle, keep or exceed every bound, and none of its laws has one return without resting. Where every link gives on at least what it receives the difference never falls, so a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less. A map below the identity off zero closes within d turns, exactly, and merges. Monotone return maps settle within d turns where f d <= d. With whole-number factors a loop closes at once, keeps, or from a positive start exceeds every bound, never closing gradually; taking one off does close gradually. A self-loop of strength M has factor 1 + M; read on balanced flows, on a ring of two or more conditions with one positive strength on every link and every condition starting at the same positive gap, one plus the product of strengths is strictly below a turn. That the exchanges respond to the gap by a map is a premise, taken as given; without it the gap need not be the course of any map.

condition.en: with links multiplying by whole-number factors, product 0 closes at the first turn, product 1 keeps the difference, product at least 2 exceeds every bound from a positive start

open.en: That closing a difference is better than keeping or widening it; real factors.
A loop of Rejoining where the difference is many numbers: the reading is of the gap at one condition, and that the exchanges respond to it by a map is a premise.

The carried amount around a cycle exactly where links read more than the current level of the one before, or other formations give into the cycle: there the exact turn does not apply and the bound is what holds.
A closed form for a turn around a cycle of several conditions.

name.en: The grammar's law of rest: falls that end do not recur

mechanism.en: On any carrier, for any two relations Q and F, read as no rise and a least fall: where the steps of a line from T on are, each as far as can be refuted, steps of Q, and every course of Q steps then an F step ends from the line's place at T (the grammar's ending, «尽»), the F steps along it do not recur, as far as can be refuted and outright, with no decision and no choice. The ending is sufficient, not what rest is, and no converse is established. At amounts, within fewer than m least losses those courses end, so the law of rest over amounts is proved from this one, and an amount's strict falls stopping is by definition their non-recurrence. Rest is not being drawn, either way: a fixed point is at rest and not drawn, and a place can be drawn in while its marked steps recur.

edge.en: Along the successor on the whole numbers every step is an F step, so the F steps recur, and 0 is drawn in: being drawn does not bring rest.

open.en: A converse of the law of rest, from rest along a line to the ending of the courses: none is established, and one would have to say which step relations it compares and on what logic.
That rest is a case of being drawn, or being drawn a case of rest.

name.en: The last change of a run

mechanism.en: Calibration. Take a run of configurations with decidable equality whose visited states all lie in a list of N configurations and that has no change within a loop: it makes fewer than N changes (no decidability needed); it settles exactly where it is decided at every step whether it changes again; that is decided within every finite stretch, and with no further premise the run is not not settled; with LPO it settles. Conversely, that every process of decidable configurations in a world a list holds settles from wherever no reachable change can be undone is LPO: the count of changes is bounded, the step of the last change is not. With LPO, in a world a list holds, of decidable configurations, every run from a configuration comes to rest with its target met exactly where every reachable configuration with a step that stays meets the target and no reachable change can be undone; with no such principle each run then does not not rest.

open.en: Settling without LPO for a process's runs: the count of changes is bounded, the step of the last change is not. For a law's run a bounded mark of its changes decides it (LastChange.still_within, where-a-run-of-a-regime-comes-to-rest).
Configurations whose equality is not decided, where the double negation needs stability of equality; worlds no list holds, where change can recur without a loop.

name.en: When the runs of a process settle

mechanism.en: In a world a list holds, some run from a configuration keeps changing exactly where a reachable change can be undone; a run that changes within a loop gives a run from the same start, possibly a different one, that goes round the loop and keeps changing, and so does not settle. Within finitely many configurations, a list holding every one, a run starts exactly where a course as long as the list starts, exactly where a course leading to a return starts, with no decision and no selection. That no run keeps changing does not give settling constructively: in a process of two configurations with no way back no run keeps changing, and every run from the first settling gives LPO, a run changing once, at the first true of a sequence, so that settling decides whether such a true comes. Calibration: a run staying in every family that keeps moving, asked of every process, is exactly dependent choice. Worlds that no list holds are outside these laws; where branching is infinite, courses of every length need not give a run (the fan, a witness).

edge.en: In a world a list holds, some run from a configuration keeps changing exactly where a configuration reachable from it has a step to another configuration from which it can be reached again.

open.en: Settling without the limited principle of omniscience: with no reachable undoable change, every run settling is exactly LPO for every process of decidable configurations in a world a list holds (the-last-change-of-a-run).
Worlds no list holds, where change can recur without a loop (how many times a run changes within a list is in the-last-change-of-a-run).
Whether the core gives dependent choice: a statement about the theory, needing a model outside it.
That courses of every length give a run beyond finitely many configurations: the root of the fan has courses of every length and no run.

Runs along unbounded configurations where branching is finite and nothing is searched (given in Lasting through EitherThroughout and a selection); the laws along runs where nothing lists the configurations.
Settling and the tail beyond lists and numbered conditions.

name.en: Where the possible grows

mechanism.en: What is possible under a process Q from a configuration Q reaches is possible from the first. So along a course (any process; read from the course's first step), where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening; where it keeps widening, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of Q's moves throughout. Along a course coming back to one configuration at arbitrarily late steps, nothing read off its configurations keeps widening. What is held is read by a relation on configurations, kept move by move: the held possible grows across a step only where the step changes what is held, and keeps widening only where what is held changes without end and no list holds the whole possible from the course's start; endless change with an unlisted whole possible does not suffice (a witness). Along a course of a stated process nothing is added to the whole possible, a rule changing its own rule and a tower of rules with no top, its scheme fixed, included. On the root a move holding a relation is a continuation under it. Near-definitional or witnesses.

edge.en: Where the possible under Q keeps widening, read from the course's first step, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of moves of Q throughout.
The held possible keeps widening only where what is held changes without end: from every step some bounded stretch does not hold it throughout.
It keeps widening only where no list holds the whole possible from the course's start.

With a rule raised at every step, the possible with the rule held keeps widening while every formation is possible from every configuration of the course; read on the course's moments under the rule held, every moment ceases.
On a tower whose moves above 0 copy a rule down, each rule changing once as the change climbs, the possible with the rules from every height up held keeps widening.
With the rule raised at every other step, the held possible keeps widening, every formation stays possible, and renewal without end holds at every even moment.

open.en: That growth relative to what is held is growth of the whole possible: along a course of a stated process the whole possible never grows.
A sufficient condition for keeping widening relative to what is held, beyond the witnesses: endless change with an unlisted whole possible does not suffice.
Where a change of a general part is located without deciding each step's holding: the law then gives a bounded stretch not holding it throughout, not a step.
That a move above n changes a rule: the tower's law locates moves that can change a rule from height n up, not a change.
A change of the law of change with no fixed scheme, or a space of rules not given with the carrier: the tower's scheme is fixed, as the law of any stated process is.
Whether the actual unfolding is a course of a process statable in advance; the possible that cannot be prestated is outside.
That growth relative to what is held is better or is the direction of 生生: ranking needs C or a premise in its place, and the reading of 生生不息 here is an AI reading.
A result no neighbouring field states: the held law restates open-ended novelty's innovation, and the tower law the finite degree of introspection of reflective towers.

The second-order direction of 生生: a comparison of a range whose widening keeps widening with one merely wider now, never reversing widening and counting neither novelty nor scale. Eventual widening, first-order widening read on late tails, does not give it.

name.en: What keeping widening needs, and what carries it

mechanism.en: Take a course keeping widening by name on the actual levels, what every formation supported from a step on requires fixed within a finite family of conditions. The family's stock passes every bound and rises at arbitrarily late steps (natural-number amounts); under the first law, the family without repetition, at arbitrarily late steps the rest gives it net or it is not closed; and a finite world under the first law, balanced on all its conditions from a step, has no such course. Under upkeep it has ever more takers; with the family balanced on from a step its replenishment, and with bounded giving per entry its renewers, are bounded from no step on, entries of the present list counted with repetition. Under the World premises and requirements never loosening, along a continuation containing carrying on of the supported, keeping opening needs, up to double negation, a beginning after every step (a passing of support into a formation nothing supported continues into along it), by name a passing of support, not conversely. Along every continuation containing carrying on while supported or passing support nothing keeps opening or keeps widening; where a list holding every condition any formation requires is dissipated on from a step, along a continuation containing carrying on of the supported nothing keeps widening. The first two laws restate open-systems thermodynamics and maintenance scaling, the others are near-definitional, and none compares two courses; which actual courses meet the premises is not shown.

edge.en: Under the first law, the family without repetition, at arbitrarily late steps the rest gives it net or it is not closed.
With balance on the family from a step as well, it is not closed at arbitrarily late steps.
Without the first law: with a source giving from nothing, a finite balanced world keeps widening by name, its family closed and never given from beyond.
Without fixed needs: on a loosening web, needs falling toward one, a course keeps widening by name with stock one throughout.

On the kind relay, six formations of two kinds whose units pass within and across kinds with period two, the kind chosen so that the passings across kinds begin, the levels keep widening within kinds, while what it can form by name only returns.

open.en: A comparison of two courses: no law here compares two, so the second-order direction of 生生 stays open and eventual widening's lag stays undecided.

That renewal gives widening: on the kind relay 全生成 at two orders of grain and renewal without end hold while what it can form by name only returns, and beginnings recur on a reading that opens nothing.
That a part under dissipation is sustained by supply from beyond: the fed relay's required conditions conserve, its loss paid by fuel no formation requires.
That renewers count formations where the present list repeats one; growth by kinds not given in advance; which actual courses meet the premises.

The second-order direction of 生生: a comparison of a range whose widening keeps widening with one merely wider now, never reversing widening and counting neither novelty nor scale. Eventual widening, first-order widening read on late tails, does not give it.
Passing every bound uses natural-number amounts; in a dense order needs approaching a limit could support ever more formations at a bounded stock (argued, not proved in Lean).

name.en: What closes what can form: a net draw on a required condition

mechanism.en: Near-definitional, and a comparison of two level paths, not a course closing: withhold a part (a decided family of formations), keep the rest of the exchange as it was, and compare the formations admitted at each step; no significance or standpoint enters. Where the rest would overdraw there are no withheld levels and nothing to compare; where they exist they are unique, and in a balanced flow, at each step, each level with what the part has so far taken equals the level without it with what the part has so far given. So a part closes what can form only by a net draw on a required condition, and opens it only by a net give: a formation is supported exactly where, on each condition it requires, the part's net draw stays within the margin; naming the condition overdrawn needs excluded middle. By inclusion of what is admitted a part widens, narrows, keeps the same or is mixed, one of them wherever inclusion or exceeding is decided both ways, and ordering a mixed part needs a measure. With only active formations taking and only from what they draw on, run classes read over a whole run decide part of it: drawing only on conditions renewed over the run does not narrow; giving no more than it takes, where a dependence is consumed and met without it, narrows; inactive at the start and never arising, only active formations giving, changes nothing; within renewal at a step decides nothing. Consuming over the run, or having arisen, does not alone decide. Discrete steps, natural-number levels and needs.

edge.en: With balance before each step at the conditions each formation requires, the levels with a part widen those without it exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation the levels without it admit and, at some step, brings within it one they do not.
A giver from beyond: without its part the condition stays at zero and a formation is admitted at no step; with it that formation is supported from step one on.
The clearer, active and supported at every step: its part opens nothing and closes the dweller, unsupported from step two on.
A conveyor takes a unit from one condition and gives it to another: each path admits a formation the other does not.
A drawer within renewal at its step, consuming over the run: its part narrows, so being within renewal at a step decides nothing.
A formation drawing on a condition that stays below its need, consuming over the run with nothing taken: its part keeps what can form the same, so consuming alone does not narrow.
A member not active at the start that arises across the first step then narrows, taking a condition's unit before a dependence on it forms.
A member not active at the start that arises across the first step then widens, giving a condition the unit a later dependence needs: the arising class does not decide.

open.en: Compares only the formations admitted at each step, not reachability over several steps, renewal capacity or richness of relations.
The counterfactual does not let the rest adjust; where no level path balances the flow without the part there is nothing to compare.
Does not say which part should be withheld.
Near-definitional: the margin law is the balance equation substituted into the admission inequality, and comparing admitted sets by inclusion is the opportunity-set ordering (Pattanaik and Xu 1990).
A mixed part is not ordered by inclusion: ordering it needs a measure weighing some possibilities against others, which is a further premise.
The witnesses are minimal, their endings stipulated in activity or requirements and shown consistent with balance, support and dependence.
That renewing widens: keeping what can form is not widening; whether a part opens anything is its net give.
A valuation of either class; how far an arisen part widens or narrows, which is its net exchange (the margin laws), not its arising.

name.en: Revisiting, novelty and forgetting on the levels alone

mechanism.en: On the levels alone, a family whose stock stays within a bound from T on takes one configuration at two steps from every step on (no flow, balance or decision); changing without end as well, it cannot be that it never revisits after a change (a double negation: no step of return is computed). What is new at every step exceeds every bound; a bounded family exchanged with at arbitrarily late steps does not carry the count of its exchanges, nor does a bounded whole where finitely many relata are all there is. With the stock never rising and falling across each change, change does not recur without end. With the rest of the whole counted, every rise is given net by some relatum; under the first law a family without repetition that rises is given by the rest or is open; and, under the first law, a whole a list holds without repetition, the rest giving it nothing net from T on, stays within its stock at T and is not new at every step. Novelty, and formations first supported without end, what each requires fixed within the family, need gain; gain is not openness. Which parts are bounded is a condition of the laws, not shown of any actual part.

edge.en: Under the first law, a family without repetition that rises across a step is given net by the rest or is open there.
In Web.counting the level is the step, new at every step and above every bound: the bound in the laws cannot be dropped.

Web.counting with nothing taking part: the family is closed, yet counting on is new at every step, the rest giving one unit at every step; the condition that the rest gives nothing net cannot be dropped from the return of a finite whole.

open.en: Which parts are held within a bound, gain nothing or lose at each change: these are states of the part, given as conditions of the laws.
The double negation of returns_of_bounded is not removed: from never revisiting being refuted, no step of return is computed.
No correspondence to thermodynamic entropy, physical recurrence (Poincaré) or memory capacity is checked.
Continuous time and real amounts are not stated.
Whether an actual part is open, which relatum the rest is in an actual unfolding, or whether its exchange is without end: these are correspondence, given per application.
Gain is not openness: a family can be closed and gain from the rest, and openness can carry a net of zero.

name.en: The rest theorem

mechanism.en: In a world with censuses of what is active and of what stands, arising embodied, flow balanced and dissipative, and every step from some step on enclosed around what stands, rest from some step on cannot be refuted; neither arising nor ceasing recurs. It says rest cannot be refuted, not when it comes: naming, for every finite world meeting the eight premises with activity decided, the step after which nothing arises gives LPO. Across such a step any change of standing lowers the total; with every relatum embodied and activity decided, and every step from T on enclosed, the total standing at T bounds the relata active together with the steps of change. The world need not be finite, but finitely many stand and act at each step. Each premise is needed, by a witness without it. The exchange does not recur under the census of what stands, balance, dissipation and enclosure alone (a negated recurrence). The eight premises decide neither enclosure nor openness, and openness with them does not give arising without end (holding, a witness); every premise binding does not bring rest. The premises are stated, not shown of any actual world.

edge.en: Under a census of what stands, standing changes at arbitrarily late steps exactly when it changes at arbitrarily late steps across which what stands does not run down.
With a census of what is active, every relatum embodied and flow balanced and dissipative, arising without end leaves no step from which every step is enclosed.
exposed meets all eight premises, no step enclosed, and arising never ceases; so enclosure cannot be dropped. Activity needing support, bounded transmission and dissipation hold vacuously in it.
With only arising embodied, a world can be enclosed at every step and arise without end: throughput has no census of what stands, embodiedThroughput no census of what is active.
attrition meets every premise of the rest theorem but the census of what is active, every step enclosed around what stands, and ceasing recurs.

open.en: The exchange coming to rest is stated as no exchange at arbitrarily late steps (a negated recurrence), not as a step after which none occurs, which would need a decision.

In a world meeting the rest theorem's conditions not unboundedly many relata ever stand or act, a list holding all of them needing omniscience in general, so the generalization lies only in idle relata.
Openness with the eight premises does not suffice for arising without end, nor does every premise binding bring rest.
In exposed three premises hold vacuously, a feature of representing dissipation as binding only enclosed exchange, not a description of actual open systems.

Amounts are natural numbers, a taking losing a whole unit; in finer amounts rest can fail only along a reading no list holds: read off listed configurations, the rest theorem's premises give it unrefuted in any amounts, with no least loss.
The second law gives no least loss per step.
Change does not recur, and an end step needs omniscience in general.
The change bound is the total standing at enclosure, which can be attained but is not the value in every world.
The bound counts steps of change, not events.
Closure is not what bounds change: the proof shows that running down does, and closure, which the name ‘closure bounds change’ names, is how the premises supply it.

name.en: An arrow leaves change not recurring

mechanism.en: Under balance, with the family gaining nothing at every step from T on, where some quantity of its configuration is an arrow from T on (it never falls, and it rises across every step at which the configuration changes), the configuration does not change at arbitrarily late steps, a negated recurrence; so under the first law no quantity is an arrow while change goes on. The route is the first law, not dissipation: a family so balanced and gaining nothing that never revisits a configuration does not change at arbitrarily late steps, with no least loss, and one unit passing once, losslessly, rests and is not dissipative (a witness). Where the configuration of a balanced family carries the count of its exchanges since T, the reading that gives it is an arrow, so, gaining nothing, nothing is exchanged with the family at arbitrarily late steps; a finite balanced world under the first law that keeps exchanging forgets: from no step on does its configuration carry its history. Natural-number amounts at a fixed unit. The correspondences to thermodynamics are readings, not derivations.

edge.en: Exact conservation, every step enclosed and the exchange recurring, a record's level an arrow from the start, rising at every step, where the record gains from relata beyond it and the world is not finite: gaining nothing and finiteness do work.

Finite, balanced, lossless and enclosed, each exchange reversed at the next step, arising and ceasing recurring, with no arrow: the first law gives neither rest nor dissipation. The lossless returning course, entered by family F.

open.en: The correspondences to thermodynamics are readings, not physical derivations.
The count of reachable configurations within the first law's list is not stated; their shrinking step by step holds for any determined law with no premise.
A coarse-grained entropy rising from an ordered start needs a premise about the start and is not stated.

name.en: Rest at every resolution

mechanism.en: The natural-number unit is a quantum of loss. Read a unit that only splits, balance at the refining unit, two ways. With the refinement not counted: under loss in proportion q/(q+1) (a research-note premise, not the theory's), everything taken from a family without repetition closed from T on is, in the unit of step T, at most q + 1 times its stock at T, a least bound; in a world with a census, embodied relata and enclosure, least sizes bound the times of exchange, growth, fall and arising, each a negated recurrence. With the refinement counted as a formation that only gives (a reading [AI reading, D45]), balance at the refining unit is the spine's balance; then, with nothing added to the spine's premises, that the world rests at every resolution cannot be refuted, and the witnesses that leave it uncounted are fed by it. Dissipation, the least loss per exchange, stays a premise of the spine. Witnesses show each premise needed given the others; none describes an actual system.

edge.en: In a world with a census of activity and embodied relata, balanced at the refining unit and, with the refinement counted, dissipative at every step, where arising recurs no step begins a stretch in which every step is enclosed with the refinement counted.
Balanced at the refining unit and dissipative, where arising recurs no step begins a stretch in which every step is enclosed and the refinement gives no relatum anything.

Emission, with a census, embodied relata, every step enclosed and half of what is taken lost, has a new relatum arise at every step, standing at one unit of the step after, and does not balance at the fixed unit.
Circulation exchanges one whole unit of step 0 at every step, every step enclosed around what stands, losing one unit of the step after, and is dissipative in no proportion.

With the unit splitting at arbitrarily late steps, the closed pool of Asymptote is taken from at arbitrarily late steps, its flow balanced at that resolution and dissipative, even losing all it takes; it does not balance at the fixed unit.

open.en: Amounts are rationals by refinement, the unit never coarsening, with neither real amounts nor continuous time.

The amount law's bound is the least, while whether the counting bounds are attained is not proved in the core: the review's probe Tight.attained attains the exchange bound at p = q = S = 1 and is not moved into the core.
The exchange law is stated for a fixed family closed from T on, not read of worlds with changing enclosures.
Loss in proportion and the least fall of the reserve are premises not taken for the theory, kept as research notes.
Each witness shows the premise it lacks is needed given the others, not that all premises are mutually independent, and none describes an actual system.
‘Does not recur’ is a negated recurrence, not a step after which nothing happens.
Amounts are natural numbers of a unit that only refines, never coarsening; real amounts and continuous time are not treated.
That rest cannot be refuted supplies no step from which the world rests: ‘does not recur’ is a negated recurrence.
‘No premise added’ means none beyond the spine's: dissipation, the least loss per exchange, stays a premise of the spine.

name.en: Rest exactly where the total stops falling

mechanism.en: Over any amounts (a cancellative preordered commutative monoid with nothing least), a family balanced (no amount made) and dissipated on (whatever gives back all it takes takes nothing) has a total that falls strictly at every change of a level, with no least loss, and stops changing, as far as can be refuted, exactly where its total's strict falls stop. With a census of the active relata, every relatum embodied, flow balanced and dissipative and every step from T on enclosed (the enclosed premises), a world whose census total stops falling rests, unrefuted; so does one whose census total is read off configurations a list holds, finiteness being a premise, not derived of any actual system. Rest over every world in given amounts follows from no endless fall, which a least fall in Archimedean amounts gives, and excludes an amount falling at every step, so dyadic and layered amounts each carry a world that never rests. The two coincide classically, with dependent choice; constructively this is not shown.

edge.en: A family balanced and dissipated on from T on stops changing, as far as can be refuted, exactly where its total's strict falls stop; the edge is that they do not stop.
Along an amount that does not rise and falls strictly at every step, a standing passed between two relata meets the enclosed premises and never rests; no list holds its levels.
In dyadic amounts (no least fall) some world with the enclosed premises never rests; in layered amounts (not Archimedean) likewise, Layered.worlds_need_not_rest.

open.en: That rest over every world in given amounts is, constructively, the absence of an endless fall: from an amount whose falls recur only as far as can be refuted, an amount falling at every step is not built without choosing the steps at which it falls; classically, with dependent choice, the conditions coincide.

That the whole-number rest theorems are derived from the law over any amounts: they keep their own proofs below Becoming.InAmounts, which reads World; the instance shows their premises are exactly what the general law needs in whole numbers.
That any physical system has a least fall or a finite reading: both are premises.
How soon the world rests, or naming the step: that is a principle of omniscience (World.lpo_of_finite_ends).
The other natural-number laws of flows, webs and worlds over any amounts (needs, support, gain, loops): only the rest theorem and the law of one step on which it turns are stated here.

A least loss in energy from the pure core, which needs a reading of count as energy and, since Landauer's count so read bounds heat exported rather than exergy destroyed, irreversibility as well; whether rest over every world in given amounts is, constructively, the absence of an endless fall; the other laws over any amounts.

name.en: The least loss as a premise of rest

mechanism.en: Over any amounts, possibly dense: where an amount does not rise from T on, falls by at least ε at each step at which P holds, and m copies of ε are not within its value at T, steps at which P holds do not recur (the grammar's law of rest at the amounts). In Archimedean amounts a least loss above nothing suffices; with none a closed amount still approaches rest, few steps losing at least any ε. Read off configurations a list holds, an amount not rising from T on falls strictly at most as often as the list is long, over any amounts, with no least loss, Archimedean property, totality or decision; so along any process's run whose configurations a list holds, such falls come to rest. In whole numbers, a count balanced across each step of a stretch and losing at least one more than it gains at each falls by at least the stretch's length; where marking is decided, some step within the count's value is unmarked, found by search. That bounds how long a count can lose, not that it reaches nothing. Over finitely many configurations a loss above nothing needs a law that merges. A least loss and a finite reading are premises, not shown of any physical system.

edge.en: Dense, Archimedean dyadic amounts, every loss above nothing and no least loss, the stock falling at every step.
In layered amounts a least loss at every step, the stock beyond every multiple of it, falling at every step; the amounts are not Archimedean, so approach fails too.
Falls that recur need a reading no list holds: the halving stock falls strictly at every step, and no list holds its values.

open.en: That any physical system has a least loss per change; the statistical second law names none, and which physical premises supply one is stated, as a correspondence, in least-loss-from-entropy-production (T1).
That coming to rest supports or damages 生生.
Stated in whole numbers; in denser amounts a fall at every step need not end.
It bounds how long a count can lose; it does not say that the count reaches nothing.
The comparison orders the counts at the end; it does not order what each drew at each step.
How far the amount falls, or that it approaches any value: the law bounds how often it falls strictly.

That the configurations of any actual system are finitely many at the resolution an amount is read: finiteness is a premise (a list), not derived; physics supplies it where a bounded system has finitely many distinguishable states.
That a least loss is derived: it is made unnecessary where the reading is finite. With a decided total order the finitely many losses have a least one, but the law does not go through it.

A least loss in energy from the pure core, which needs a reading of count as energy and, since Landauer's count so read bounds heat exported rather than exergy destroyed, irreversibility as well; whether rest over every world in given amounts is, constructively, the absence of an endless fall; the other laws over any amounts.

name.en: Laws path by path, and rest not in expectation

mechanism.en: A law of exchange with noise is a relation of exchange, along every realization of which the course is a run, so the laws over every relation of exchange hold path by path. In the periphery (Lean's standard axioms through Mathlib), with integrable amounts, balance along every realization passes to the expectation and rest does not: a condition ending at a random step rests along every realization while its expected level falls at every step (a witness): a law that a run comes to rest does not pass to the expectation of the runs.

edge.en: Every realization comes to rest, while the expected level falls strictly at every step and never rests.

open.en: Laws reading a distribution of exchanges rather than a realization; that an actual noise is a value read at each step.
Laws of the distribution of courses (variance, the seen half of T6 is one); an independent review.

name.en: Where a run of a regime comes to rest

mechanism.en: The regime, a named model: whole numbers, the draw taken first, discrete steps. For one condition whose state is the level and one recent giving: where an adjustment of giving rises with what is left and with the recent giving, rests at the draw exactly where the regime gives it, and keeps a band up to hi, every run from a level and a recent giving up to hi rests within 3 hi + 3 steps, either at or above the draw, with recent giving equal to the draw and a level the regime's step leaves as it is (any such fixed point, not only the point of no return), or below the draw with level and recent giving equal; whether it changes again is decided at each step: settling needs no omniscience. On webs (finitely many listed conditions, a band the step keeps, mutual support) a run from the band rests within the count times hi plus one steps, ending decided there, and each point of no return, the others given, is exact and does not rise as any other level rises. That measured giving rises over its band is a premise, which the field's giving meets only partly (post hoc); that measured webs meet mutual support and a band is untested.

edge.en: Without giving rising with what is left: giving two from nothing and nothing from more keeps a band up to two under a draw of one, yet the run from one moves between one and two at every step.
With no band, the gated giving's run from five rises at every step.

open.en: Rest in finitely many steps over the reals: in whole numbers each change moves an amount by at least one; over the reals a run converges and need not rest (record regime-in-any-amounts).

That measured giving rises over its band: MQ5's law rises in both arguments exactly where its regime's giving rises with what is left. Read through the balance as an adjustment, the field's giving meets this assumption only partly (post hoc, MQ5 stocks): it rises in the recent giving in 65 of 69 stocks; it does not rise in what is left over the whole band, each stock's fitted level law humped, rising over a median 41% of its observed escapements and over the whole band in only 4 of 69. So the order laws reach the field's state on the low side of its level law, below the peak; rests at or above the draw are the regime's on either side, since that law needs no rising.
That 3 hi + 3 is the least bound; a state with a further lag. Coupled conditions with a recent giving are stated (record webs-with-a-recent-giving); rest within a band for them is not.
Infinitely many conditions: the decision whether a step changes what is left runs over the covering list.
Amounts beyond whole numbers; rest within a band with a recent giving. Thresholds beyond a band and webs with a recent giving are stated (records thresholds-beyond-a-band, webs-with-a-recent-giving).
That measured webs meet mutual support and a band: how far a field web's thresholds fall is untested.
Rest within a band for webs with a recent giving; partial dependence; a cascade's time.

name.en: A coupling saturated by what it has carried

mechanism.en: Whole-number amounts and strengths, discrete steps. Strengths read off what has passed through a coupling read the levels before, so the carrying law with them generates a course. Where they are zero once A has passed and A has passed by N, the coupling stops by N: it does not recur and nothing more passes; where every coupling has so saturated by N, order N is exact. A coupling acting at each step until saturated, from a level that stands, has passed A by step A and stops by step A. With strengths f times a coupling acting at each step from a level that stands, f not rising in what has passed, it stops by some step exactly where f reaches zero; floored at one it recurs, at least one more passing at every step, and coupled into itself leaves every finite order inexact. Settling at a known step without that zero needs LPO, and is not stated. That use wears any actual coupling this way, or how fast, is not shown.

edge.en: With strengths f a times k, a what has passed and f not rising, k reading the level of a listed condition at each step through some formation present outside the part and that level standing, the coupling stops by some step exactly where f is zero at some amount.
With the response at least one at every amount, under the same reading, the coupling recurs and at least one more passes at every step.

open.en: That a non-rising response never reaching zero settles at a known step: that needs the limited principle of omniscience, and is not stated.
Recovery after rest; strengths read off what passed through other couplings; amounts beyond whole numbers.
That use wears any actual coupling this way, or how fast.

name.en: Unceasing arising needs renewal

mechanism.en: Where, at a step at which no condition of a finite family rises, each arising goes with a fall in one of them (a supplied premise, not a conclusion; it asks only that some condition of the family change and does not involve the arising formation), unceasing arising leaves the family still from no step on, and where every rise is an active renewer's, renewing stops from no step on. Under balance, uptake at arbitrarily late steps needs replenishment at arbitrarily late steps. Where a quantity never rises and every arising lowers it, arising is not unceasing; a closed cycle sustains it, and a tide renews with nothing arising: unceasing arising is strictly stronger than recurring renewal. Formations can arise one after another while drawing an unrenewed condition, and arising does not recur (a witness). A formation active exactly where supported, at a step and the next, does not arise across the step where every condition it required before is still required, its needs stay and every level stays: arising needs a change in what is read. Unceasing reads only that arising recurs at arbitrarily late steps, not more, diversity or complexity, and it depends on identity across steps.

edge.en: Where, at a step at which no condition of the family rises, each arising goes with a fall in one of them, and every rise is an active renewer's, unceasing arising leaves renewing stopping from no step on.
Under balance, positive uptake at arbitrarily late steps needs the family replenished at arbitrarily late steps.
One unit cycles between two pools, the total stays one, every premise holds and arising is unceasing; the dissipation law needs every arising to lower the quantity concerned.

open.en: Yields no “unceasing is better” or any ranking.
Does not state “more”, diversity or complexity; the generation component is not added to any reading of living.
The depletion premise asks only that some condition of the family change (depletes_iff) and does not screen out arisings made by naming (TideFlip).
In the flow form of the two-kind reading arising works only through uptake (Steady), while the arising of an embodied relatum is itself replenishment (generation-is-replenishment).

Unceasing depends on identity across steps (identity-across-steps): a naming that keeps continuing activity makes no arising; these are laws of generation only under a continuation that carries a pattern, along which a generating line has carriers arising without end (Web.generation_arises_late).
Rises is a net rise, and concurrent replenishment is visible only in the flow form.
Arising where activity is not read off support.
A disappearing requirement can admit it with nothing else changed.

name.en: Ceasing needs arising; under a bounded list the two keep pace

mechanism.en: Where what holds is listed at each step, each member once, and holding is decided, ceasing recurring needs coming to be recurring; so in a world with a census whose activity is decided ceasing recurs only where arising recurs, read of standing and of dependence likewise, and wherever some list covers what holds at arbitrarily late steps. With no decision, where a list covers one step and nothing comes after it, ceasing does not recur. Not conversely in general: accretion has a census, arising recurring and nothing ever ceasing. Where the list returns to at most some K members at arbitrarily late steps, coming to be recurring needs ceasing recurring, so the two keep pace even among infinitely many members; on a World with activity decided and its census so bounded, arising recurs exactly where ceasing does. Under a bound growing without end, however slowly, arising can go on without ceasing (a witness). In a finite world with activity decided arising recurs exactly when ceasing does; decidedness is that law's own condition: asked of every finite world without it, the law is equivalent to excluded middle. A count, not a mechanism: it says neither which member comes to be nor that the two are causally linked.

edge.en: On a World with activity decided, at most B t relata active at each step t and listed, and B returning within some K at arbitrarily late steps, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does.
In a finite world whose activity is decided, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does.
In a finite world whose activity is decided from some step on, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does, with no decision procedure.
accretion has a census, arising recurring and ceasing not; attrition keeps ceasing while nothing arises, so by this law it has no census.
For any non-decreasing, unbounded B, in slow B a census is counted by B, arising recurs and nothing ever ceases: no bound growing without end keeps the two together.
One relatum active at each step, arising and ceasing both recurring, the relata not finitely many: the bounded law reaches beyond finite worlds.

open.en: The law is a count, not a mechanism: it says neither which member comes to be nor that coming to be and ceasing to be are causally linked.
Recurring means occurring at arbitrarily late steps and gives no frequency.
That a non-decreasing bound either stays within some number or grows without end is classical; the pure core states the two sides separately.
For a bound that is not monotone and eventually exceeds every number no corresponding world is given (its construction needs data from existence).

name.en: A merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining

mechanism.en: Formations hold codes from senses to forms, changed only by hearing; the codes, the hearings and the rule of adoption are given. An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges, the source of the imposed code losing none. Under hearings that copy, where every formation holds the imposed form at a sense, all hold it at every later step: a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining. A resolution written back into the records later cohorts read rests from the next cohort on (records written to offer exactly what was resolved, read by later cohorts, the repertoire listed without repetition); it merges the histories resolving alike, so no later reading recovers them, and kept records bar a different resolution. That actual conventions, scripts or the theory's own terms form by hearing in this way, or whether a shared, imposed or kept code supports or damages 生生, is not shown.

edge.en: Where every formation holds the imposed form at a sense, those imposed on and those kept alike, all hold it at every later step: the return needs a form held outside.

Where a formation holds the imposed form at one sense and, under a rule that always takes the form heard, hears at a sense the imposed code merges with it a formation whose form there is not the imposed one, it then tells the two senses apart although the imposed code merges them.
Where all hold a code merging two senses, a form coined at one that the code does not give the other, heard by all, makes every formation tell them apart again.

open.en: Which orders actual exchange takes, with probabilities over orders, and how long agreement takes: the voter model's and the naming game's expectations are not stated.
That actual conventions, scripts or the theory's own terms form by hearing in this way, or whether a shared, imposed or kept code supports or damages 生生.
That names in use are coined deliberately, or that a coined form is heard.

name.en: Generation, keeping and degeneration at two grains

mechanism.en: For every carrier, relation and pair of classes, read at a fine and a coarse class: going on along some branch and ending on every branch exclude each other; generation and keeping each exclude degeneration, and can share a point along different branches (生守相杂, a witness), and on a single line exclude each other. 全生成, 全守 and 有终 exclude each other pairwise; with excluded middle as a hypothesis every point lies in one of them, and in one of 生成, 后守 and 退化, on a single line exactly one. The short life renews and still ends on every branch, so renewal does not decide the region. Read along renewing into under the one, the grammar's `«生生»` of the root, renewal without end, is going on along some branch: a Lean name with that meaning, no premise on what the pattern is or whether its going on is good, and not the 生生 of life in the whole. For any sequence of classes, no order of grain assumed, generation at order k keeps order k + 1 from ending on every branch.

open.en: That generation here is the 生生 of life in the whole: it is the continuation of a pattern through renewal of its parts, with no premise on what the pattern is or whether its going on is good.
That the regions are decided: at a given point, whether the pattern goes on is in general not decided.
That renewal is generation: a line can renew and still end.
The some-branch regions read on the World.

name.en: Supported repair and reformation of a sustaining relation

mechanism.en: In every balanced flow a step of joint net giving raises a level by at least one, and where giving jointly exceeds taking at each step at which the level is not below its start, m − level steps bring it to at least m. In the support-gated law a supported route of contribution restores the sustaining activity (initial repair support and contrib > draw at each of the next needG − level steps, the schedule and its source supplied), with both unsupported the level stays, and two histories with the same later inputs recover or do not. Recovery does not guarantee maintenance.

condition.en: Where giving jointly exceeds taking at each step at which the level is not below its start, m − level steps bring it to at least m.

open.en: Finite recovery does not guarantee later maintenance.

Does not derive contribution sources, activity selection, physical laws, general recoverability, whole-Becoming relational constitution or ethical necessity; living significance, the practical commitments and E stay explicit.
The family's balance as a flow holds by construction (the focal take is what the step removes); the instance's content is its supported givers and arithmetic.

name.en: Support passed on by later gainers

mechanism.en: Under balance, with only active formations giving and activity needing support, every rise of a condition is given by a supported formation taking part, so a formation whose requirements do not loosen across a step cannot gain support there while no supported formation taking part gives to a condition it requires.
