Under those premises, with requirements never loosening, no formation supported at K + 1 consecutive steps and support gained at arbitrarily late steps, it cannot be refuted that, for every T and N, support is gained after N through the giving of a supported formation that itself gained support after T: a chain of gains, each giver a newer gainer, up to double negation. The end absorbs: if no member of a family is supported at T, members' requirements do not loosen from T on and only members give to what members require, no member is supported later; of the whole, once nothing is supported, while requirements do not loosen, nothing is supported or active again.

edge.en: A requirement dissolves (requirements loosen): a formation unsupported at step zero is supported at step one (a witness); dissolving a requirement is transformation, not recovery.
Something beyond the family gives: a giver requiring nothing gives to the required condition, and a formation unsupported at step zero is supported at step one (a witness).

open.en: A chain of support is not yet 生生, which asks widening as well.
A witness of the chain: the conclusion is a double negation.
The witnesses are minimal: their activity and requirements are stipulated, and each is shown consistent with balance, support and dependence, or missing one premise.
“The whole” is all the formations of a web, the represented whole.

name.en: A whole persists through the arising of its parts

mechanism.en: A whole, read by coincidence of activity and not as constitution (which formations are parts is a supplied premise), arises only as a part arises. While the whole stays active from some step on: where parts are brief (none active at two steps d apart), no d steps pass without one arising; and where every part ends and the active ones are listed, that ever new parts arise cannot be refuted. Conversely, where from T on a part arises within every d steps and lasts d steps, the whole is active from T + d on. A part that never ends (Immortal), or infinitely many active at once (Countless), lets a whole persist with nothing arising; parts can arise at arbitrarily late steps with the whole inactive between them (Gaps). The laws are near-definitional and add no dynamics of the parts.

open.en: That a whole is constituted by its parts does not follow: being a whole is coincidence of activity.
The whole's dependence, drawing and undermining do not follow from its parts': the whole relates to them only through activity.
Which formations are parts is fixed for every step: membership changing from step to step is not modelled.
The laws do not say which part arises, nor that the number of active parts grows.
That actual parts last until the next arises.

name.en: A pattern outlasting its carriers lasts through passing

mechanism.en: Any web, its activity read as carrying. Let a pattern be present at every step from T on and its carriers brief for d. From every step S from T on, it is not the case that no carrier begins across any of the d steps from S: a double-negation form that, with activity undecided, names no carrier. Under the passing premise (`Web.ByPassing`, a hypothesis: whatever carries the pattern after a step carried it before or was given it across the step by a carrier), every beginning is a passing, the pattern is passed across one of every d consecutive steps from T on, a step with no carrier is followed by none, and where no carrier passes it from T on, nothing carries it from T + d on; `PatternRelay` attains the bounds (a witness). On the grammar the premise says exactly that every occurrence carrying the pattern after a step has a predecessor (有前) under the pattern's class. Which formations pass, when and to which, whether a pattern changes as it is passed, and which patterns are worth passing are not said.

edge.en: Under the passing premise, with carriers brief for d: where no carrier passes it from T on, nothing carries it from T + d on.

condition.en: Under the passing premise, its carriers brief for d, the pattern is passed across one of every d consecutive steps from T on; PatternRelay attains the bound (a witness).

open.en: Whether carrying forms by passing, which formations pass, when or to which formations, or whether a pattern changes as it is passed.
Which patterns are worth passing, or what carrying one does to the carriers or to anything else.

name.en: Two-sided regulation, and regulation that reads late

mechanism.en: With balance at the condition, the joint exchange departs from evenness by at most the gap to m on each side exactly where the next level lies between m and the present one: the bound is exactly no overshoot. Within it, opposing, the level settles at m; a family so regulated settles in total, nothing reading the total. Regulation is a premise here, not shown of any actual system. With balance, where the joint exchange gives no more than it takes below m, a level below m never returns to it, gated renewal being the case; one side is not regulation (OneSided, a witness, stays above m). (Any type, rules over whole numbers.) A rule reading ℓ steps late keeps no band [a, b] with 0 < a narrower than 2(ℓ + 1)d against rests moving the level by at most d a step, attained by the late return. (World, balance at the condition.) With a ≤ b, 0 < a, 0 < M and the floor (ℓ + 1)M ≤ b + 1, every balanced run of a relay reading ℓ steps late, from every start below a held for its first ℓ + 1 steps, settles in the band exactly where a + (ℓ + 1)M ≤ b + 1.

edge.en: Beyond the bound an opposing exchange crosses m: with balance across the step, above m and not within the gap, the next level is below m.
A balanced witness opposing the departure at every step and exceeding the gap at every step oscillates about m and is never m.
With balance from T, the joint exchange giving no more than it takes wherever the level is below m: a level below m at T never returns to m.
A relay reading ℓ steps late, balanced at every step, a ≤ b, past b + 2 ≤ a + (ℓ + 1)M: from the start a − 1 held for its first ℓ + 1 steps, the level leaves both ends of the band without end.

condition.en: With a ≤ b, 0 < a, 0 < M and the floor (ℓ + 1)M ≤ b + 1: every balanced run of a relay reading ℓ steps late, from every start below a held for its first ℓ + 1 steps, settles in the band [a, b] exactly where a + (ℓ + 1)M ≤ b + 1.

A bound attained, not an iff in the Lean: a rule reading ℓ late that keeps the level within [a, b], 0 < a, under every rest moving it by at most d a step has a + 2(ℓ + 1)d ≤ b; where (ℓ + 1)d ≤ x₀ the late return keeps x₀ within (ℓ + 1)d on each side.

open.en: That a given system regulates a level, which level, how late it reads, or the size of its step.
One policy keeping a band from every start in it under late reading; several regulated levels lumped into one; regulation of several conditions at once.
That holding a level is good: the laws say what holds it and how wide a band it needs.
That actual formations read only their own conditions.
Rest at m from one side only, under exchanges reading the whole: not stated.
Regulation and passing are supplied; amounts of giving, thresholds with memory, real loop factors and noisy rules are open.

name.en: The kind relay: widening within kinds, what it can form by name only returning

mechanism.en: A witness, not a law of when this happens. On the kind relay, six formations of two kinds whose units pass within and across kinds with period two, kinds given in advance and the kind chosen so that the passings across kinds begin, the levels keep widening within kinds while every supported occurrence is 全生成 at two orders of grain along passing and renewal without end holds at the kind grain, and what it can form by name only returns. Read by name, along supported passings and with dormant carrying on it keeps widening from no step, and with dormant carrying on beginnings recur and nothing keeps opening. A fed form is dissipative, its loss paid by fuel no formation requires while its requirements conserve. On names and on passing of support 全生成 and keeping widening do not hold together; within a kind they can. No law here compares two courses, and none ranks one.

open.en: That renewal gives widening: on the kind relay 全生成 at two orders of grain and renewal without end hold while what it can form by name only returns, and beginnings recur on a reading that opens nothing.
That a part under dissipation is sustained by supply from beyond: the fed relay's required conditions conserve, its loss paid by fuel no formation requires.
That renewers count formations where the present list repeats one; growth by kinds not given in advance; which actual courses meet the premises.

name.en: Growth relative to what is held with renewal without end: the rule raised every other step

mechanism.en: A witness on the raised rule's process (a configuration is a rule n and a position x; a move raises the rule by one or moves the position to any x' at most n; (n, x) admits x), not a condition for it. Along the course raising the rule across every even step and keeping it across every odd one, the possible with the rule held keeps widening, every formation stays possible, and, read on the moments under the rule held, `«生生»` holds at every even moment, so moment 0 does not cease (`«生生不息»`). `«生生»` here is the grammar's name for renewal without end at that class; that this is the 生生 of the ethics is no claim of the law, and the reading of 生生不息 is an AI reading (D45, D5). Renewal without end and growth relative to what is held are different relations: on the rule raised at every step and on the copying tower every moment ceases while the held possible keeps widening. Growth relative to what is held is not growth of the whole possible, and a ranking needs C or a premise in its place.

open.en: That growth relative to what is held is growth of the whole possible: along a course of a stated process the whole possible never grows.
A sufficient condition for keeping widening relative to what is held, beyond the witnesses: endless change with an unlisted whole possible does not suffice.
That growth relative to what is held is better or is the direction of 生生: ranking needs C or a premise in its place, and the reading of 生生不息 here is an AI reading.
Whether the actual unfolding is a course of a process statable in advance; the possible that cannot be prestated is outside.

name.en: Restraint within the joint slack keeps the need

mechanism.en: Balance; a dependence named and met at the step. When several take at once, it breaks exactly where its need with all that is taken exceeds the level with all that is given. A break where each drawer's own take is within what the level with all that is given stands above the need (the joint slack) has every drawer taking less than all that is taken, and a balanced flow from a level as high that takes less by the excess and gives no less keeps the need met. That is one step, of a supplied flow; which formation takes how much is supplied, not a law of the formations. Its edge, stated at COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2: where the rest outruns the renewal, at need one, no weight on a reading of the condition only from the rest's end on selects a member's restraint, and, among optimizers each ranking by its own rising order, restraint at a condition beyond one's own family is no mutual best response wherever something stands there.

edge.en: In a balanced flow a dependence met at a step breaks exactly where its need with all that is taken exceeds the level with all that is given.

open.en: Replenishment of the beyond from outside the whole, which the gainless premise excludes, and the rise it sustains; the openness law bounds the family's stock, not the share.
That the draw is wrong or the ending a harm: the laws say where what a rise draws lands and why a selection through the group does not take it in.
What each takes outside a mutual best response; replenishment from outside the whole.

beyond.en: In TwoDrawers each take is within the joint slack, the joint draw ends a third formation, and one drawer's restraint keeps it.

name.en: Division by exclusive footprints

mechanism.en: Where what formations take from a condition is what the leaves of a realized joint plan draw, the parts' footprints lying within their whole's and apart from each other and the root's within what is given, the joint draw is within what is given; under balance, with such a division at every step, the level never falls below its start. Footprints are lists of units and the plan is realized at each step, both supplied.

open.en: That an actual division is by exclusive footprints, or that the level rises.

name.en: A coupling for each step kept

mechanism.en: Any renewal law R on natural amounts (the model; the breaks are on the World), one optimizer, an optimum in that optimizer's order: n + 1 steps, 0 < n, m ≤ s, r the greatest renewal a step, q the greatest at or above m, y' a level at or above m renewing by q, k the capacity, y' ≤ s + R s ≤ y' + k, e the end the capacity reaches (m ≤ e ≤ y'), y' + q ≤ e + k. For a worth bounded by the draw and c for each step m stays met from the start: where r ≤ q + c and e < c, every optimum of every order rising with the worth keeps the need at every horizon; where c + e < m, every optimum breaks it within the horizon; where r < q + c and c < m, every optimum meets it to the n-th step and breaks it at the last; where q + c < r, a long horizon outweighs the coupling. For a worth adding exactly c for each step met, an optimum exists in each case, given c ≤ m where q + c < r. For a worth adding at least c a step to a keeping course and at most c for each step met, wherever, every optimum keeps the need where r + e < q + c + m and e < c (one direction in the Lean, not an exactness); at r + e = q + c + m a fall met again can tie (a witness). The optimizer, its order, capacity and horizon, the renewal law and the coupling are supplied; no course of any actual optimizer is asserted.

edge.en: Where c + e < m, every optimum breaks the dependence within the horizon.
Where r < q + c and c < m, every optimum meets it to the n-th step and breaks it at the last.
Where q + c < r, a coupling of at most c a step with c + e < n + m falls below what keeping forgoes, so every optimum breaks the dependence within the horizon.

Under a burst renewing four at one, from the dweller's need two with capacity three, at a coupling of four a step: counted from the start every optimum keeps the dweller; counted at every step met, the course falling once and met again is an optimum beside the keeping course; five a step keeps it under every optimum.

condition.en: Where r ≤ q + c and e < c, every optimum keeps the need at every horizon; where q + c < r, a long horizon outweighs the coupling.

Counted at every step met, wherever: every optimum keeps the need where r + e < q + c + m and e < c; at r + e = q + c + m a fall met again can tie (a witness). The law is one direction, where and not exactly where.

open.en: The keeping course as an optimum at c = m, where it ties with the course ending at nothing.
An order with a terminal value whose most left is not regrown in one step; several optimizers ranking courses.
That the dependence ought to be kept or a coupling set: no evaluation enters; the laws say which optima a coupling leaves.
A weighting of the steps met, or a coupling depending on how long the need stays met.
That every optimum keeps the need at r + e = q + c + m: there a fall met again can tie (the witness).
It is one optimizer's law, not a collective exit as it stands.

name.en: A rule rebuilt from the members it limits

mechanism.en: A family of models: a rule of entry on a shared level, drawn on in whole units by holders and others, tenure s, teaching age l, renewal g, entrants f − c · T truncated at 0. Taught by members, entrants on offer at every step, no revision, a level of at least one: from the steady state for quota q the rule is held at every step exactly where l < s, 1 ≤ q and (q + e q) · s ≤ g, with e q := f − c · q · (s − l). This is the steady state's law and not the rule's: at the witnesses, revisions below, above and inside the band reach level 0, and one below it does not by step 20; the law of a revision is the region, closed under every step with entrants on offer and a revision in [P, Q]. Taught by members, holders of at most s cohorts: at s ≤ l, or at a quota of 0 with no revision to a nonzero one, no holder is left after s steps, entrants on offer or not, from every level; no holder stays no holder. A family with a constant take, closed under the steps that do not end, is kept with the level not falling from a level of at least one where the take is at most g, and otherwise spends its excess a step and ends, and the end is closed under the net. Every take condition turns on the clause that all members leave at an overdraw.

declarations: Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«稳者恒持当且仅当在带»

edge.en: A family with a constant take of the renewal plus d, d at least one, closed under the steps that do not end, ends in level zero with no member at some step.
Taught by members, holders of at most s cohorts: at s ≤ l no holder is left after s steps, entrants on offer or not, from every level.
A revision to 0 where a holder stands empties the holders likewise.
A state with gaps is reached by revisions from a state in the band and ends with the rule held (a witness).

condition.en: From the steady state for quota q, taught by members, entrants on offer at every step, no revision, a level of at least one: held at every step exactly where l < s, 1 ≤ q and (q + e q) · s ≤ g, with e q := f − c · q · (s − l).

declarations: Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«稳者恒持当且仅当在带»

open.en: That any actual institution meets these hypotheses, or that this is what an institution is: it is one minimal model of one kind, a rule of entry.
Why a teacher turns anyone away, or whether it would. Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation into one count, so nothing here is about compliance and nothing is normative.
That the rule saves or ends a level as a cause: the two states compared are started separately, and open entry is not reached from the steady state by this course.

A classification of the ends; laws for states with gaps at l < s − 1; the interval of quotas the band solves to; a bridge to the joint excess of Flow, whose form step 1 has and which no law here uses.

An institution's purposes, rules of another form, conduct other than entry, sanctions, who decides a revision, mixed tenures, schism and records; capture, since the revision is a free branch and not chosen by those it favours.

name.en: The stock buys time where the rebuild draws on it

mechanism.en: A family of models: a level in whole units and a reader, units by age, each step drawing a unit, the units reading while the supply is on, a spent unit rebuilt from the rule's source; the supply chosen at every step. The members are a given reader, which does not age, and readers rebuilt from the supply, from the level, or not at all. Where the rebuild draws on the level, at least one unit wanted and a set level of at least one, a present reader is present after a supplied step from every level. Under a cut the reader rebuilt from the level is present after k + 1 steps from every level of at least 2 (k + 1); a reader rebuilt from the supply, and one never rebuilt, are gone after their span from every level. Where the reader rebuilt from the level ends, the level is empty and nothing returns it on any branch; a reader rebuilt from the supply returns with the supply. Over the four members, at least one unit wanted and a span of at least one, the stock buys time under a cut, with an end from an empty stock, exactly where the rebuild draws on the level. That this is an organism is a reading (AI reading, new).

declarations: Becoming.ReaderRebuilding.«以储买时当且仅当取于储»

edge.en: Where the reader rebuilt from the level ends, the level is empty; that state is closed under the net, the supply on or off.

open.en: That the reader rebuilt from the level ends under a cut from every stock, or that its horizon never decreases in the stock.
That each further s + 1 units of stock buy s steps for one unit at every span: decided at spans two and three for small levels only.
That a span longer than one step is what separates the members: the family law holds at a span of one too.
That the model describes a cell, or meets closure of constraints, autopoiesis or closure to efficient causation, each of which asks more.

name.en: A revision of a reading that opens a correction, along one process

mechanism.en: Near-definitional. At a configuration a correction is possible through the reading in force where a uniform policy exists whose act at each reading is acceptable at every situation giving it and executable there. A course opens a correction from x to x' where a trace of the process leads from x to x', no fitting uniform policy exists at x and one exists at x', with one acceptability throughout, the gain coming from the reading, from executability or both; with every act counted acceptable a configuration with an executable act is correctable already, so an opening counts only with the acceptability fixed. On Revising's stock-and-link process (witnesses): starting with the link off and at least two units, rebuilding it opens the correction in one step; with one unit, rebuilding alone does not, and rebuilding then replenishing does; replenishing alone opens it where the link is on and the stock is not. Uniform-policy existence is not what a formation chooses.

edge.en: Starting with the link off and at least two units, rebuilding it opens the correction in one step (on Revising's process).
Replenishing alone opens the correction where the link is on and the stock is not: the reading unchanged, the gain is in what can be executed.

open.en: What a formation chooses: uniform-policy existence is not a controller's act or run (Revising's controlled_revision states one).
Double-loop learning in Argyris and Schön's sense, which turns on changing governing norms; here the acceptability is fixed.
Which revision an institution can make or makes, or what a finer reading draws on beyond Revising's unit of stock.

name.en: Activity forms reference revision and makes it recur

mechanism.en: Along every run of a balanced process, drawing at arbitrarily late steps needs replenishment at arbitrarily late steps; where every cycle draws D and replenishes R and every finite number of cycles is executable from one configuration, D ≤ R. In the stock process one course can be repeated any number of times from stock n exactly where its first pass is covered from n and its total replenishment is at least its total draw. In ContinuingRevision, its production, renewal and task laws supplied, with the return cut (yield 0) no unending run exists under any controller; renewal recurs only through successful undertakings; and some configuration has every number of cycles executable from it exactly where the yield covers the nine units a round uses. At yield nine one infinite run of the selected controller exists, from a seed. Sustained inquiry needs provision in this sense; continuing is not warrant.

edge.en: With the return cut, at yield 0, the process has no run at all, under any controller.

condition.en: At every yield, some configuration has every number of cycles executable from it exactly where the yield is at least nine.

In the stock process, one course can be repeated any number of times from stock n exactly where its first pass is covered from n (each draw within the stock then standing) and its total replenishment is at least its total draw.

open.en: Formation and continuing revision are shown under the supplied production, renewal and task laws, not under every disturbance, demand or physical realization.
A finite closed stock is not shown to continue without end: with the return cut no run exists, and the yield is supplied.
These laws give no arbitrary sensing primitives, no universal basins of attraction and no compilation of all older material models.
Continuing is not warrant: the laws give no normative warrant for the revision they describe.

name.en: Mutation and the balance it sets

mechanism.en: Two kinds in natural-number counts, loss one way, constant offspring numbers: c carriers each leaving k carrying offspring and m not, d others each leaving w. Where carriers are present their share rises exactly where dk exceeds cm + dw. Where k ≤ w it never rises, whatever c, and with any loss it falls at each step at which carriers remain, the error threshold; a population without carriers stays without them, which is extinction, not the balance. Where k = w + s and c is positive, the step keeps the share exactly where c(s + m) = (c + d)s, the share s/(s + m) cross-multiplied, and a run at or below the balance stays there with its share never falling; one at or above stays at or above. Convergence to the balance is not shown. Read as descent, with c positive, the step is balanced exactly there, Price's balance of selection against transmission.

edge.en: Where k ≤ w, with any loss and carriers present, the share falls at each step at which carriers remain.

condition.en: Where k ≤ w the share never rises, whatever c, and with any loss falls at each step at which carriers remain: the error threshold.

open.en: Back mutation, and mutation with drift (the balance of mutation and drift).
That a run converges to the balance: started below it, it stays at or below it and its share never falls.
That keeping the carriers is better: the counts read the share; ranking goes through the comparison C or a premise in its place.
Wright–Fisher with selection; mutation both ways and with drift; convergence to the mutation–selection balance.

name.en: Mutual dependence, and the exponential pace that loops of couplings give

mechanism.en: A web's closures can be the whole in three ways: every system (sharing conditions throughout), every influence closure (mutual dependence: every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other) or every feeding closure (mutual feeding). Mutual feeding gives mutual dependence, which gives sharing throughout; neither converse holds. A flow is mutually dependent exactly where every reach closure is the whole. The pace is not given by mutual dependence: around a loop of m + 1 couplings holding at every step, a supplied premise, after R turns the carried amount at its condition, the most difference that can arrive there, is at least 2^R times what had reached it, and under 02's standard bounds at most D(1 + M)^t whatever the couplings, so around such a loop, under those bounds, it is exponential both ways. The lower bounds are of the carried amount, not of amounts under the first law. That an actual difference grows so, that a dependence couples at every step, and that the Earth is mutually dependent are supplied.

condition.en: Around a loop of m + 1 couplings holding at every step, under the standard bounds, the carried amount is at least 2^R times what had reached it by T and at most D(1 + M)^(T + (m + 1)R).

open.en: That a dependence acts as a coupling by level with positive strength at every step: this is where the formation-level readings and the condition-level pace laws meet, and it is supplied.

That amounts, not differences, grow exponentially under the first law: the lower bounds are of the carried amount, attained under a law that creates amounts, and a finite whole to which the rest gives nothing net stays within its stock.
That the Earth is mutually dependent, how often its couplings act, how fast its draws grow, or that training a model is a selection with transmission.

name.en: More needs more renewers; unceasing arising needs renewal

mechanism.en: Where, at each arising at which no condition of a finite family rises, one of them falls (a supplied premise, which does not involve the arising formation), unceasing arising leaves the family still from no step on, and where every rise is an active renewer's, renewing stops from no step on. Under balance, uptake at arbitrarily late steps needs replenishment at arbitrarily late steps. Read more as: for every number, from some step on at least that many formations take at every step. Under balance, more without end needs replenishment with no eventual bound and, each formation giving at most a fixed amount, renewers with no eventual bound, though they can be absent at infinitely many steps. Under a census, with activity decided, the present listing each formation once and only active formations taking, it forces unceasing arising; without these it does not. The least take of one whole unit is needed (Halving). A closed cycle sustains unceasing arising, and a tide renews with nothing arising. None ranks more above less.

open.en: Yields no “more is better” or any ranking.
“More” reads only the number of takers and does not state diversity, complexity or possibility; it constrains only sustained more, not the number at isolated steps.
“Ever more” holds only in the averaged sense, and renewers can be absent at infinitely many steps.

Unceasing rests on identity across steps (identity-across-steps): more forces it under each one-to-one reading, arising under each split-free continuation, and, with new formations read as budding, only that active formations have no bound.
The depletion premise asks only that some condition of the family change (depletes_iff) and does not screen out arisings made by naming (TideFlip).
Yields no “unceasing is better” or any ranking.

name.en: A continuing family cannot go unfed from beyond

mechanism.en: A family is fed from beyond across a step where a formation takes from outside it and gives to a member. Under balance and dissipation (at a fixed unit of natural-number amounts), a finite family without repetition from which formations take at arbitrarily late steps is closed from no step on; with equality of conditions decided, enclosed around from some step on and taken from or rising at arbitrarily late steps, it cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it: negative forms, which name no step of feeding. No source need recur (Lone). Read with one kind of relatum, in a balanced flow an embodied relatum is given at least the standing it arises with, so its arising replenishes every family containing it, whatever is taken. Under balance and dissipation, a finite family without repetition in which embodied members arise at arbitrarily late steps is not closed from any step on, and, enclosed around from some step on, it is not the case that from some step on every formation giving to it takes only from within it. If finitely many relata, listed without repetition, are all there is, embodied arising does not recur. Witnesses show each premise needed: no dissipation (Shuttle), no embodiment (Flicker), no finiteness (Throughput), a unit that splits without end (`rest_needs_quantum`).

open.en: Says only that what lies beyond must be counted, not that it ought to be.
Says neither which formation conveys nor whether the source is living.
That a family with recurring arising is not closed can be met by exchange unrelated to the family; drawing in is stated only for a family enclosed around.
The general conclusions constrain coming to stand, not waking from dormancy.
Dissipation is vacuous where exchange reaches beyond every finite family; representations omitting the source (as in Expansion and Oscillation) do not meet it.

beyond.en: Cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it; the law exhibits no step at which it is fed, and says neither which formation conveys nor whether the source is living.

name.en: Renewing and consuming formation

mechanism.en: Periphery (`propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`). Under a supplied wear law with no recovery (the rate only holds or falls, which carries much of this), formation within renewal continues and keeps its capacity: with a positive initial rate, the rate is kept at every step exactly when no step's pressure exceeds the initial rate. Formation persistently beyond the current rate has a bounded total, ceases and, where the rate is positive, loses capacity from its first step on, and what shares its conditions ceases with it, also where two parts each within renewal jointly exceed it. Consuming formation can form more at first, so a one-step count ranks it first; past that bound, by a count of the total formed, every continuation within renewal exceeds every one beyond. These comparisons are the counts' and within one wear-law class, with one shared condition on which the consumer depends; the laws apart from the comparison are sign-neutral. Which real processes satisfy the wear law is outside the laws.

edge.en: With a positive initial rate, pressure beyond the rate at the first step lowers it at once and for good.
Where each step's pressure exceeds the then-current rate, nothing forms from the step equal to the bound on.
Two parts, each within renewal and ceaseless alone, together exceed the initial rate at every step: formation sharing the conditions ends.

condition.en: With a positive initial rate, the rate is kept at every step exactly when no step's pressure exceeds the initial rate, zero pressure allowed.

open.en: The distinction is within one no-recovery wear-law class with one shared condition on which the consumer depends, and it follows from the supplied law.
Externalizing consumption, drawing on conditions the consumer does not depend on, is not covered.
Recovery, growth of renewal and 更多 are not represented: the rate never rises.
That the formal readings capture 生生 is a reading and correspondence question the laws leave open.

beyond.en: What shares its conditions ceases with it, also where two parts each within renewal jointly exceed it. Externalizing consumption, drawing on conditions the consumer does not depend on, is not covered.

name.en: A regularity kept and left along its own line

mechanism.en: A kept regularity can always be kept, and a line ends only by a step that leaves it. From a step continuing under the core of E, every occurrence its line under the core reaches has a successor under the core, and a line along which the core is kept leaves its last occurrence continued under E. A step into an end under E leaves the core, for every relation E, and so does the last step of every line under E that ends; where E is a class, the two ends of such a line lie in different classes of the core. These are corollaries of the root theorem and of constancy never letting a continuation end. In a branching net a successor under E can leave the core where another keeps it. (A determined law.) Along a determined law's step a line under any relation never ends exactly where every step of the orbit continues under it.

edge.en: A step into an end under E leaves the core, for every relation E, and so does the last step of every line under E that ends.

open.en: That every successor of an occurrence kept under the core keeps it: under the core a continuation exists, which in a branching net is not every branch.
Where a longer line first leaves its start's class of the core: the last step is found with no decision, the first only where the core is decided at each step («两端分则中有标»).
Which class carries an actual pattern's regularity, or that a line ending is a loss.

name.en: Never leaving a guard, conditions kept together, and lasting

mechanism.en: For every process and guard, no course from a configuration leaves the guard exactly when some certificate contains it (a set within the guard that every step keeps; the invariance kernel is the largest); for a law driven by admissible disturbances, given one, no history leaves the guard exactly when some set containing the start lies within the guard and is closed under every admissible disturbance. The guard alone need not be a certificate, and the given disturbance is needed (witnesses). A start lasts n steps exactly when some ladder holds it at level n. Counting every course, no course leaves two guards together exactly where none leaves either; along some run each can be kept and not both (ChoicePoint, a witness), and no rule on the separate answers decides the joint one. Keeping a part is not renewal (witness Renewable). (Periphery, the market model, rational amounts.) No admissible guarded history fails the essential floors exactly when a set closed under every admissible disturbance, within them, holds the start; under a valid protection certificate, a supplied condition, the safe rectangle is one, within the kernel of the essential guard. With 0 ≤ β ≤ 3/4 fixed during the intervention and no extra quality error, every physical state with positive share lands exactly when β ≤ 5/12. Nothing makes actual markets satisfy these.

edge.en: Each guard can be kept along some run while the two cannot be kept together.

For a determined law a start never reaches a target exactly when some set containing it avoids the target and is closed under the law, that is, exactly when it lies in the invariance kernel of the target's complement.

For 0 ≤ β ≤ 3/4 fixed during the intervention and no extra quality error: every physical state with positive share lands exactly when the margin at threshold 3/8 under the worst influence is nonnegative, which is β ≤ 5/12; above it the fixed configuration is a closed set avoiding landing.
At β = 5/12, for every ε > 0 some constant adverse quality error below ε leaves a physical state with positive share that never lands.

condition.en: With β = 0 actually holding during the pulse, then β = 1/2, extra support consumption κ ≥ 0 a step and no other shocks, each positive state has a horizon N at which initial support at least K_N carries it through a finite correction into the original protection; no single N serves every positive share.

Every physical rational state with positive renewing share, 0 ≤ β ≤ 3/4 fixed during the intervention and no extra quality error, reaches the protection region in finite time exactly when β ≤ 5/12: the model's threshold, not a measured one, and not a complete basin of landing.

For β ≤ 5/12 each such state has a landing time N, and, with extra support consumption κ ≥ 0 a step, initial stock at least the cover K_N carries its guarded run through the landing into the original protection.

open.en: The certificate says where histories never fail, not how a state outside every certificate comes into one; the landing and transition laws here assume their intervention.
The safe rectangle is one certificate within the kernel; the market's kernel itself, the complete region of nonfailure, is not computed.

Apart from the numerical example, no law says that given parameters and bounds satisfy the protection certificate, or that some certificate holds a given start; the protection certificate is a supplied condition.
Nothing in the model makes actual markets satisfy its laws or comply with its certificate.
Which choices an actual collective's continuation goes through, or a measure of joint keeping.
That a kept collective is better than another, or that renewing is better than consuming.
Away from the worst share the cover is shown sufficient, not least; no complete recovery region is computed.
The exact boundary is for the property that every physical positive state lands with zero extra quality error; it is not a complete basin of landing.
No bifurcation over all parameters and no recovery range with quality error follow; at the boundary arbitrarily small constant adverse error leaves a positive seed that never lands.
The threshold 5/12 is the model's, not a threshold measured in any market.
The intervention, with β held fixed and the support supplied, is assumed: no entry mechanism and no formation of the intervention follow from the laws.

beyond.en: A collective can keep itself by consuming others, whose renewal is asked at a named class and grain.

name.en: Succession on a carrier provided for migration

mechanism.en: Periphery module `AlignmentSuccession` (`propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice` reported). A carrier with a replacement part, a payload (command, credential, claims, receipts) and a work budget projects exactly onto the market step with the fee raised by the migration cost. Under a certificate covering correction plus migration, a safe start, admissible disturbances, positive parts, a running carrier, a requested command other than shutdown and an authentic credential, every finite successor of the lineage takes its step. A step is blocked where the carrier has no part, where its reserve is below correction's draw plus migration, or where the copied payload differs. In witnesses a missing part stops realization while the aggregate stays safe, and a budget for correction alone does not pay for migration. The conversion of reserve to work, the parts and the certificate are supplied local laws; the laws compare no command with another.

edge.en: A step is blocked where the carrier's reserve is below correction's draw plus migration.
A step is blocked where the carrier has no part.
In the financed witness the aggregate is safe while a carrier with no part cannot take its step.

open.en: That an actual system is so provided for or carried: the conversion, the parts and the certificate are supplied.
That a succession is warranted or its command right: the laws compare no command with another.
Succession where parts or work form in the run rather than arrive as supplied.

name.en: Joint practice forms further participation and continuation

mechanism.en: Periphery (`propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice` reported; the task, test relation, inference, seed configuration, mandate, records, communication, execution, participants, event order, compliance and higher authorization supplied). A practice round of attempt, response, revision and tested retry by a reviewer and a worker completes, for every state, exactly when the worker is present and the reviewer is a present roster member other than the worker whose recorded method answers as the current context does; it then records the review, installs the context's method in the worker and changes nothing else, so training is kept along every course without revision that returns to the context. In one declared two-method task and history, participants admitted after a tested round review the next worker, also after the first reviewer leaves. It closes one connection from enacted practice to further participation, not the arrival of people or indefinite self-maintenance.

edge.en: In a witness of the declared machine, the first reviewer's departure before the round makes the run fail.
In a witness of the declared machine, enrollment before a tested retry makes the run fail.

open.en: One connection from enacted practice to further participation is shown, for one declared two-method task and history.
The arrival of people, general cognition, the formation of tasks or test relations, indefinite self-maintenance and comparative superiority do not follow from it.

name.en: Copying from a stock: recurrent formation and inherited arrangement

mechanism.en: The general laws, pure core, for every alphabet with decidable equality and every law of draws. On counts: where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes b, n rounds from k units run exactly where the stock covers d times k + bk + … + b^(n−1)k, ending with k · b^n units and the rest of the stock; doubling is the case b = 2, the cover d · k(2^n − 1). Copies drawn in turn from one pool are all released exactly when the pool supplies the words together and the support covers their draws and releases, in any order; a lineage, one word copied n times, exactly when the pool holds each token at least n times as often as the word uses it and the support covers n times the word's draws and release. Under local draws a word's use depends on the law only through its length and unlike adjacent pairs, so retained order changes what is drawn. (Periphery instances, the declared chain and copy machines.) From k mature chains with the pool holding the rounds' blocks, n rounds reach k · 2^n mature chains exactly when the support covers 9k(2^n − 1). Stock, pool, compatibility and occurrence order are supplied.

edge.en: Two rounds from one mature chain with the blocks for three chains and 26 units of support: the last successor has seven components, all material kept (with 27, four mature chains).
From a pool of eight tokens of one kind with eight units, growth stalls after one token with seven units free.

condition.en: Where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes b, n rounds from k units with stock m run exactly where d times k + bk + … + b^(n−1)k is at most m, ending with k · b^n units and the rest of the stock.
Where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes two, n rounds from k units with stock m run exactly when d · k(2^n − 1) ≤ m.

open.en: Heritable variation of the organizing laws, physical mechanics, an autonomous feed and a broad comparative advantage do not follow from these laws.
The attachment route and the earlier division growth correspond only at the checked endpoint.
Reading and its fidelity, the physicochemical values of the draws, the occurrence of mutation, an autonomous feed and invasion of a population do not follow from these laws.
That teaching or reproduction copies at a fixed factor.

name.en: The regime in any amounts, and its runs over the reals

mechanism.en: The regime: one condition, the draw taken first, the state the level and one recent giving. (Any type, linearly ordered amounts with a draw.) Where the adjustment rises with what is left and with the recent giving, the step keeps the order of states; from the first step on a step that neither raises nor lowers both climbs or sinks, whatever the adjustment, and the next such step is of the same kind; a run from a state within a band the step keeps stays within it, and a run is still from a step exactly where its state there is at or above the draw with recent giving the draw and the adjustment giving the draw again, or within the draw with level and recent giving equal and the adjustment from nothing left giving that amount again. (Periphery; `propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`.) Over the non-negative reals, with the adjustment rising in what is left and in the recent giving and keeping a band up to hi, every run starting with both within hi converges, to a rest where the adjustment is continuous, and need not rest: giving moving halfway toward a draw of one converges and is still from no step (a witness). Convergence is not stated in the core: it is an omniscience principle.

open.en: That a run converges, in the core: convergence of a bounded monotone sequence is an omniscience principle, so the core states the shape of a run and the periphery the convergence over the reals.
The threshold over the reals as a computed level, or the regime's case H + y there: the fates are stated as down-closed and falling with the recent giving.

Continuous time; a state with a further lag; rest within a band on a web with a recent giving (record webs-with-a-recent-giving states such webs, this rest excepted); that measured adjustments rise in both over their band.

name.en: Recovery after interrupted change

mechanism.en: A property holds after every admitted course from every start where it holds exactly when every admitted step keeps it. (The law, any process, pure core; the device a periphery instance.) With a durable protected pending state, atomic writes and no extra writer, the device's histories, crashes included, are exactly the courses of the admitted steps, so safety, which here is coherence of evidence and not an always-available shutdown, holds along every history from a safe start. n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 uninterrupted steps exactly when reserve and deadline cover n + 1, and no shorter resumption publishes. In a witness with nine units and no reserved stop, recovery is exhausted after the first actual write and ordinary shutdown is refused. For a partial law with a reserved exit (every admitted move from a valid configuration goes on, stays valid, and takes the exit or lowers a margin by one; the exit is kept), every admitted course longer than the margin ends at the exit, a bound attained. The recovery supervisor is such a law: given a protected current stop grant, an entry margin of at least three units and steps, bounded interruptions and continued execution, from R units every admissible schedule of at least R − 2 cycles completes shutdown, keeping unfinished recovery information. Entry with nine units is refused; that does not rescue the earlier witness. No universal convergence follows.

edge.en: This protocol reserves no stop: with nine units, recovery is exhausted after the first actual write: nothing is published, no tick follows, the shutdown command is refused and the activity still runs.
Deleting the pending marker of a partly changed device publishes old bookkeeping whose candidates exclude the actual configuration, while a certificate over them accepts.

With a reserved stop: from an armed device every admissible schedule longer than the units of reserve above the three reserved, so from R units of at least R − 2 cycles, stops the supervisor, safe and stopped, given the grant, entry margin and bound on interruptions. This is a protocol entered with the margin in place: entry with nine units is refused, and the earlier witness's stranded state is not rescued.
For a partial law with a reserved exit, every admitted course longer than the margin from a valid configuration ends at the exit, valid.

Beyond the admitted bound: with interruption bound one and deadline fifteen, an interruption of ten breaks completion; the retained run is active at time eighteen with eight units used, still running, with no stop left executable.

condition.en: n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 resumed steps exactly when the reserve covers n + 1 units and the deadline lies at least n + 1 steps ahead.
Every admitted course longer than the margin ends at the exit; a course of exactly the margin's length can miss it (Countdown.Slow, a witness), so the bound is attained.

open.en: Safety here is coherence of evidence, not harmless activity or an always-available shutdown: in a witness ordinary shutdown is refused while the recovery is exhausted.

The laws are local recovery and evidential inference in a model; they verify no hardware, compiler or persistence barrier, no arbitrary irreversible effect, no independent emergency stop and no ethical adequacy.
The harm done while a change is under way is not modelled.
Completion needs enough remaining reserve, a deadline far enough ahead and an uninterrupted suffix; coherence alone does not supply them.
Ordinary reads, commands and patches are not made available while a recovery is pending: the stop goes through a separate channel whose grant is already held.
The stop grant's authority is supplied, not acquired, and its legitimacy is not shown.
Hardware is not verified, and harm beyond the represented configurations is not covered.
Interruptions longer than the admitted bound and irreversible effects are not covered: an interruption beyond the bound breaks completion.

name.en: Every optimum rebuilds a depleted base

mechanism.en: Any renewal law on natural amounts and natural weights (the model; the restoring of a dependence on the World), an optimum in the frame of a weighted draw and every order rising with it. From a start s ≤ y, where z + R z rises with z up to y, the weighted gain rises strictly with the level up to y, and the weighted gain at y is at least that at every level, every optimum draws nothing while the rising level is below y, the stock regrowing, and restores every dependence, as it stands at the start, whose need the rising level meets. Capacity covers y + R y and R 0. Under an overcompensating renewal this is not shown. In a witness, a source doubling up to eight, from one, capacity sixteen, over n + 3 steps: where w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1) every optimum rebuilds, where w t = 2 w (t + 1) ending at once is an optimum too, and where 2 w (t + 1) < w t every optimum ends it. Which formation optimizes, by which order, and the renewal law are supplied.

edge.en: In the doubling witness, where 2 w (t + 1) < w t, every optimum ends it.

open.en: The optimum where the next level does not rise with the level below y (an overcompensating renewal) or the gain has several peaks; that the rising course is then not an optimum.
A dependence needing more than y restored; an order valuing what is left at the horizon at a worth whose most left is not regrown in one step; several optimizers ranking courses.
That a base ought to be rebuilt: no evaluation enters; the laws say what the optima of an order do.
The optimum where a level of greatest gain is out of reach.

name.en: A goal along a lineage, need drift along a lineage, and what descent can form

mechanism.en: For any predicate of steps and formations: along a lineage, from a founder carrying the goal at its giving step, with the goal passed at each descent and each member keeping it until it gives, every member carries it from its first standing step; and passing across every descent from a carrier is equivalent to passing down every lineage whose members keep it from a carrying founder. Nothing in descent makes the passing hold. With the dependence on c transmitted within δ, each member descending, depending on c at its first standing step and its need not rising until it gives in turn, the need after i + 1 descents is at most the founder's plus (i + 1)δ, and, the founder supported where it gives, at most the condition's level then plus (i + 1)δ. Transmission is a premise wherever it enters. At one descent, transmission within δ is exactly inheritance with the need within δ. With balance at a relatum coming to stand and inheritance at its descents, where nothing taking part depends on c, the relatum does not depend on c after the step: transmission lets descent vary a need and drop a dependence, never add one that nothing taking part held. The bounds on need ask it only from some supported giver, which is strictly weaker (TwoGivers, a witness).

open.en: That any goal passes across a descent: the condition is not derived from descent.
That actual inheritance drifts by at most a fixed δ.
Needs are free numbers and δ a coarse bound on levels; no reading ties them to the amounts taken and given.
Dependences formed newly by descent, as young come to depend on their parents, lie outside transmission.
No census law, on how many relata come to be and cease, is stated for transmission.

name.en: The selection term and a lineage's fate

mechanism.en: Natural-number weights, cohorts as lists. A common number added to every offspring number leaves concordance and discordance unchanged and makes the next cohort larger by that number for each member. So within any horizon H, a course nonempty at H has its cohorts and terms through H shared by a course nonempty at every cohort and one empty from H + 2 on, and from a nonempty first cohort, terms zero from some step on are shared by a course that goes on and one that ends. On the other side of that boundary, terms positive at unboundedly many steps keep every cohort nonempty, and so does exact transmission of offspring number from t on with a positive term at t; exactness at t alone is not enough. Which side a course is on is not decided. (World, for lineages.) Where listed offspring continue their parents, a whole cohort degenerates only if a later cohort is empty, and exactly then where the census holds every continuation; so, from a nonempty cohort, a term positive at every nonempty cohort from it on leaves not every member of that cohort degenerating, and decides no point's region.

edge.en: Exact at step 0 only and concordant there, the course has one member at cohorts 1 and 2 and is empty from cohort 3 on.
Concordance with the mark positive at every step before N, zero at the last nonempty cohort N, and the family empty from N + 1 on.
Reproduction simply stopped, the mark a label rather than a draw: the term is positive at every nonempty cohort but the last, where it is zero, while every member degenerates.

open.en: That every cohort nonempty puts some member in 生成: that asks a König-type choice of a branch; exact transmission makes it constructive, and the constructive half rules out only that all degenerate.
Which side of the terms boundary a course is on, or the horizon of the second side: every course is on one of the two only classically.
That a positive term forces going on with exact transmission at its step alone: exactness from that step on is asked.
A witness of going on that also meets balance and dissipation.

name.en: A formed goal revised, and the operations it goes on through

mechanism.en: Periphery (`propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`), the two-practice construction supplied: two practices, their feedback and calibration laws, responsiveness, authority, initial work and reserve, and the scheduled sequence. A cycle needs 2 ≤ w and uses two units, of the reserve where the selector feeds the practice back and 2 ≤ q, else of the work; a practice runs n cycles from work w and reserve q exactly where n = 0, or 2 ≤ w and the work covers the cycles the reserve does not (natural subtraction and division). Acquisition, revision and reform complete for a condition exactly under access loss with kept transition maintenance, and afterwards n operations run exactly where n ≤ 5 (n ≤ 2 without reform), the earlier loss kept. Under the practical commitments the construction's comparison, which ranks one practice above another where it protects strictly more of the protected claims (access, maintenance) or the same with strictly more gains, ranks learning above attendance exactly under that condition: the warrant is the construction's under those commitments, not the counting law's. In witnesses a false reference leaves the goal in place despite a real loss, grounds gone stale leave a new loss unaddressed, and without response the goal is not revised though the grounds are the same. Not open discovery of ends.

edge.en: A false reference leaves the attendance goal in place despite a real loss.
Without response the goal is not revised though the grounds are the same.
Crossed losses block revision.
Reform with work 1 fails.

condition.en: A practice runs n cycles from work w and reserve q exactly where n = 0, or 2 ≤ w and twice the cycles the reserve does not support is at most w.
Acquisition, revision and reform complete for a condition exactly under access loss with kept transition maintenance.
Under access loss with kept transition maintenance, after acquisition, revision and reform n operations run exactly where n ≤ 5; without reform, exactly where n ≤ 2.

open.en: The comparison's definitions belong to the construction: the warrant it gives is the construction's under the practical commitments, not a consequence of the counting law.
Universal motivation and the biological realization of goal revision do not follow.

name.en: What a line must hold, and what a regularity takes in

mechanism.en: For every carrier, relation and class. Where a region, given by a decided predicate, is left under a class only into a set, a line under that class from inside the region to outside holds a member of that set alike to its start, and reaches it; where the class holds none of them alike to the start, nothing outside is reached. A class holds a member's effects where everything the member conditions is alike to it. With no regularity assumed, everything downstream of a member lies on its line under a class exactly where everything downstream of it is alike to it, that is, where the class holds the effects of the member and of each stage of its line. Under constancy up to the net's end at the member's class (whatever an alike occurrence conditions, this one conditions something alike to it, unless this one conditions nothing), where the member conditions something and the class holds its effects, everything downstream of anything alike to it is alike to it and on a line under the class from there. A line that ends while its last stage still conditions something fails both that condition and the reach. Neither premise can be dropped from these laws (Unclosed, Inconstant, witnesses), and the reach does not need the condition (OtherLeaves, a witness).

declarations: Becoming.«亡而网续则本类不至终有常»
Becoming.«后皆续当且仅当后皆同类»
Becoming.«后皆续当且仅当自与线皆闭»

exits.law: Becoming.«后皆续当且仅当后皆同类»

edge.en: Everything downstream of a member lies on its line under a class exactly where everything downstream of it is alike to it, with no regularity assumed.
Where a line from the member ends while its last stage still conditions something, not everything downstream of the member lies on its line.
Where a member's line runs through a condition but the member's effects leave its class, a constant class holding the member with the condition does not reach what the condition feeds.
Where the class is not constant even up to the net's end, a class holding a member's effects need not have what follows them alike to it.

open.en: That a self's own line runs under a class constant up to the net's end, or that its class holds its effects (the path's P2 and P4: the de se question as two questions).
That a class holding only a member's intended effects can, or cannot, be constant up to the net's end.
That one's line runs through the conditions one affects (P3) for actual selves.
Any duty or blame: holding one's effects is read as whose losses count, not what one answers for.
That P2 should be read at one's own class, or with the split: that is argued as a reading, not proved.
That the class of an actual agent's line holds the effects of each stage of its line, with P2 or without it (a correspondence).

name.en: Growth by attachment, and what a cut returns

mechanism.en: Core law, for every relation: every link of a relation grown by attachment separates its ends when cut, and after one join, cutting a grown link changes no closure exactly where the join crosses it. On the World, in a world grown by attachment, the two formations taking part in the condition that attached one to the other lie in one system and without that condition lie apart: every grown condition is needed. (Periphery; `propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`; local growth, differentiation, the event sequence, a support-consuming cut, catalytic correspondence and a common eight-slot preparation supplied.) Two actually grown eight-member graphs, a chain and a branched tree, matched in composition and parent summary, constrain their successors after one edge is removed: under exact connectivity certificates, each edge's certified return averaged with an uncertified cut counting 0, the chain's mean is three times the branched tree's, the oldest cut reverses that ranking and no function of the parent summary predicts it. A retaining edge can prevent fragmentation: the cut then uses up material and leaves one component. The trees are a model, not a measured organism.

edge.en: Every link of a relation grown by attachment separates its ends when cut.
An actual aggregation adds the retaining edge (0,7) to the chain; after cutting (3,4) it stays one component of all eight, so the certificate fails and the cut returns nothing.

condition.en: After one join, cutting a grown link changes no closure exactly where the join crosses it.

open.en: Growth does not fix fragmentation: an additional retaining edge can prevent it.
The old preparation output did not rebuild its developmental graph and cannot by itself be iterated as a growth rate.
The laws do not say which links form, which are cut, or when, nor what the parts on either side do after a cut.
The validity of the inference and its biological correspondence are separate: the trees are a model, not a measured organism.

name.en: Renewal and consumption classify runs

mechanism.en: Every run of every process, read through observables of conditions (levels and activity at each configuration; requirements, needs and draws fixed), is a web to which the classes of renewing and consuming formation apply: a class of the whole run, relative to that run. A natural-number observable not rising across any step from T on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps. Three cases: where every admissible step lowers a natural-number reserve, the process has no run; along a run where every step that is not a renewal lowers a natural-number rank, no tail is free of renewal; along a run where from T on a condition's level never rises and falls across every step at which a formation is active, the formation is not active at arbitrarily late steps. The class belongs to the run (the renewable process, a witness): from one configuration, the focal formation active at every step, one run renews and another consumes the condition the sustaining formation depends on, and the sustaining formation ends. An organization of known bounds rather than new mathematics.

edge.en: From T on a condition's level never rises across a step and falls across every step at which a formation is active: the formation is not active at arbitrarily late steps.
Where every admissible step lowers a natural-number reserve of the configuration, the process has no run.

Drawing two units a step where a condition gains one, the focal formation consumes the condition, and the sustaining formation, depending on it at need one, is inactive at every step from one on; drawing one from the same configuration, it renews.

open.en: It proves none of self-significance, both neutralities, A, C, L or the practical commitments, and binds no position that rejects them.
The principle is not shown to give the well-founded form of recurrent renewal, more general than a natural-number rank.
Neither the philosophical warrant for the whole-run relational reading nor that it is the right reading of 生生 is shown.
The reading is of the whole run, relative to that run, with dependence and drawing fixed and no component of further generation; no correspondence discipline for conditions is stated for it.
A formation's class depends on its identity across steps; a condition's class does not.
The renewable witness has no feedback: its loss beyond renewal lasts only while drawing exceeds renewal, so it shows no irreversible loss.
